jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

jobs.title: Product Management - Investments Advisory - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.
  
  
As a Product Manager in the Product Management team, you will be responsible for the product vision and strategies to come up with innovative solutions to problems that are valuable (our users choose to use them), viable (the solution works for the business), usable (the users can figure out how to use) and feasible.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Understand client and advisor needs. Invests in a deep understanding of the business opportunity, advisor & client needs and competitive landscape. Dive into research to uncover what matters most, ensuring every feature is relevant, useful, and ahead of the curve.
* Be passionate about AI & Innovation - Bring relentless passion for AI and innovation to the Private Bank every day. Focus on delivering standout client and product experiences. Collaborate closely with developers and UX designers to create intuitive, differentiated solutions. Prioritize features that deliver client impact and business goals, within complex control requirements.
* Inspire adoption – define and track KPIs for usage & impact (both quantitative & qualitative) metrics. Focus on constantly aligning our AI powered digital solutions with user needs to maximize AI adoption and impact across the Private Bank.
* Drives the product development lifecycle - define requirements (in partnership with cross-functional teams), ensuring sprint inputs and outputs are as envisioned, and providing direction and smart trade off decisions for the scrum team. Collaborates with others across broader teams to deliver end-to-end product and experience.
* Embody true “customer-obsession”. Put customer obsession at the heart of everything—leverage user data, performance metrics, industry trends, and all forms of feedback to shape design and roadmap decisions.
* Set the standard for piloting and rolling out new capabilities - define objectives, scope, communication, training, support, and feedback/metrics to ensure successful adoption.
* Develop and maintain deep relationships with delivery partners including senior leaders, Digital, Technology, Design, Operations, Servicing, Legal, Risk & Control functions across the International Region
* Work hand-in-hand with Technology and Design, but you'll also be out front—engaging with Advisors and Business Management throughout the product lifecycle to make sure we're always building the right thing, the right way.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in Digital or financial services, with experience leading strategic or transformational change in wealth management, digital banking, or a related business.
* A proven innovator with an ability to think differently, reframe problems and uncover opportunities to turn emerging ideas into meaningful outcomes.
* Experience managing product delivery across multiple workstreams, balancing shifting priorities and complexities to successfully deliver new products to market.
* Experience in KPI frameworks such as OKRs or HEART to communicate measures of success.
* Excellent leadership skills – ability to guide teams and influence peers to build consensus.
* Strong understanding of different technological development methodologies (e.g., Agile) and design techniques with ability to successfully lead regardless of approach.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Organization**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward, to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we can make. Together, we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Our purpose**
: Building a brighter future for all.
  
  
**Business & Team**
As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform how we engage with customers and colleagues. This requires moving from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience, enriched and augmented by our colleagues.
  
  
The Gen AI Domain within CDAO has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group and to lead the “Transformer Banking” initiative. The domain focuses on solution practices, tools and platforms required to leverage Large Language Models safely and effectively, rather than creating foundation models.
  
  
The domain is building technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and reusable patterns and practices for Gen AI-enabled solutions across CBA.
  
  
The team enables crews across CBA to use Generative AI as part of traditional solutions in a heavily regulated environment. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain focused on customer needs, manage risk thoughtfully, and are passionate about enterprise transformation through Gen AI.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution**
As Product Owner, you will be accountable for a portfolio of Gen AI platforms and services used across CBA to solve important customer and colleague’s needs. You will deeply understand end-customer and internal-consumer needs, own the product roadmap, ensure the products meet those needs, and partner with the Group Practice Lead - Gen AI Solutions to drive customer success.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
Direct line reporting to CAL, Gen AI.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, direction and goals for the development team.
* Work with knowledge engineers, prompt engineers, platform engineers, data scientists and analysts to build reliable, resilient and adaptable Gen AI applications and deployable solutions.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, features and user stories, ensuring the development team works on the highest-value outcomes.
* Use your engineering background to understand customer needs for platforms serving internal engineers and assess the feasibility of transformative business capabilities.
* Balance business partner demands with the long-term sustainability of products and services to optimize customer experience, NPS, cost and risk outcomes.
* Partner with SRE teams, consuming service owners, controls teams and risk communities to embed risk management and platform resilience.
* Manage delivery expectations and provide clear status reporting to technology and business stakeholders.
* Own the risks, costs and benefits of platforms and services, while driving reliability, testing practices and Responsible AI.
* Help engineering squads determine which parts of fast-evolving Gen AI solutions require variability and which require stability.
* Continue learning while delivering tangible customer outcomes.
* Act as an ambassador for Gen AI transformation across the bank, sharing knowledge and supporting an open learning culture.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years of relevant experience.
* Product ownership experience delivering complex, high-profile digital capabilities, technology platforms and services.
* Strong understanding of banking workflows and customer experiences, such as dispute-management processes and orchestration of multiple workflows to execute a case.
* Engineering background in software development, data engineering or data science.
* Experience building and operating technology platforms used internally or externally within an organization.
* Experience leading engineering teams that build and scale distributed systems, tools and frameworks across public, private or hybrid cloud environments.
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to identify unmet needs and champion innovative experiences and product practices.
* Ability to drive safe and responsible Gen AI solutions by challenging technology limitations and improving systems, processes and methods.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud solution architecture, preferably AWS and Azure; exposure to services such as Amazon SageMaker or equivalent AI platforms is valuable.
* Strong software-development practices, including Git, debugging, automated testing and documentation.
* Experience or exposure to Python, TypeScript and/or C#.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Prompt engineering and non-deterministic automated testing.
* System Reliability Engineering, secure coding, and software security pipeline tools for installation, configuration, operation and monitoring.
* Customer engagement systems and workflow platforms.
* Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio.

**Good to Have**

* Understanding of machine-learning models and how generative architectures such as GANs, VAEs and Transformers are deployed at scale across cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
* Hands-on knowledge of scalable AI application patterns, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access or control planes.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with developments in AI and machine learning.

**People Capabilities**
**Customer Focus:**
Creates value in every customer interaction and considers the total customer experience.
  
  
**Team and Culture:**
Inspires others to demonstrate CBA Group values and contributes to a passionate, high-performing culture.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Continuously improves and innovates to make experience simpler for customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Effective Communication:**
Communicates clearly and with impact to build understanding, engagement and commitment to action.
  
  
**Judgement:**
Uses CBA knowledge, industry information and financial drivers to guide decisions and actions.
  
  
**Drive Results:**
Takes initiative and accountability to achieve business outcomes.
  
  
**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science.
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
  
  
We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

**1. Power Electronics Design and Development**

* Lead the design and development of power conversion products, including Online UPS, DC-DC Converters, DC-AC Inverters, Bidirectional Converters, Battery Chargers, Power Supplies, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

* Design and optimize switching power converters using Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost, Flyback, Forward, Half-Bridge, Full-Bridge, LLC Resonant, Phase-Shifted Full-Bridge, and Power Factor Correction (PFC) topologies.
* Perform component selection and design calculations for power semiconductors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC/GaN devices, magnetics, capacitors, thermal management, and protection circuits.
* Drive improvements in power density, conversion efficiency, reliability, performance, and cost.

**2. Control Systems and Digital Power Electronics**

**4. Technical and Project Leadership**

**5. Testing, Validation, and Compliance**

**6. Innovation and Technology Development**

**Preferred candidate profile**

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in power electronics design, converter topologies, control systems, magnetics, and product validation, along with the ability to lead engineering projects from concept to production

  

**Required Technical Skills**

**Core Power Electronics**

* Power Electronics Design and Development
* Online UPS Design Single Phase and Three Phase
* DC-DC Converter Design
* DC-AC Inverter Design

* Switching Power Supply (SMPS) Design

* Power Semiconductor Devices: MOSFET, IGBT, SiC, and GaN

**Control and Embedded Systems**

* Digital Power Control

**Product Development and Quality**

  

**Exposure required:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in power electronics design, electrical power conversion, or related engineering domains.
* Master's degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electrical Drives, Energy Systems, or a related specialization.
* Strong hands-on experience in the design and development of power electronic converters and associated control systems.
* Demonstrated experience in taking engineering products from concept and design through prototyping, validation, and production.
* Experience leading technical activities, engineering projects, or cross-functional product development teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales - Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Function:** Enterprise Sales / Strategic Account Management

**Market Coverage:** India & Southeast Asia (SEA)

**Experience:** 5 to 9+ Years

  

**Role Purpose:**

  

The Enterprise Sales Capital Markets (Farmer / Strategic Account Management) role will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing Azentio's existing Capital Markets customer relationships across India and Southeast Asia.

  

The role will focus on understanding each customer's business priorities, technology landscape, operational challenges, and transformation roadmap, and identifying how Azentio's broader portfolio can address those evolving needs.

  

A key expectation is to identify whitespace within existing accounts and drive incremental revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Azentio's product portfolio, while protecting existing revenue, expanding account penetration, and building long-term strategic customer relationships.

  

The successful candidate must possess strong BFSI domain expertise and proven experience in managing strategic BFSI accounts, with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth, achieving sales targets, and expanding customer relationships within this segment.

The individual should bring strong business and sales acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to identify and convert opportunities into incremental revenue. Experience in managing large enterprise accounts, driving complex sales cycles, developing C-level relationships, and positioning technology solutions across the BFSI landscape will be essential. The candidate should also be comfortable operating in a dynamic and relatively unstructured environment, taking end-to-end ownership of accounts and proactively creating new business opportunities

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Account Management & Growth**

  

* Manage a portfolio of existing Capital Markets customers across India and SEA.
* Develop comprehensive account plans covering existing products, revenue, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, whitespace, competitive presence, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Own account growth and develop clear strategies for increasing Azentio's share of wallet within strategic customers.
* Identify opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, and technology environments within existing accounts.
* Build a sustainable account-level pipeline for cross-sell, upsell, renewals, extensions, and new requirements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape within each strategic account.

  

**Understanding Customer Needs & Consultative Selling**

  

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, operational model, technology landscape, and transformation priorities.
* Engage customers proactively rather than waiting for requirements or RFPs to emerge.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to uncover new requirements.
* Understand the underlying business problem and map the appropriate Azentio products and capabilities to the customer's needs.
* Develop solution propositions and business cases aligned to customer objectives.
* Position Azentio as a strategic technology partner, rather than a single-product vendor.

  

**Portfolio Selling, Cross-Sell & Upsell**

  

* Develop a strong understanding of Azentio's broader BFSI portfolio and its relevance to Capital Markets customers.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell by connecting customer business requirements with relevant Azentio solutions.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules, licenses, users, geographies, upgrades, integrations, or transformation initiatives.
* Work with Product and Pre-Sales teams to build integrated propositions where multiple Azentio capabilities can address customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain an account-level upsell and cross-sell roadmap for key customers."

  

**Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop trusted relationships with senior business, operations, technology, procurement, and leadership stakeholders.
* Expand relationships beyond existing contacts and build multiple stakeholder connections within each account.
* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), customer reviews, and strategic account discussions to assess customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive account expansion.
* Understand stakeholder priorities, influence levels, decision-making processes, and potential relationship risks.
* Maintain strong customer engagement through regular meetings, workshops, market visits, and executive interactions.
* Act as the commercial relationship owner and customer advocate within Azentio.

  

**Renewals, Retention & Commercial Expansion**

  

* Protect and grow existing account revenue through proactive management of renewals, extensions, upgrades, and commercial opportunities.
* Engage customers ahead of renewal cycles to identify potential risks and expansion opportunities.
* Drive commercial negotiations for renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Identify competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, or relationship risks early and develop appropriate retention strategies.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customer commitments are addressed and commercial relationships remain healthy.
* Balance customer requirements with commercial quality, margins, contractual terms, and long-term account value.

  

**India & Southeast Asia Account Development**

  

* Manage and grow assigned strategic accounts across India and Southeast Asia.
* Develop an understanding of market-specific customer dynamics and business practices.
* Build strong customer relationships through regular in-person engagement.
* Candidates who bring strong market intelligence, industry insights, competitive awareness, and an understanding of emerging business opportunities across India and Southeast Asia, enabling them to identify new growth avenues and add strategic value to Azentio's business, will have an advantage
* Travel extensively across India and Southeast Asia based on customer and business requirements.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Collaborate closely with Pre-Sales, Product Management, Delivery, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Leadership.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, solution workshops, customer presentations, RFP/RFI responses, and commercial proposals.
* Work closely with Delivery and Customer Success teams to understand ongoing projects and identify potential account opportunities or risks.
* Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product teams.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent approach to strategic customers. Salesforce Hygiene, Pipeline Management & Sales Governance

  

The candidate should be expected to:

  

* Maintain the highest standards of Salesforce (SFDC) hygiene, ensuring timely and accurate updates of account information, sales opportunities, deal values, pipeline stages, probability, expected closure dates, and customer engagement activities.
* Maintain a healthy and actionable sales pipeline, with clear visibility into opportunity progression, next steps, dependencies, potential risks, and closure plans.
* Consistently adopt and apply the MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology across strategic opportunities to ensure structured opportunity assessment and deal governance.
* Maintain accurate and realistic revenue forecasts, booking projections, and closure estimates.
* Participate in mandatory weekly sales review calls with management, providing updates on pipeline movement, opportunity progression, MEDDPICC qualification status, revenue outlook, challenges, and action plans.
* Take complete ownership

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS

**Department:** Learning & Development

**Location:** Pune

**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications

(BCA/MCA)

  

**1. Job Purpose**

The Jr. Software Support Engineer will support the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and operational

functioning of the organisations LMS. The role includes managing user accounts and course assignments,

maintaining accurate reports, preparing and uploading digital learning content, conducting learning platform testing,

supporting system enhancements and migration activities, and resolving platform-related queries from trainers and

other stakeholders.

  

The role requires attention to detail, technical troubleshooting skills, data accuracy, and effective coordination with

internal teams to ensure reliable platform operations and continuous improvement.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Learning Platform Administration and Operational Support**

* Create and maintain user accounts, ensuring accurate user profiles, roles, locations, and project mappings.
* Manage course enrolments, programme assignments, user deactivations, and other learning platform

administrative activities.

* Monitor platform activities and screenshots as per the defined schedule.
* Track and resolve platform access and assignment-related issues within established timelines.
* Maintain records of platform activities and conduct periodic operational compliance checks.
* Ensure accurate batch and programme mapping across the platform.

**B. Reporting and Data Management**

* Extract, validate, consolidate, and maintain platform data for operational and management reporting.
* Prepare and submit weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports within defined timelines.
* Maintain trackers for user accounts, course assignments, enrolments, completions, and other platform activities.
* Verify report accuracy against source data and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain appropriate report version control and documentation.
* Provide timely and accurate data to support internal reviews and management decisions.

**C. Digital Content Development and Assessment Management**

* Convert and upload learning content in SCORM-compatible formats, where required.
* Create quizzes, assessments, and question banks aligned with course learning objectives.
* Map assessments to relevant courses and configure scoring, pass/fail criteria, and completion triggers.
* Test uploaded content for compatibility, functionality, and playback before publishing.
* Incorporate feedback and content revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain content quality standards and ensure accurate course configuration.

**D. Quality Assurance and Learning Platform Testing**

* Prepare and execute test cases for learning platform releases, updates, and enhancements.
* Identify, document, and report software defects, errors, and functional issues.
* Conduct retesting after bug fixes and validate enhancements before deployment.
* Perform regression testing to confirm that existing platform functionalities continue to work as expected.
* Validate data migration, including user records, course completions, and assessment scores, where applicable.
* Maintain test documentation, defect trackers, and quality assurance reports.
* Coordinate with developers and relevant stakeholders to support issue resolution and platform stability.

**E. Stakeholder Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical and operational support to trainers and internal stakeholders for learning platform-related

queries.

* Troubleshoot user access, course assignment, assessment, and platform usage issues.
* Maintain a query tracker documenting issue details, status, resolution, and closure.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate team and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
* Guide trainers on platform processes and the correct use of learning tools.
* Participate in mandatory internal training and undertake regular technical upskilling.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform processes, documentation, reporting, and user experience.

**F. Skills and Competencies Required**

* Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Basic understanding of SCORM content, e-learning modules, and online assessments.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to conduct functional testing, document defects, and validate fixes.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and quality assurance practices.

make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are part of your success here. Learn more about our diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces, obtaining the resources they need to thrive, and sharing the messages they are passionate about.   
   
ZS’s Digital and Technology group focuses on driving end to end Digital Transformation that includes Digital Strategy, Human centered Design, exploiting emerging technologies, and purposeful change management to improve customer and company results. The types of solutions include Digital Strategy and Advisory services, end to end Transformation Management, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI, Intelligent Automation, reimagining business processes with digital first lens and building Digital Products, Solutions and Digital Platforms leveraging Big Data Technologies, AI/ML and Advance Analytics, Digital Platform configuration and integrations. We provide a complete spectrum of technology solutions, from strategy and roadmap definition to full scale implementation and on-going operations. Our team possesses deep expertise in leading digital transformation, enterprise data analytic and AI, Data science and advanced analytics and building end to end digital.   
  
   
  
**Manager- Enterprise Architect in Tech and Cloud Advisory**     
  
ZS's Technology Advisory Group ensures our future information, technology and architectural landscape is built to plan and evolve as our business grows, striving to balance future-proofing our end-to-end technology stack while accelerating the speed of innovation and streamlining the delivery of business capability.- This role will be responsible for supporting the growth and development of our Technology Advisory Practice within the ZS Technology Services business.   
    
     
    
  The successful candidate will work closely with ZS practice leadership and be responsible for evolving our practice, enriching our practice assets and collaterals, building, and managing client relationships, generating new business engagements, and providing thought leadership in the Technology and Architecture Area.   
    
  **What You’ll Do**

- Drive technical architecture and design discussions with internal and client groups to brainstorm and finalize technology solutions
- Collaborate with the Architecture & Engineering expertise centre leadership to define technology roadmap and work with delivery team to put together a plan for technical implementation with and stay on track
- Stay current on latest technology trends and architecture patterns, and lead the effort to develop ZS POV for strategic decision-making

- Groom junior team members and maintain a culture of rapid learning and explorations to drive innovations / POCs on emerging technologies and architecture patterns

jobs.title: Sales Support Representative
jobs.description:
The Sales Support Representative (SSR) delivers prompt transactional support to Account Executives (AE) and Area Sales Directors (ASD) by preparing quotes, cost proposals, pilot orders, drop shipments, and implementations via a CRM system. The SSR handles transactional tasks so AEs and ASDs can concentrate on selling and building relationships, driving revenue and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cost Proposals/Quotes**
  + Create and assist with cost proposals and quotes using the Salesforce (CRM) within the established service level agreement (SLA) timeframe.
  + Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with approval workflows with each quote.
  + Generate standard and customized quote documents for customers.
* **Implementation/Gratis, Sample Orders, and Pilots**
  + Process, monitor, and track implementation/gratis requests based on established guidelines by product, Line of Business (LoB), or unique conditions.
  + Submit and track sample orders. Provide detailed information for custom shipments and labeling.
  + Execute pilot orders following the established guidelines and directions from the HMH Pilot team.
* **Sales Operations**
  + Handle inbound requests for quotes, samples, implementation/gratis, etc., from AE and ASD teams.
  + Research product availability, pricing, and tracking information.
  + Escalate issues to management when necessary.
* **Systems Tools**
  + Develop and maintain working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP, Sales Hub, and Customer Care platforms.
  + Perform daily sales transactions via SFDC and maintain organized records of sales activities.
* **Collaboration Communication**
  + Liaise with sales support team members and internal departments to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  + Participate in process improvement initiatives and team meetings.
  + Provide clear, concise, and frequent updates related to transaction status with Sales Support manager(s), AEs, ASDs, etc.

**Core Competencies**

* **Adaptability** Maintain effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment, adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, or requirements.
* **Navigating Complexity** Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues; responding effectively to complex and ambiguous situations; communicating complicated information simply.
* **Communication** Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that helps them understand and retain the message.
* **Continuous Improvement** Originating action to improve existing conditions and processes; identifying improvement opportunities, generating ideas, and implementing solutions.
* **Time Management** Effectively manages one's time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
* **Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills** Having achieved a satisfactory level of technical and professional skill or knowledge in position-related areas; keeping up with current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** AA/BS/BA degree
* **Experience:** 3-5 years sales support experience required.
* **Skills:**
  + Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel).
  + Experience with Salesforce and SAP, NetSuite is a plus.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stationary position for a considerable time (sitting and/or standing).
* Constantly operates a computer
* Must be able to collaborate with colleagues via face-to-face, email, Teams, conference calls, and online meetings.

jobs.title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**  
  
  
To ideate create suitable interactions designs for various requirements for the assigned products. Work with internal domain experts like CX Analysts, UX Writers UX POs to create creative and user-friendly visual solutions. Give feedback to designs coming in from the satellite design teams sitting with the COE teams. Work with the testing team to try out new designs and create new industry benchmarks using data-based designs.  
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities**  
  
  
1.Creating inspirational kickass visual designs keeping our design language in mind as a base template  
2.Making sure your creations look good on all screen sizes with an understanding of responsive scaling and grid structures  
3.To be able to make stunning designs, you need an awareness of Colors, Typography, Layout composition, spacing, materials textures and a great aesthetic sense  
4.Adding micro interactions to your concepts can help launch them over the line  
5.Knowing the limitations that our tech team works with, will help your designs go all the way much faster.  
6.Theres a lot of great stuff happening out there everyday! Keeping up to date with it will help you stay on the top of your game.  
7.To be a project/track owner, you need to be decisive and good at absorbing critical feedback.  
8.You will need help to achieve your targets, and for that you need to be able to scout, rear, manage and guide vendor teams.  
9.You will help your team meet their potential by planning their Goals and KRAs to keep everyone on their sharp and ever ready.  
10.Evolving, upgrading and maintaining a design system is a very important part of both a Design ecosystem, and your responsibilities  
11.Understanding the business landscape, goals and the design requirements associated with it  
12.Understanding the customer behavior, needs and challenges faced by them  
13.Benchmarking online journeys with competitors and define best user experience for our product  
14.Mapping business requirements to design solutions  
15.Documenting requirements received via user stories or stakeholder meetings  
16.Planning and prioritizing for multiple ongoing requirements  
17.Managing stakeholders and their expectations from time to time  
  
  
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**  
  
  
1.Decisions regarding planning of individual bandwidth and task prioritization  
2.Decisions on design solutioning for requirements  
3.Decisions regarding user experience journey  
4.Decisions on visual and usability options for requirement  
  
  
**Major Challenges**  
  
  
1.Cross functional teams not responding on time thus impacting project delivery deadline  
2.Frequent changes in requirements, leading to rework  
3.Ad-hoc requirements from different stakeholders impacting planned tasks  
  
  
**Required Qualifications and Experience**  
  
  
Qualifications   
- B.Des/M.des from a recognized design school or equivalent practical experience in visual/digital designing and frontend development
- Or 4-5 years of experience working as a Visual/Interaction Designer.  
  Work Experience
- 3-4 years of experience working as a Visual/Interaction Designer. The main focus of the experience should have been on Visuals, Interactions, Aesthetics Usability.
- Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary UX/Product teams (motion, interaction, UX research, etc.) on technical implementation
- Experience implementing visual design systems across platforms in a software development environment
- Preference given to candidates who have worked at tech firms and in large corporate format environments

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

  

You will work in a highly collaborative environment with colleagues from globally diverse backgrounds and skillsets coming together to solve challenging problems as a team. The position is within our Trade and Transfer Assets stream closely collaborating with the part of Agile delivery units distributed across the globe. Our teams design, deliver and operate state-of-the-art financial systems that offer best-in-class services to the bank's clients. We are genuine believers that diversity brings more varied experience, expertise, and working methods to improve the way we engineer and deliver solutions. We are looking for a DevOps with Azure engineer who is passionate and ready to develop the state of art technology solutions for their digital platforms. This job will have a variety of challenges on a daily basis, where you will need to understand the business needs and based on your creative thinking-ways, you will develop and design solutions in Azure with Kafka and DevOps capabilities. You will implement them according to the DevOps practices. This job is for someone who is excited and happy to work with cutting edge technologies and really motivated to work with large amounts of complex cloud-based data.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

  
* Our team is undertaking an ambitious programme of wholesale platform renewal product evolution underpinned by genuine digitalisation. We are looking for a talented engineer to act as a technical expert for our fledgling team in Pune, India. If you are motivated to build our next-generation Post-Trade Custody ecosystem based on services and integration in modern programming paradigms, we look forward to receiving your application.
  

  

**Skills**

  

Must have

  

  
* To apply for this job as an Azure Cloud Developer with Kafka, you should bring:
  
* 8+ years of experience as DevOps
  
* Significant experience in designing and developing Azure (with Kubernetes) solutions
  
* Strong knowledge and experience working with Kafka, Ansible, Gitlab
  
* Comfortable working with large amounts of data
  
* Knowledge of technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  
* DevOps skills are also essential
  
* Good Postgres DB knowledge
  
* Microsoft Azure expertise and certification is a plus
  
* Your profile may also show the above and beyond elements such as:
  
* A positive attitude willingness to learn desire to improve the environment around you
  
* Knowledge of virtualization and containerization
  
* Track record as an engineer working in a globally distributed team
  
* On-the-job examples of working in a fast-paced Agile environment
  
* Our Stack
  
* CI/CD: GitLab
  
* Cloud: Azure
  
* Platform: Linux, Windows, Mainframe
  
* Configuration management: Ansible
  
* Scripts: Bash
  
* Programming languages: Java, .NET, Kafka, Kotlin
  
* Container-based architecture and deployments (Kubernetes)
  
* DB: Postgres
  

  

Nice to have

  

  
* Ability to communicate to different seniority levels
  
* Motivated to go the extra mile
  

  

**Other**

  

  
* Languages: English: C1 Advanced
  
* Seniority: Senior

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager.

* Lead complex initiatives including establishing marketing programs for new products or enhancements
* Conduct market research and market results-oriented analysis for major products and services
* Review and analyze complex major product lines and services
* Implement change delivery solutions for the portfolio's technology process work of low to moderate complexity
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations of global market dynamics, trends, and regulatory impact

jobs.description:
**Please Update Job Description To Reflect Associate Pm**
Position Summary
  
  
**Assist in shaping the individual product requirements in support of an existing product strategy. Accountable for assisting in driving the full product lifecycle from ideation to end-to-end of life. Responsible for relevant, specific product feature requirements. Ensuring that user personas & product requirements are defined and reflected in user stories. Working with the Scrum team on backlog grooming. Prioritising and Managing dependencies.**
**Supervision and Autonomy**

* Conducts tasks & assignments as directed.
* Operates with moderate supervision, little instruction on routine work; detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. Latitude for independent judgment for defined tasks.
* Uses existing procedures to complete diverse assignments

**Product Knowledge**

* Develops competence by completing structured work assignments
* Expands knowledge about industry, customers, org. to capture internal/external requirements.

**Position Responsibilities & Essential Function**

* Assist in shaping the individual product requirements in support of an existing product strategy.
* Accountable for assisting in driving the full product lifecycle from ideation to end-to-end of life. Responsible for relevant, specific product feature requirements. Limited interaction with net new products.
* Ensures that user personas & product requirements are defined and reflected in user stories. May also own and/or assist in Epic development.
* Works with the Scrum team on backlog grooming and ensures timely decision making on product requirement trade-offs.
* Translates defined product vision & Features (Epics) into user stories (based on feedback from dealers/customers & analysis of user & buyer personas) to deliver differentiated customer outcomes.
* Manages the backlog for scrum teams, partnering with R&D/scrum master to prioritise and plan product backlog, supporting full lifecycle from definition, beta, showcase, & retrospective.
* Works with other CDK product managers and product marketing to articulate the value proposition for user stories & Features (Epics). Owns dependency management.
* Understands the key product success metrics (e.g. adoption, profitability, NPS, market share growth) & how they relate to user stories/Features (Epics).
* Invests in gaining functional expertise & SME through training, partnering with more experienced CDK product managers.
* Develops & prioritizes user stories based on user/market requirements, strategy & business plan.

**Qualifications**
**Preferred:**

* Knowledge of Payments is preferred

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience
* 5+ years of Product Management and/or equivalent experience in Enterprise SaaS, full lifecycle management.
* Experience in Agile software/DevOps methodologies & working with globally distributed teams.
* Experience in creating user stories, working with R&D & other product managers to drive end-to-end execution of product releases.
* Strong written & verbal communication skills. Experience is facilitating customer communications.
* Ability to listen & consider the points of view of others, collaborate & build consensus with cross-functional areas.
* Strong technical aptitude, can work with R&D to translate business requirements into actionable user stories.
* Strong track record of product execution in dynamic environment.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

More about

and

.

You’ll help us build the next generation of systems that help us run multi region, scalable processes to identify customers who they say they are and ensure any processes minimise the chance of financial crime manifesting throughout a customers lifecycle. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

As an Associate Product Manager at Alacriti, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and development of our cloud-native money movement and payments platform. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, performant, and developer-friendly payment solutions that delight users and accelerate digital transformation for our financial clients. We are seeking candidates with 3+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of owning platform, API, or developer-facing products end-to-end.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop the long-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
* Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
* Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end-users
* Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency
* Use metrics to inform point of view and leverage analytics to measure success
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, adoption and margins
* Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility
* Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform-level problems

**Who you are**

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

* You are a product builder who can move easily between a user’s hardest problem, the business opportunity behind it, and the product decisions needed to solve it.
* You have worked on technically complex products - such as APIs, developer tools, shared platform capabilities, or core product experiences - but you do not build tech/platform for its own sake. You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.
* You are opinionated, thoughtful, and execution-oriented. You can focus a team on the few decisions that matter most, create momentum in ambiguous situations, and ship products that raise the bar for both quality and impact.

Key Requirements

* **Product Management Experience:**
  3+ years of experience in Product Management, with end-to-end ownership of platform, API, or developer-facing products.
* **Product Strategy and Execution:**
  Demonstrated experience in roadmap development, feature prioritization, product delivery, and outcome measurement.
* **Payments and FinTech Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of payment processing, money movement, transaction flows, payment ecosystems, or financial technology products.
* **Technical Product Understanding:**
  Ability to work with APIs, platform capabilities, technical requirements, and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* **Data-Driven Decision-Making:**
  Experience defining product success metrics, analyzing performance data, and measuring business impact.
* **Customer-Centric Mindset:**
  Strong problem-discovery skills and the ability to translate user needs into effective product solutions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and external partners.
* **Business Acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, customer value, revenue opportunities, and complex platform-level challenges.
* **Go-to-Market Collaboration:**
  Experience working with Sales and Marketing teams on product launches, positioning, enablement, and adoption.
* **Execution and Ownership:**
  Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Education:**
  B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **Domain Experience:**
  Prior experience in payments, FinTech, banking technology, or financial infrastructure is an advantage.
* **Platform Product Experience:**
  Experience converting customized or client-specific solutions into scalable, reusable product capabilities.
* **API and Developer Products:**
  Experience building or managing API-first products, developer-facing platforms, or technical integrations.
* **Strategic Product Thinking:**
  Ability to anticipate future customer needs and make well-judged foundational product investments.
* **Experimentation and Analytics:**
  Experience with product experiments, holdback tests, performance measurement, and data-driven optimization.

In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. * Proven ability to effectively manage competing priorities and to work well under pressure in a team environment.
* High level of discretion and awareness of accountability.
* Analytical skills and interest in developing problem-solving capabilities.

The role focuses on delivering a seamless customer experience within agreed service timelines while maintaining high-quality output and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru

Flexible Shifts

---------------------------------

* Managing the issuance and processing of Bank Guarantees (BGs) and Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
* Delivering exceptional customer service by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to resolve queries and drive positive customer outcomes.

**Req ID:** 393722
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Go-to-Market Asset Experience Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
AI Go-to-Market Asset Experience Manager
  
**Organization:** Global AI Go-to-Market | Role Type: Individual Contributor
  
About the Role
  
NTT DATA is looking for someone to own the digital assets our global AI Go-to-Market organization runs on: the AI demo catalog ("Periodic Table"), software demonstrations, sales and solution presentations, client-ready materials, and enablement content.
  
The job blends digital asset management, content operations, product ownership, and hands-on prototyping. You'll keep the library current and trustworthy, and you'll keep looking for better ways to organize, surface, and reuse this content across SharePoint, Lighthouse, internal portals, and AI-powered knowledge experiences. When the existing tools fall short, you build something lightweight yourself.
  
What You'll Own
  
The AI GTM asset library. Manage the full lifecycle — intake, tagging, review, publication, versioning, ownership, refresh, and retirement — across demos, presentations, use-case and industry materials, videos, architecture artifacts, seller enablement, and reusable pursuit content. Keep what's published accurate, discoverable, and reusable by sellers, solution teams, and delivery organizations globally.
  
The Periodic Table / demo portfolio. Serve as operational owner. Work with demo owners and engineering teams to capture new capabilities; make sure each demo has solid descriptions, screenshots, video, architecture detail, use cases, and sales material; retire what's duplicate, outdated, or unsupported; track ownership; improve taxonomy and navigation; watch usage to find the high-value demos. Push it from a static catalog toward a real AI solution discovery and enablement experience.
  
The content experience. Prototype and improve how assets reach internal users — search, navigation, discovery, personalization, recommendations, metadata generation, summarization, and publishing workflows — using SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Lighthouse, custom portals, search and knowledge-management technology, and conversational interfaces.
  
AI-assisted operations. Use Enterprise ChatGPT and other approved platforms to generate summaries and metadata, recommend taxonomy, spot duplicates, translate technical content into seller language, extract information from decks and documents, and support quality reviews. Automate the repetitive parts while keeping governance and human oversight intact.
  
Governance and stakeholders. Work across AI GTM leadership, offering teams, Forward Deployed Engineering, solution architects, industry teams, marketing, sales, engineering, and alliance partners. Establish clear asset ownership and quality standards through processes light enough that people actually follow them.
  
What You'll Need
  
5+ years across some combination of digital content platforms, knowledge management, web application development, product management, sales enablement technology, digital asset management, or software engineering
  
A track record of bringing order to a large, fast-moving collection of digital assets
  
Hands-on experience with generative AI assistants and LLMs, plus the instinct to experiment and prototype independently
  
Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, React or similar, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and Python or Node.js — enough to prototype ideas and integrate systems, not to work as a full-time engineer
  
Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Azure, plus Git and standard development practices
  
**Strong writing:** turning complex technical detail into clear, concise content
  
Comfort with both business and technical stakeholders, operating with limited supervision in a global, matrixed organization
  
**Nice to have:** enterprise sales, consulting, solution engineering, or GTM support experience; ownership of a demo environment, solution catalog, developer portal, or digital marketplace; semantic or vector search, RAG, or AI-powered knowledge management; Azure AI, OpenAI APIs, or comparable LLM platforms; metadata, taxonomy, information architecture, and enterprise search; internal web apps and content portals; content analytics; technology consulting or large global professional services.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
Sellers find the right asset fast. Demos have owners and stay current. New assets get added quickly and consistently. Duplicate and outdated content shrinks. The Periodic Table becomes the trusted entry point for discovering NTT DATA's AI capabilities. AI handles more of the ingestion, classification, search, and discovery work. And the organization can see which assets get used — and where the gaps are.
  
The Profile
  
This one is unusual by design. You may have started as a developer, solution engineer, digital experience specialist, knowledge-management professional, or technical product manager — but you enjoy organizing technology as much as building it. In a given week you might restructure a SharePoint information architecture, sit with an engineering team on a new demo, generate metadata with Enterprise ChatGPT, prototype a search experience, review a sales deck, and help a seller find the right demonstration for tomorrow's client meeting.
  
**Above all:** curious, highly organized, technically capable, and motivated by making complex information easier for others to find and use.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. Client Revenue Operations (CRO) is part of the GSAM which is at the heart of the Goldman Sachs Asset Management (GSAM) funds and separate accounts business. CRO covers a range of activities that allows team members to interact with a number of other internal teams as well as external teams, vendors, and industry experts. As such, this role will allow the candidate to gain broad exposure to the workings of the GSAM business, as well as detailed understanding of Client Revenue Operations.

CRO is responsible for all revenue related activities including different types of fees receivables as we as payables within GSAM Funds and Institutional Separate account business.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

The role entails working in the institutional space of the CRO team. The team performs the following key functions;

Institutional Billing Oversight:

* Review fee schedules and IMA agreements for clients to optimize efficient client invoicing solutions.
* Implementation and generation of client management fee invoices per the client requirements and fee schedules
* Dispatching of invoices and accounting the receivables and managing of general ledgers
* Constant focus on building enhancements and efficiencies within invoicing workflows and systems

The following items are applicable to the oversight role;

* Ongoing review and maintenance of internal policies and procedures with a view to increasing automation, scalability, and outsourcing of tasks to billing process with appropriate controls and cost efficiencies.
* Co-ordination of new clients and set-up on internal and vendor systems and platforms, working closely with Client relationship manager, sales and business side
* Ensure accurate calculation and processing of invoices in accordance with client and company policies.
* Conduct rigorous verification of fee calculations to identify and rectify any discrepancies or errors before invoice processing.
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of invoices to clients
* Skillfully match incoming payments to the corresponding internal General Ledger (GL) entries, ensuring accurate and up-to-date financial records.
* Maintain detailed records and documentation of fee calculations, ensuring transparency and auditability.
* Continuously identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancements within the rebate and trailer fee calculation function
* Provision of management/board reporting, and information for ad-hoc management requests.

The candidate will be required to work with senior members of the division and cover both day to day and project related tasks relevant to the activities mentioned in the summary above.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4+ year of experience in similar industry, specifically within Revenue functions
* Knowledge of financial instruments, investment products, and industry regulations.
* Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
* Strong problem-solving abilities.
* Exposure to project-based work, especially with thinking through and delivering policy and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of Receivables and payables function/workings
* Knowledge of Separate accounts and offshore mutual fund transfer agent operations, processing, and compliance standards
* Knowledge of multi-currency domestic/cross border payments
* Experience in the banking/asset management industry.

* Experience on PG version – PG 12, PG 13, PG 14 & PG 15
* Excellent knowledge of PG RDBMS (all versions) architecture & design.

* Experience in Backup and Recovery using PG\_DUMP and PG\_DUMPALL
* Experience in setting up WAL archiving, Point in Time Recovery

* Good understanding of configuration files such as Pg\_hba.Conf, Postgresql.Conf (with knowledge on Parameter values)

* Proficient in troubleshooting & solving complex performance problems.
* Proficient in managing Patching, Upgrades & Migrations.
* Proficient in monitoring & performance analysis through open source tools
* Experience in handling Disaster Recovery tests & exercises.
* Certifications and experience of managing RDS for PostgreSQL on AWS
* Experience in working on a large-scale environment (at least 1000 + databases with bigger sizes).
* Working experience in banking domain (preferred).

* Exceptional coordination, communication and interpersonal skills to work across global teams and clients.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, diagnose and assess problems; work with global stakeholders to derive tactical and long-term solutions as appropriate.
* Demonstrable crisis management skills in a large, globally distributed environment.
* Experience working with or in an automated operation environment
* Experience managing operations on core & cloud-based infra environments – ‘AaS platform’ experience ideal.

* Certifications and experience of managing RDS for PostgreSQL on AWS
* Hands-on experience of using tools/extensions – REPMGR, PGBACKREST, pg\_repack, pg\_crypto, pg\_audit, Data Wrapper, pg\_bouncer
* Good understanding of configuration files such as Pg\_hba.Conf, Postgresql.Conf.
