jobs.description:
Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Growth tribe. Dubai is preferred for its closeness to the Product and Engineering teams. Remote, or hybrid from the group's other offices, will be considered for a strong profile.

**The Role**

This is a product leadership role, not simply a more senior Product Manager title. You'll own the Growth tribe, covering Onboarding and Payments, line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers and report directly to the VP of Product.

The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.

**What You'll Do**

jobs.description:
**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Lev Novak
  
  
**Description**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager located (or ready for relocation) in the UAE to lead the development and growth of our P2P and local transfer products in Tabby Cash. Since our vision is to become a financial service for daily use, we need a passionate, driven individual to make sending money to friends and family a daily habit for millions of Tabby customers.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
* Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
* Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).
  
  
If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to lead the development and continuous improvement of client registration, authentication and onboarding journeys across our CFD and Crypto products.

You will own the end-to-end onboarding experience, from initial registration and account creation to identity verification, compliance approval and client activation. Your objective is to deliver seamless, secure, compliant and conversion-driven onboarding across web and mobile, while supporting multiple regulatory jurisdictions, products and business requirements.

This is a hands-on role requiring close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Risk, Operations and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and strategy**

* Own the backlog and roadmap for registration, authentication and onboarding across CFD and Crypto platforms
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and business rules
* Prioritize by business impact, regulatory requirements, customer experience and technical dependencies
* Manage the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through development, testing, release and optimization
* Ensure a consistent onboarding experience across web and mobile, while meeting product-specific requirements

**Client registration and authentication**

* Own registration and sign-in journeys: email, password, social authentication, OTP verification and account recovery
* Define requirements for session management, device management, authentication security and fraud prevention
* Optimize registration flows to minimize friction and abandonment while keeping appropriate security controls
* Manage account creation logic, duplicate account detection and client eligibility checks
* Support multiple brands, products and regulatory entities

**Client onboarding and verification**

* Design and optimize onboarding for retail clients and, where applicable, professional and corporate clients
* Own KYC requirements: identity verification, document collection, liveness checks and address verification
* Define onboarding questionnaires, suitability or appropriateness assessments, risk profiling and client declarations
* Manage onboarding statuses, rejection and resubmission scenarios, manual reviews and exception handling
* Coordinate integrations with third-party identity verification, KYC/AML and fraud prevention providers
* Communicate onboarding progress and next steps clearly to clients

**Regulatory and compliance integration**

* Work with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product functionality
* Support jurisdiction-specific requirements, including eligibility, regulatory entity assignment and disclosures
* Implement CFD- and Crypto-specific onboarding requirements
* Support AML, sanctions screening, PEP screening and enhanced due diligence workflows
* Ensure proper consent collection, data protection, audit trails and regulatory recordkeeping
* Coordinate regulatory changes and implement them on time across platforms

**Client experience and conversion optimization**

* Analyze onboarding funnels to identify friction points, drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Optimize registration completion, KYC approval and client activation rates
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers on intuitive, accessible onboarding experiences
* Define and monitor onboarding KPIs, dashboards and operational performance metrics
* Run experiments and evaluate improvements using quantitative and qualitative data
* Balance conversion optimization with regulatory compliance and risk management

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 4+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, preferably in FinTech, online brokerage, Crypto, banking or other regulated financial services
* Experience owning digital registration, authentication, KYC or client onboarding products
* Understanding of CFD brokerage and/or Crypto trading products and their onboarding requirements
* Familiarity with KYC, AML, sanctions screening, client classification and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements
* Experience integrating third-party services and working with APIs
* Strong understanding of web and mobile product development
* Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into clear technical specifications and user stories
* Experience in Agile environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills
* Excellent written and spoken English

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience testing digital retail account opening journeys, parent-child relationship linking, KYC/AML validations, and minor banking compliance rules across mobile banking apps and core banking systems.

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. jobs.description:
**Key Accountabilities**

* Audit planning and governance
  + Establish and maintain the Internal Audit Charter, audit methodology and risk-based annual audit plan for Board/Audit Committee approval.
  + Maintain an audit universe covering all licensed activities, corporate functions, systems and material third-party arrangements.
  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.
  + Identify resource and specialist requirements, including technology, cybersecurity and financial crime expertise.
* Operational and regulatory assurance
  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.
  + Assess customer fund safeguarding, float management, reconciliations, liquidity, applicable capital and guarantee requirements, and regulatory reporting.
  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.
  + Review consumer protection, customer disclosures, complaints handling, fraud controls and compliance with licence conditions.
  + Assess technology governance, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, outsourcing, business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Partner products and distribution
  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.
  + Review partner due diligence, contractual responsibilities, regulatory permissions, service standards, audit rights and ongoing oversight.
  + Assess customer journeys, disclosures, consent, fees, commissions, complaints ownership and escalation arrangements.
  + Examine controls over relevant money flows, including loan disbursements and repayments, investment subscriptions and withdrawals, and insurance premiums and refunds.
  + Evaluate whether du Pay’s activities remain within its permitted role and whether responsibilities between du Pay and each partner are clearly allocated.
  + Provide independent observations on material launches and changes without assuming management responsibility for product approval or control design.
* Reporting and remediation

  + Present significant findings and emerging risks to the Board/Audit Committee and management.

  + Escalate overdue material issues, restrictions on audit access and threats to independence.
  + Support regulatory examinations and external audits with appropriate evidence and coordination.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

**Description**

At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Private sector financial development is essential to the promotion of successful and sustainable economies in low- and middle-income countries around the world. Infrastructure plays a key role in sustained economic growth by providing critical public services to the citizens in a country as well as a platform for efficient operation of businesses that create jobs. The private sector plays an increasingly important role in the financing and delivery of infrastructure and public services, including through Corporate Finance Services.

IFC’s transaction advisory services department (CTA) is housed in the World Bank Group’s Client’s and Products Vice Presidency (CCPVP) and consists of two business lines:

* PPP Transaction Advisory (C3P) offers transaction advisory services to governments design, structure PPP transactions in infrastructure to help client governments partner with the private sector to deliver affordable and high-quality infrastructure.
* Corporate Finance Services (CFS) has three key product offerings: (1) M&A Advisory: supporting investment departments in business development and creating investment opportunities; (2) Equity Mobilization Program (EMP): supporting third party equity mobilization alongside IFC investment; (3) Asset monetization involving listed or listing public entities.

CTA has mobilized $6.6B for FY25 which translates into around 17% of IFC’s total core mobilization, of which CFS mobilized over $1.5B of this amount. The department is expected to continue playing a leading role in mobilizing private capital for the WBG.

CFS is seeking a (Senior) Investment Officer with strong M&A experience to help support the execution of our business strategy in the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia Region. The position will be based in Dubai, UAE and will report to the Global Manager, CFS. The (Senior) Investment Officer will support the CFS regional teams with global capacity, with the objective of facilitating business development and executing transactions

**Duties and accountabilities:**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of CFS’s strategy, working closely with regional and World Bank Group teams to advance business priorities and support delivery against WBG strategic objectives, with a particular focus on the MCA region.
* Collaborating with regional leads to originate, structure, and execute EMP and M&A advisory mandates across the MCA region, including buy-side and sell-side transactions, restructuring advisory, and EMP services.
* Lead the origination and execution of strategic pre-IPO advisory mandates across the five regions, working closely with relevant regional, industry, and advisory teams.
* Advise clients on listing readiness, process, timing, and regulatory considerations, including the assessment of corporate and balance sheet structures, valuation and business plans; development of listing roadmaps and timetables; broker selection and prospectus review; preparation of management teams and Boards for listing; and coordination with relevant corporate governance advisory teams, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and industry counterparts, identifying opportunities for collaboration that strengthen business development, enhance transaction delivery, and support IFC’s corporate and regional objectives.
* Develop and manage strong client relationships, working closely with multi-regional clients and relevant IFC teams to develop transaction strategies and provide advice on bankability, funding feasibility, financial modeling, business planning, and restructuring.
* Provide senior-level oversight and guidance on the preparation of key transaction materials and project documentation, including transaction marketing materials, information memoranda, due diligence and transaction structuring reports, and transaction contracts and agreements, ensuring high-quality analytical and transaction outputs.
* Mentor and support junior colleagues, providing guidance on transaction execution, client engagement, and business development, and helping strengthen team capabilities and delivery against business objectives.
* Contribute to strengthening IFC’s positioning and visibility in the CFS space, leveraging IFC’s regional presence, client relationships, and broader communications strategy to support market development and business origination.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or another relevant field, with at least 8 years of relevant professional experience, preferably 12 or more years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance, M&A advisory, or other relevant areas.
* Seasoned in equity transactions, as a principal investor, an advisor, or underwriter, including in an investment bank, VC, PE type institution.
* Transaction advisory experience in buy side mandates, sell side mandates, restructuring mandates, preferably in the disruptive technology space.
* Track record of delivering targeted results on M&A, Restructuring and IPO mandates under stressful timetables and environment.
* Proven success in developing strong client relationships and executing mandates across-borders and in difficult environments.
* Experience taking companies public on major international stock exchanges such as the New York stock exchange, London Stock exchange etc, is plus.
* Strong track record of business delivery, demonstrated investment experience, superior business judgment and established professional credibility.
* Excellent team player and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a dispersed team in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with superior facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills. English is mandatory, and Arabic and/or Russian would be an asset
* Ability to represent IFC externally and to develop and manage relationships with clients, media, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to use commercially available LLM tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot for research, analysis, and drafting in investment, validate outputs against primary sources, and remain accountable for recommendations
* Commitment to development and alignment with the World Bank Group and IFC's mission, strategy, and values.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

* Relevant experience in business management, financial analysis or business support within banking or financial services.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
  
  
We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
  
  
If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
* Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
* Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
* Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
* Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
* Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You:**

* Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
* 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
* A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
* A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
* Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
* Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
* Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

**Good to have :**

* Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
* Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

**Hiring Process:**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bengaluru**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

The Product Design team at Navi creates clear, intuitive experiences that put users first. We work end to end across research, interaction, and visual design to shape products that are simple, fast, and purposeful. Our approach is deeply data-driven, combining user insights and product analytics to continuously refine and improve the user experience.

**About the Role**

Navi is seeking a Senior Manager - Design to lead and scale our growing design team. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is not just an expert in design, but an expert in building a team that is "ruthless" in its approach to problem-solving. Your core responsibility will be to lead a team of talented designers who are experts in taste, data, and problem-solving, and who act as a force for alignment across the company. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture of relentless pursuit of excellence and pushing for an incredibly high bar for what we ship. You will be responsible for the overall success and strategy of the design function, from defining the "why" to ensuring a high-quality outcome. The ideal candidate has a strong backbone to take a stand for what is right for the customer and the company , but also has a humble heart to listen and learn.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Strategic Leadership:**

○ Partner with senior leadership (Product, Engineering, Business) to define the design vision and strategy for all charters, aligning with company goals and product principles.

○ Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring the team starts with the customer's pain and obsesses over making their lives better.

○ Drive a culture of ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team is focused on doing fewer things, but better.

○ Seek clarity relentlessly to unblock your team and ensure everyone is moving fast with purpose and sense.

* **Team Leadership & Management:**

○ Recruit, coach, and lead a high-performing team of product designers, fostering their growth and helping them do their best work.

○ Conduct performance reviews, set career goals, and create a clear path for professional development for the team.

○ Instill the core Navi principles of end-to-end ownership and accountability.

* **Design & Process Excellence:**

○ Maintain and elevate an incredibly high bar for design quality, simplicity, and taste across all products.

○ Oversee the design process, ensuring it is data-informed and focused on clear outcomes.

○ Establish and evangelize best practices, design patterns, and standards across the organization.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 7+ years of experience in product design, with a minimum of 2-3 years in a formal management or leadership role.
* A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing design teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* A strategic portfolio that demonstrates how your leadership and design vision drove significant business impact and customer value.
* Deep domain expertise in fintech or a related industry.
* Expertise in user-centered design principles and methodologies.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at a senior leadership level.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

jobs.title: Principal - SAP RTR
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

We are seeking an experienced Principal Record to Report (RTR) to join our Global Capability Center (GCC) and provide functional leadership for SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions supporting enterprise transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and continuous business process improvement.

This offshore leadership role will serve as the primary SAP Record to Report functional expert within the GCC, partnering closely with global Finance, Business Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and System Integration partners. The Principal will play a key role in the BD integration program while establishing scalable global finance solutions and standards for future acquisitions.

The role is responsible for delivering end-to-end SAP Finance solutions across the Record to Report landscape, supporting global design, solution configuration, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement. The Principal will drive standardization using SAP best practices while ensuring compliance with global accounting standards and local statutory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Finance Solution Leadership

* Serve as the Global Capability Center functional lead for SAP Record to Report (RTR).
* Support the Finance Solution Lead and Business Process Owners in delivering SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities.
* Lead functional design activities for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, ERP modernization, and business integration programs.
* Drive global process harmonization while minimizing customizations and maximizing SAP standard functionality.
* Recommend SAP best practices and future-state finance processes.

SAP Functional Expertise

* Lead solution design, configuration, and support for SAP S/4HANA Finance including: General Ledger (Universal Journal), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Margin Analysis (COPA), Intercompany Accounting, Parallel Ledgers, Financial Close, Group Reporting.
* Lead the design, configuration, and support of SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions to enable electronic invoicing (eInvoicing), statutory reporting, tax reporting, and country-specific regulatory compliance across global operations.
* Own configuration and process design for SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), ensuring accurate revenue recognition per ASC 606/IFRS 15 across performance obligations and contract structures
* Own integration architecture between S/4HANA and adjacent systems

M&A Integration

* Support finance integration activities for acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs, including the BD integration program.
* Perform fit-gap analysis between acquired company ERP processes and Waters' SAP S/4HANA global template.
* Support legal entity integration, organizational structure design, chart of accounts mapping, ledger design, fiscal calendar alignment, and financial reporting harmonization.
* Collaborate with Data Migration teams on historical data conversion, opening balances, reconciliation, and financial validation.
* Support deployment and cutover planning to ensure business continuity during integration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Treasury, Tax, Planning, Reporting, and Master Data teams.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP Finance and boundary applications.
* Support interface design and integration using SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, and middleware technologies.
* Participate in architecture reviews, solution workshops, and design governance activities.

Delivery & Continuous Improvement

* Lead functional configuration, testing, defect resolution, and deployment activities.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and Hypercare.
* Develop functional specifications and support technical development where required.
* Identify automation and process improvement opportunities across global finance operations.
* Mentor analysts and consultants within the GCC and promote SAP S/4HANA best practices.

Qualifications

* 10+ years of SAP Finance implementation experience with at least 5 years supporting SAP S/4HANA.
* Deep functional expertise across SAP Record to Report processes.
* Strong hands-on experience with: Universal Journal, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Material Ledger, Product Costing, Margin Analysis (COPA), Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Parallel Ledgers, Intercompany Accounting, Financial Close, Group Reporting, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), RAR
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA 2023 or later releases.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), including electronic invoicing (eInvoicing), statutory reporting, and digital tax compliance. Experience implementing country-specific DRC requirements and integrating with indirect tax processes is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience including direct configuration or functional ownership of Revenue Account Recognition (RAR)
* Experience supporting ERP integrations during mergers, acquisitions, or large-scale transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of legal entities, organizational structures, fiscal year variants, ledgers, currencies, accounting principles, and financial master data.
* Experience with finance data migration, reconciliation, and cutover planning.
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, and finance integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of SOX controls, audit requirements, IFRS, US GAAP, and statutory reporting.
* Experience working in a Global Capability Center or offshore delivery organization supporting global stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline.

Success Factors in Year One

* Successfully support the Record to Report workstream for the BD integration and future M&A initiatives.
* Deliver high-quality SAP Finance solutions aligned with the Waters global template.
* Lead finance configuration, testing, data migration, and deployment activities with minimal business disruption.
* Establish strong partnerships with global Finance teams, Business Technology, and implementation partners.
* Improve standardization and adoption of SAP S/4HANA Finance best practices across the enterprise.
* Mentor GCC team members and contribute to building a high-performing SAP Finance Center of Excellence.

jobs.title: Senior z/OS Unix & zLinux Integration Enginee
jobs.description:
**Your role:** *As a Senior z/OS UNIX & zLinux Integration Engineer, you will spearhead efforts to modernize and integrate our mainframe with contemporary platforms and tools.* Were seeking an **experienced z/OS Systems Engineer** with **expertise in z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** and **IBM zLinux** (Linux on IBM Z) to drive innovation in bridging mainframe and distributed systems. In this role, you will:

**Design and implement enhancements** to our **z/OS UNIX and zLinux environments** – ensuring robust, secure, and scalable UNIX system services on z/OS and optimizing Linux on IBM Z for enterprise workloads. You will apply best-in-class engineering practices to develop new features, automate manual tasks, and improve the developer experience on the mainframe.

* **Accelerate Modernization** – **Leverage modern interfaces** like **z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF)**, the **Zowe** framework, and **IBM Wazi** to integrate mainframe systems into **contemporary DevOps and cloud environments**. This includes enabling REST APIs and CLI tools that allow distributed teams and modern applications to seamlessly interact with z/OS resources. You will play a key role in making the mainframe a more **open and agile platform**, bridging the gap between legacy systems and modern development practices.
* **Implement DevOps and CI/CD practices** for mainframe – Work on integrating z/OS with enterprise **DevOps pipelines**, enabling efficient use of mainframe capabilities in continuous integration and delivery processes. Introduce and support tools such as **Git or Ansible** for z/OS automation, and promote the adoption of modern mainframe development environments (e.g., using **Zowe CLI and APIs** for automation; exploring containerized dev/test frameworks like **IBM Wazi** for z/OS).
* **Ensure system interoperability** – Develop and maintain **interfaces between z/OS and distributed (Linux/Unix) systems**, enabling smooth data exchange and process integration. This may involve building secure API layers, cross-platform file sharing (e.g. via NFS or Zowe API Mediation Layer), and connecting mainframe services to cloud or hybrid environments.
* **Operational Excellence** – Integrate advanced **observability** and **monitoring** for USS and zLinux processes, using tools like system logs, **SMF data**, and modern monitoring dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, etc.) to ensure performance and reliability. You will also **provide third-level support** for complex UNIX and Linux-related issues on the mainframe, employing deep problem analysis to identify root causes and permanent fixes.
* **Technical leadership** – As a senior engineer, you will make high-impact decisions regarding our mainframe integration strategy. You’ll present solution designs and roadmaps to **stakeholders and technical leadership**, advocating for improvements that enhance agility and align with business needs. You will collaborate with architects and other senior engineers to design hybrid solutions that leverage mainframe strengths in a modern IT landscape. Furthermore, you will contribute to our culture by **mentoring colleagues** (e.g., in using new tools or approaches) and by sharing expertise in internal forums and guilds.

**Your team:** You’ll be part of the **Mainframe Platform Core Services** crew, working within a specialized **zSoftware** pod. This cross-functional team focuses on evolving the mainframe to support **new interfaces and hybrid-cloud connectivity**. You will closely partner with team members in **Core z/OS Engineering, Middleware (CICS/MQ) Integration, Security, and Cloud Enablement** to develop end-to-end solutions that connect mainframe services with modern platforms. The team operates globally, so you’ll collaborate with colleagues across different regions and time zones, bringing together a variety of skills to modernize our mainframe environment. The working model is agile, emphasizing iterative improvements, quick feedback loops, and continuous learning as we adopt new technologies in the mainframe context.

**Your expertise:** You are a *seasoned mainframe engineer (8–10+ years of experience)* with a blend of **traditional mainframe skills and modern tooling knowledge**. Key qualifications include:

* **z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** – Advanced knowledge of **UNIX on z/OS** (shell environment, POSIX interfaces, zFS file system management, Unix security model) and the ability to develop and debug programs or scripts running under USS. Experience porting or integrating open-source tools (e.g., Git, Python) onto USS is an advantage.
* **Linux on IBM Z** – **In-depth understanding of zLinux** (Linux running in KVM or LPAR on IBM Z hardware), including system installation, networking, and performance tuning in a mainframe environment. Familiarity with virtualization via **KVM** and concepts like IFL processors, CPU management, and resource sharing on IBM Z is expected.
* **Modernization Tools** – Hands-on experience with or strong knowledge of **modern mainframe tools** such as **z/OSMF** (IBM z/OS Management Facility) for web-based system management, **Zowe** (Open Mainframe Project’s framework for mainframe integration) — e.g., usage of Zowe CLI/Explorer and API mediation for connecting mainframe services with cloud – and **IBM Wazi** for cloud-based mainframe development/testing. Your ability to utilize these tools and frameworks is critical for enabling an **API-driven, cloud-integrated mainframe** environment.
* **Systems Programming & Scripting** – Proficiency in **shell scripting**, REXX, and programming languages like **Python or C/C++** on z/OS or Linux, enabling you to create automation scripts, API endpoints, and system utilities bridging z/OS with distributed systems. Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (e.g., **Ansible on z/OS**) is a plus, emphasizing code-driven system management.
* **Software Maintenance & Configuration** – Solid knowledge of SMP/E, with proven experience in installing, configuring, and migrating new product versions.
* **Networks & Security** – Good grasp of mainframe networking (TCP/IP on z/OS) and **cross-platform security protocols**. Understanding how to manage secure APIs and connectivity between z/OS and external systems (e.g., leveraging encryption, RACF rules for cross-platform access, etc.) is important for safe integration.
* **Performance & Reliability** – Experience optimizing the performance of USS workloads and zLinux instances, including resource allocation, workload balancing, and monitoring of key metrics (like CPU, memory usage on IFLs, network throughput) to ensure stable operations. Familiarity with **mainframe performance tools** and logs (SMF, RMF) is expected.
* **Strategic & Innovative Mindset** – Passion for **modernizing mainframe usage** and staying updated on industry trends (for example, containerization on zLinux, cloud integration, DevOps practices for mainframe). Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and incorporate them into the mainframe environment when beneficial.
* **Communication & Collaboration** – **Excellent English communication skills** are **essential**, enabling you to collaborate effectively with global teams and to clearly present modernization plans to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable in a leadership capacity, coordinating initiatives across different groups, and nurturing a culture where mainframe and distributed teams collaborate seamlessly on hybrid solutions.

**By joining our team as a senior mainframe engineer in any of these roles, you will be empowered to work independently, make critical technical decisions, and visibly shape the future of our mainframe platform** in a dynamic, agile environment. You’ll leverage your deep specialty—be it base z/OS systems, workload automation, or mainframe Unix/Linux integration—to drive high-impact improvements that keep our mainframe systems robust, modern, and aligned with business needs. We value proactive

Founder & CEO

**About the Role**

KGIL Fintech Solutions is looking for an experienced lending professional to establish and lead our First Loss Default Guarantee (FLDG/DLG) business vertical.

The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding lending partners, structuring commercially viable FLDG arrangements, managing portfolio performance, building operational processes and scaling the business independently.

We are looking for someone with strong relationships across banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and lending institutions, combined with practical experience in credit risk, lending operations and portfolio management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. FLDG Business Development**

* Establish and independently scale the FLDG business vertical.
* Identify banks and NBFCs interested in eligible DLG-supported lending arrangements.
* Develop new lending products and commercial opportunities.
* Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial structures.
* Build a sustainable and profitable lending portfolio.

**2. Strategic Lending Partnerships**

* Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across banks and NBFCs.
* Maintain relationships with existing lending institutions.
* Identify additional opportunities in digital lending, loan distribution and co-lending arrangements where applicable.

* Coordinate partner onboarding, underwriting criteria and credit policies.
* Oversee loan sourcing, disbursement coordination and portfolio monitoring.
* Work with regulated lending partners on approved DLG structures.
* Monitor portfolio performance, delinquency, defaults and guarantee utilisation.
* Coordinate reconciliation, claims, collections reporting and settlements with relevant teams.
* Develop operational SOPs and reporting dashboards.

* Analyse portfolio-level credit risk and profitability.
* Track delinquency buckets, vintage performance and loss trends.
* Recommend appropriate risk controls and portfolio eligibility criteria.

* Ensure the business operates within approved risk limits.

* Recruit and lead a dedicated FLDG business team.

* Coordinate agreement execution with Legal and Compliance.
* Maintain complete portfolio records, lender reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure clear accountability for guarantees, commercial obligations and portfolio performance.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10–15 years of experience in NBFCs, banks, fintech or digital lending.
* Direct experience managing FLDG/DLG arrangements or credit-risk-sharing programmes.
* Strong existing relationships with banks and NBFCs.
* Knowledge of unsecured personal loans, business loans and digital lending.
* Understanding of credit underwriting, portfolio risk, collections and lending operations.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial lending partnerships.
* Ability to independently establish and manage a business vertical.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates currently working as AVP, VP, Business Head, Lending Partnerships Head, FLDG Head or Credit Partnerships Head in an NBFC, bank, fintech or lending platform.

**Our expectation:**
An entrepreneurial business leader who can establish a new lending vertical, generate sustainable revenue, manage risk and build a strong team from the ground up.

**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution & Revenue Product Strategy**

* Own the regional product vision, strategy and roadmap for Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity and Revenue Management Systems, aligned to APAC commercial priorities and the global Accommodation platform direction
* Define a coherent distribution and revenue product architecture that enhances our customers positioning whilst maximising visibility and yield across the channels that matter in APAC markets
* Set prioritisation frameworks that balance direct booking growth, channel partner breadth, rate/revenue optimisation and customer retention
* Lead product investment decisions in partnership with engineering and finance, grounded in commercial impact – distribution cost reduction, RevPAR/ADR uplift and channel yield
* Monitor the competitive OTA, channel management and revenue management landscape across APAC (including region-specific players and metasearch/OTA dynamics) to continuously sharpen product positioning

**AI-Native Distribution & Revenue Capabilities**

* Lead the product strategy for AI-native and agentic capability within the distribution and revenue suite – including automated rate optimisation, dynamic pricing recommendations, AI-assisted channel mix decisioning and automated review response
* Embed AI across the product suite where it demonstrably improves revenue or reduces manual effort – intelligent rate shopping insights, forecasting-driven pricing, and automation of routine channel and connectivity management tasks
