jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

HR ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** Head People & Culture  
**Role:** Asst. Manager HR

**Performance Allocation:**

* **70% – Talent Acquisition & Onboarding**
* **30% – HR Operations**

1. End-to-End Recruitment & Talent Acquisition – 70%

The HR professional will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower requisition to successful candidate onboarding.

**A. Manpower Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate with Department Heads, Reporting Managers and HRBP to understand manpower requirements.
* Collect and validate approved manpower requisitions.
* Understand job descriptions, experience requirements, salary budgets and expected joining timelines.
* Maintain a vacancy tracker with position-wise hiring status and recruitment TAT.

**B. Sourcing & Candidate Screening**

* Source candidates through Naukri.com, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, consultants and other recruitment channels.
* Actively utilize assigned recruitment portal credentials and maintain sourcing productivity.
* Screen resumes based on job specifications, experience, qualifications and salary expectations.
* Conduct initial HR screening and assess candidate suitability, communication and joining availability.
* Maintain a qualified and relevant candidate pipeline for all assigned vacancies.

**C. Interview Management**

* Schedule and coordinate interviews with respective Department Heads and Hiring Managers.
* Ensure a minimum required interview pipeline for each assigned vacancy.
* Follow up with candidates and interview panels for timely feedback.
* Maintain interview trackers with selection, rejection and pending feedback status.
* Coordinate subsequent interview rounds wherever required.

**D. Offer Management & Closure**

* Discuss salary expectations and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.
* Coordinate management approvals before releasing offers.
* Release Offer Letters / LOIs to selected candidates.
* Follow up for offer acceptance and required pre-joining documents.
* Maintain regular communication with offered candidates to minimize offer dropouts.
* Ensure positions are closed within the assigned recruitment TAT.

2. Employee Onboarding & Joining Formalities

* Coordinate pre-joining communication and joining confirmations.
* Collect and verify candidate documents, including Aadhaar, PAN, educational certificates, previous employment records and bank details.
* Obtain previous employers' official email IDs wherever required for Background Verification (BGV).
* Coordinate employee registration and onboarding formalities in Keka HRMS.
* Ensure appointment letters, employee documentation and joining checklists are completed.
* Coordinate induction, departmental introductions and reporting-manager alignment.
* Ensure asset issuance, ID cards and other joining requirements are completed.
* Coordinate training schedules, travel, lodging and boarding arrangements for outstation employees wherever applicable.
* Maintain accurate employee master data and onboarding records.

3. HR Operations – 30%

**A. Attendance & Leave Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, login/logout records and employee absenteeism through Keka.
* Track leave applications, approvals, rejections and attendance regularizations.
* Follow up on missing punches and attendance discrepancies.
* Maintain daily attendance and absenteeism reports.
* Coordinate with managers for attendance-related clarifications.

**B. Employee Documentation & HR Records**

* Maintain employee personal files and confidential HR documentation.
* Manage appointment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters and other employee correspondence.
* Maintain employee databases, department-wise manpower reports and employee movement records.
* Ensure timely updating of employee records in Keka HRMS.

**C. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Coordinate probation reviews, confirmation processes and employee status updates.
* Support employee engagement and grievance coordination.
* Manage employee exit formalities, resignation documentation and notice-period tracking.

jobs.title: Senior Mainframe Workload Scheduler Specialist
jobs.description:
**Senior Mainframe Workload Scheduler Specialist *(IBM Workload Automation & related non-IBM Products)***

**Your role:** *As a Senior Mainframe Workload Scheduler Specialist, you will be accountable for the design, reliability, and evolution of the mainframe batch workload automation environment.* Were seeking an **expert in IBM Workload Scheduler for z/OS (formerly Tivoli Workload Scheduler)** with a strong grasp of non-IBM **scheduling suite products** (such as IWS/BatchAD, IWS/BatchCP, IWS/Audit, IWS/Graph, XINFO). In this role, you will **design and optimize enterprise-wide batch scheduling solutions**, improving how we orchestrate and automate business-critical processing. Key responsibilities include:

* Ensuring **reliable and efficient batch scheduling** for all mainframe applications and systems, by configuring and fine-tuning IBM Workload Scheduler (IWS) to meet strict SLAs for job completion and throughput.
* **Developing scheduling architecture and processes** that integrate seamlessly with z/OS Workload Manager (WLM) policies, ensuring that automated jobs get the necessary system resources for the best throughput under WLM-managed environments.
* **Implementing and maintaining non-IBM workload automation tools** (e.g., IWS/Audit, Graph, BatchAD/BatchCP, and XINFO) to extend and enhance the IBM Workload Scheduler environment. Leverage these tools to provide advanced scheduling analytics, audit capabilities, and improved operator interfaces.
* **Modernizing and integrating** the scheduling environment with **DevOps and agile processes**, including exploring ways to introduce **APIs and modern interfaces** for scheduling (for example, via Zowe CLI or REST APIs) for better integration with enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* **Monitoring scheduling performance and reliability**: Build observability into the scheduling systems and **establish robust monitoring** to detect and resolve job failures or delays rapidly. Use metrics and tools (including non-IBM products) to ensure continuous improvement in scheduling efficiency and fault tolerance.
* **Stakeholder collaboration**: Work closely with application development teams and operations to gather scheduling requirements, advise on workload planning, and ensure scheduling solutions have **bank-wide impact and reliability, with minimal business disruption**. Provide consultation and *advisory* services for improving enterprise batch processing and workload management strategies.
* **Leadership and innovation**: Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate manual tasks and improve our batch operations. You will make **key technical decisions** regarding workload automation design and present your proposals and their trade-offs to **stakeholders and technical leadership** for alignment. You’ll also contribute to **hiring and mentoring** within the team, sharing knowledge of scheduling best practices and fostering an engineering culture of reliability and innovation.

**Your team:** You will join the **zSoftware engineering Pod** and closely collaborate with the **Mainframe Production Control & Automation team** (part of our broader Mainframe Platform Services crew) responsible for enterprise batch **workload automation**. Working in an **agile crew**, you’ll closely collaborate with **application support teams, infrastructure engineers, and IT operations** across regions to ensure our batch scheduling aligns with business needs and integrates with cross-platform workflows. You’ll frequently interface with mainframe system engineers (e.g., z/OS base systems, DB2, CICS/MQ teams) to coordinate changes that span multiple disciplines, ensuring that scheduling, infrastructure, and applications operate harmoniously. As a senior specialist, you may lead scheduling-related projects and coordinate with global staff (across locations such as Switzerland, India, and the US) to drive unified improvements in workload automation.

**Your expertise:** To be successful, you should have *extensive experience (8+ years preferred) in mainframe scheduling and automation.* Key qualifications include:

* **Mastery of IBM Workload Scheduler for z/OS (IWS/TWS)** – Profound knowledge of job scheduling concepts, calendar and plan management, JCL and OPC/IWS definitions. Hands-on experience customizing and tuning **IWS subsystems** (controllers and trackers) to meet complex enterprise scheduling requirements.
* **Batch supporting Product Suite** – **Expertise with Batch supporting tools** job scheduling add-ons and tools (such as **IWS/BatchAD, IWS/BatchCP, IWS/Audit, IWS/Graph,** and **XINFO**), with ability to maintain and upgrade these tools in line with platform upgrades. Familiarity with vendor roadmaps and version support for these products is beneficial (e.g., transitions to **IWS 10.x** and related HORIZONT versions).
* **Workload Optimization & WLM** – Strong understanding of **z/OS Workload Manager (WLM)** principles and how workload scheduling interacts with WLM and system capacity. Able to configure scheduling policies that complement WLM to **maximize throughput and resource utilization**.
* **Scripting & Automation** – Proficiency in **REXX and JCL** scripting to automate scheduling tasks and implement advanced conditional scheduling logic. Experience integrating scheduling events with cross-platform orchestration tools or REST APIs (for example, using modern interfacing via **Zowe CLI** or similar frameworks to trigger or monitor mainframe workloads) is an advantage.
* **Software Maintenance & Configuration** – Solid knowledge of SMP/E, with proven experience in installing, configuring, and migrating new product versions.
* **High Availability & Resilience** – Experience designing **highly available scheduling configurations** (e.g., dual controllers, fault-tolerant arrangements) and disaster recovery procedures for scheduling systems. Familiarity with GDPS or multi-site scheduling setups is a plus.
* **Problem-solving & Support** – Demonstrated experience in **troubleshooting complex batch job failures** and scheduling anomalies under pressure. Comfortable providing **3rd-level support** for scheduling platform issues, including analyzing *critical path delays, late job executions, and root-cause determination* to ensure timely resolution.
* **Strategic mindset** – Proven ability to plan for **modernization of batch processing**, such as migrating to new versions (e.g., **IWS 10+**), implementing **DevOps-friendly scheduling interfaces**, and improving the overall agility of mainframe operations. You think ahead to ensure **long-term scaling and sustainability** of the workload automation environment.
* **Communication & Leadership** – **Excellent communication** in English (verbal and written) is **required**, as you will liaise with diverse global teams and present scheduling strategies to senior IT management. You have a knack for translating complex scheduling concepts into understandable plans for stakeholders. As a senior specialist, you also have the **leadership skills** to mentor junior team members in workload automation practices and to champion best practices within the organization.

jobs.title: MRGR Review Lead - Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
* Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
* Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
* Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
* Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
* Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
* Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
* Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.
* Contribute to model risk governance and review priorities and initiatives.
* Stay informed about changes in consumer banking, artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques (including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence), products, markets, models, risk practices, and industry standards; use this knowledge to guide review priorities and identify emerging risks.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a strong quantitative background (PhD, Master's degree, or equivalent) in Statistics, Economics (with Econometrics), Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a quantitative science.
* Knowledge of both statistical/econometric methodologies and machine learning modeling methodologies.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, SAS, or R.
* Working knowledge of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques, including large language models, generative artificial intelligence, and agentic artificial intelligence systems, including key risks and limitations.
* Ability to challenge model design, assumptions, and testing approaches for advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models.
* Product domain expertise in consumer banking/retail banking, including ability to understand the business and knowledge of regulation surrounding the business.
* Extensive experience and familiarity in model development or model validation in financial institutions.
* 12+ years of work experience in model development or model validation.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to interface with stakeholders on model-related issues.
* Risk and control mindset: ask incisive questions, assess materiality of issues, and escalate as required.
* Sound project management and organizational skills; flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities, and able to work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.description:

Location: India Tamil Nadu Adyar - Chennai

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.

#### **Job ID**

62988

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and

* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What you will do:**

  

As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

  

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

  

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Data Model Ownership:

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.
* Establish a strategic target-state data architecture aligned to business, technology, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.
* Govern data model design decisions and oversee implementation across programmes and change initiatives.

Data Management and Governance:

* Drive adoption of data management best practices across all technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between data strategy, architecture standards, and delivery programmes.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage data-related risks across the technology estate.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure integrity, accuracy, completeness, and traceability of data.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements through effective data governance and management practices.
* Ensure remediation plans are implemented and tracked where control weaknesses are identified.
  

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* Director-level leadership experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in Banking or Financial services
* Proven experience defining and executing an Enterprise Data Strategy, roadmap and target operating model aligned with business, technology, risk and regulatory objectives.
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Management, data architecture and data modelling, including ownership of end-to-end enterprise data models and target-state architecture.
* Extensive experience in data governance, data risk and controls, including data quality, lineage, ownership, audit, regulatory requirements and remediation.
* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

Cluster Sales Head – Current Accounts

Business Banking / Branch Banking / CASA

Cluster Head

Defined cluster of branches, catchments and business hubs

Branch Managers, Product, Cash Management, POS/QR, Operations, Compliance and Service teams

**1. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.

* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.

**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Network International is the largest Financial Technology company in Middle East and Africa. Payments is our core business where we provide services in more than 50 countries – UAE, Jordan, South Africa, Egypt are some of our key markets. Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we are growing in direct to consumer card segment as well.
  
  
**Our EVP**
At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Agile Transformation will lead Acquiring's evolution into a more product-led, agile and insight-driven organisation. Working across Product, Technology, Data, Business Teams, Leadership and Transformation Partners, the role will assess current maturity, define the target operating model and embed practical ways of working suited to Network International.
  
  
The role will create the governance, capabilities, roles and operating practices needed for successful product delivery, while delivery outcomes remain shared across Product, Technology and the wider organisation. As maturity increases, the remit will evolve towards broader product strategy, portfolio management, investment prioritisation and value creation.
  
  
**The Transformation Journey**

* Discover: Assess maturity and define the target state and roadmap.
* Transform: Establish the Product and Agile operating model.
* Embed: Build internal capability, a Centre of Excellence and partner knowledge transfer.
* Scale: Extend and continuously improve successful practices.
* Evolve: Broaden influence over Product strategy, portfolio choices and value creation.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Lead Product & Agile Transformation**

* Own the transformation vision, business case, roadmap, milestones and success measures; assess maturity and sequence priorities.
* Align Product, Technology, Data, business leadership and partners around a common target state, removing organisational, governance and behavioural barriers.
* Keep the transformation practical, commercially relevant and aligned with customer, risk and enterprise priorities, using AI-enabled tools to accelerate adoption.

**Establish Product-led & Agile Ways Of Working**

* Design and embed a scalable operating model covering team structures, governance, decision rights, funding principles, delivery cadences and performance measures.
* Clarify accountabilities across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data, Operations, Sales and delivery roles.
* Embed customer-led discovery, prioritisation and outcome-based planning; apply Scrum, Kanban or scaled approaches according to context.
* Improve Product-Technology collaboration, portfolio visibility, dependency management, predictability and speed to value.

**Build Capability & Organizational Ownership**

* Build Product and Agile capability from executive leadership to delivery teams through structured learning, coaching and practical application.
* Establish a Product and Agile Centre of Excellence, communities of practice, playbooks, role standards and internal coaching capability.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change adoption; govern transformation partners and progressively transfer knowledge and ownership into Network International.

**Enable Insight-led Decisions & Demonstrate Value Through Data & AI:**

* Embed customer insight, product analytics, commercial measures and operational data into discovery, prioritisation and lifecycle decisions.
* Identify responsible uses of AI for research, experimentation, requirements, knowledge management and decision support, with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Maintain a balanced scorecard covering adoption, capability, flow, predictability, quality, customer outcomes and commercial value; report progress, risks and benefits transparently.

**Qualifications**
**Key Requirements:**
**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years across Agile transformation, Product operating models, Product management, technology delivery or enterprise change, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
* Proven success leading large-scale Product and Agile transformation across multiple teams or business units in a complex, regulated organization.
* Strong experience designing Product-led operating models, including governance, roles, team structures, portfolio practices, outcome-based planning and investment prioritization.
* Hands-on expertise in Product discovery, Agile delivery, organizational design, change leadership, executive influence, coaching and capability building.
* Experience managing transformation partners, establishing a Centre of Excellence and transferring capability into internal teams.
* Track record of measuring adoption, delivery performance, customer impact and business value; practical understanding of responsible AI, data privacy and security.
* Experience in payments, acquiring, merchant services, fintech or banking, with knowledge of the merchant lifecycle, payment products, risk, fraud, operations and commercial drivers.
* Experience across multiple markets and regulatory environments, ideally in the Middle East and Africa.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is advantageous.
* Credentials such as SAFe SPC, Certified Scrum Professional, ICAgile, Scrum Alliance or Prosci are advantageous; demonstrated transformation outcomes are more important than certification alone.

*Network International is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, nationalities, and experience levels. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where innovation, diversity, and performance thrive.*

**Role Overview**

The Branch CEO / Senior Executive Officer is the accountable executive for MultiPass's DIFC branch and the leader of its next stage of UAE growth. The role combines regulated executive leadership, delivery of a mainland licensing programme, and direct commercial ownership. The successful candidate will protect the branch's regulatory standing, build trusted relationships with regulators and local banking partners, originate revenue personally, and create a high-performing Sales and Business Development organisation.

**The Three Core Mandates**

1.
**Lead the DIFC branch.**
Act as Branch CEO and, subject to regulatory approval, Senior Executive

Officer; own governance, regulatory engagement, compliance, local banking relationships,

operational performance, and the branch's reputation.

2.
**Deliver mainland authorisation.**
Lead the end-to-end programme to identify and obtain the

appropriate UAE mainland electronic-money and/or payment-services licence or authorisation,

working with the relevant federal and mainland authorities and external advisers.

3.
**Grow the revenue base.**
Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Branch Leadership, Regulation and Banking Relationships**

* Serve as the senior accountable executive for the DIFC branch and provide coordination for
* strategy, governance, culture, risk, compliance, operations, and financial performance.
* Maintain a proactive, transparent, and credible relationship with the Dubai Financial Services
* Authority (DFSA), including timely regulatory engagement, notifications, returns, remediation, and responses to supervisory requests.
* Ensure the branch operates within its permissions, policies, risk appetite, and applicable DIFC/DFSA requirements, with particular attention to AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct, safeguarding, prudential oversight, outsourcing, and financial-crime controls.
* Chair or participate in branch governance forums; ensure decisions, delegated authorities, management information, incident escalation, and board or group reporting are clear and effective.
* Own senior relationships with local banks, safeguarding or settlement partners, payment providers, professional advisers, and other critical counterparties; negotiate resilient and commercially sound arrangements.

**2. UAE Mainland Licensing Programme**

* Define the target regulated business model and licensing strategy for mainland UAE, aligned with MultiPass's products, client segments, risk appetite, capital plan, and growth ambitions.
* Lead the feasibility study and business case for the mainland licence.
* Coordinate internal Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Treasury, and People teams, together with external legal and regulatory advisers.
* Oversee preparation of the business plan, governance and ownership materials, financial projections, capital and liquidity plans, policies, control frameworks, technology and outsourcing documentation, and evidence of operational readiness.
* Build constructive relationships with the relevant UAE authorities, including the Central Bank of the UAE where applicable, and ensure all submissions are accurate, consistent, and delivered to the agreed standard and timetable.
* Translate licensing conditions into an executable mobilisation plan and ensure the mainland entity or operation is ready to launch without weakening the DIFC branch's controls or service quality.

**3. Revenue Growth and Commercial Team Build**

* Own the UAE branch revenue plan, client-acquisition strategy, commercial pipeline, and contribution to profitability, with clear monthly and quarterly targets.
* Personally originate, negotiate, and close high-value clients and strategic partnerships, particularly among internationally active businesses requiring multi-currency accounts, cross-border payments, and FX services.
* Develop a strong network across the UAE business, banking, professional-services, investment, and fintech communities and represent MultiPass at relevant market and industry forums.
* Recruit and lead the Sales and Business Development team; define coverage, roles, incentives, targets, account ownership, onboarding standards, and performance-management routines.
* Implement a disciplined commercial operating system covering CRM hygiene, lead qualification, pipeline reviews, conversion, pricing governance, revenue attribution, forecasting, client retention, and cross-sell.
* Work closely with Compliance, Product, Operations, Treasury, and Group leadership to ensure commercial growth remains within risk appetite and that client feedback informs product and service development.

**4. People, Operations and Profitability**

* Build a high-accountability, client-focused branch culture in line with DYNINNO Corporate Values.

* Ensure the branch has appropriate business-continuity, operational-resilience, information-security, complaints, and incident-management arrangements.
* Provide concise, decision-useful reporting to Group leadership and the Board.

**Requirements**

* Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head or equivalent within regulated payments, electronic money, B2B fintech or transaction banking.
* Strong UAE market knowledge, including practical experience engaging with regulators and understanding DIFC/DFSA requirements and the UAE mainland regulatory environment.

jobs.title: Manager, Payments & Treasury
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

**1. Purpose of the role**
--------------------------

This role sits across both the EMEA Technology Risk Management group and the EMEA Cyber Governance, Risk and Control group. It is a first line regional role responsible for broad technology and cyber risk and control activity across the Middle East, while contributing to the wider EMEA operating model.

The role supports the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment and monitoring of technology and cyber risks. It also supports the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidence and remediation of controls. Reporting and management information are important enabling activities, but they are not the primary focus of the role.

The post holder will work as part of the established regional team and in close partnership with existing Technology Risk Management, Cyber GRC, Information Security and Technology colleagues. The role is intended to complement existing individuals in the region by adding capacity, coordination and specialist risk and control capability. It does not create parallel ownership or replace established accountabilities. The role reports locally to the Head of IT for the Middle East and maintains functional alignment with both the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.

**2. Background**
-----------------

* Operates within the first line Technology and Cyber organisation, reporting locally to the Head of IT for Dubai, with functional alignment to the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.
* Provides a clear Middle East regional presence from Dubai and connects regional requirements, risks and control matters into the wider EMEA framework.
* Supports a strong, consistent and transparent technology and cyber risk and control environment aligned to internal frameworks, risk appetite and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Works with regional and global stakeholders to improve consistency while preserving local ownership, expertise and decision rights.

**3. Principal accountabilities and responsibilities**
------------------------------------------------------

**Unless specifically stated otherwise, each responsibility below applies across both technology and cyber risk, controls, governance and assurance.**

**First line technology and cyber risk management**
---------------------------------------------------

* Support the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment, acceptance, monitoring and evidence based closure of technology and cyber risks and issues across EMEA.
* Maintain an integrated, decision ready view of material risks, control gaps, issues, exceptions, actions, decisions, milestones, dependencies and remediation activity, linked to business impact, risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Embed practical risk management within day to day Technology and Cyber activities, programmes, projects, services and material change initiatives.
* Ensure risks and issues are clearly articulated, consistently assessed, linked to relevant work and assigned to accountable owners.
* Provide constructive first line challenge on risk assessments, treatment plans, evidence and closure proposals without assuming ownership held by service or control owners.

**Technology and cyber risk and control management**
----------------------------------------------------

* Support the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidencing, validation and improvement of proportionate technology and cyber controls.
* Help define clear control objectives, ownership, frequency, evidence requirements, performance measures, quality gates and escalation triggers.
* Identify recurring weaknesses and thematic issues, and support sustainable improvements to control design, operation and evidence quality.
* Help owners address overdue or Red and Amber items through practical recovery plans with clear owners, dates, blockers, escalation routes and closure criteria.

**Regulatory compliance and assurance**
---------------------------------------

* Coordinate first line responses to regulatory requirements, including DORA, EBA guidance, relevant Middle East expectations and entity or Head Office requests.
* Translate regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes, evidence and accountable actions.
* Maintain a controlled record of commitments, owners, inputs, dates, evidence, blockers, dependencies and escalation status.
* Maintain traceability between obligations, policies, standards, controls, risks, evidence, findings and remediation.
* Coordinate input from subject matter experts and control owners so submissions are accurate, complete, consistent, reviewed and evidence based while preserving their accountability.

**Technology and cyber policy and standards governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Support policy owners with the review, update, approval and governance of technology and cyber policies and standards, maintaining alignment with regulation, internal frameworks and control obligations.
* Coordinate owners, reviewers and approvers through the policy lifecycle and annual approval cycle.
* Manage policy exceptions through documented justification, risk assessment, compensating controls, approval and review dates.
* Support technology and cyber policy improvement activity, including ECB related requirements, cyber skills framework operationalisation and associated process governance.

**Technology and cyber metrics, KRIs and management information**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate the monthly technology and cyber metrics cycle with accountable data and metric owners.
* Help owners define and review KRIs, KCIs and KPIs, including thresholds, data sources, ownership and data quality controls.
* Coordinate action where performance is outside tolerance or evidence is incomplete.
* Provide clear analysis of trends, service health, control effectiveness, risks, issues, remediation progress and regulatory commitments.
* Support controlled automation of reporting processes using approved tooling, with clear ownership, testing, auditability and traceability.

**Technology and cyber committee and executive reporting**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Support and coordinate technology and cyber reporting for the Security and Technology Risk Committee and provide reviewed Technology Risk Management and Cyber GRC input to other executive, entity and Head Office forums.
* Prepare concise, accurate papers covering material risks, controls, actions, service health and decisions.
* Maintain consistency and traceability across submissions while respecting forum ownership and approval routes.
* Coordinate contributors to meet deadlines, resolve data or evidence gaps and maintain clear records of decisions and actions.

**Technology and cyber audit and remediation management**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a senior first line coordination contact for technology and cyber Internal and External Audit activity, supporting accountable owners and clarifying ownership where responsibility is shared or unclear.
* Coordinate audit engagement, document requests, evidence, stakeholder responses, management responses and governance updates.
* Support agreement of practical remediation actions with accountable owners, milestones, due dates, closure criteria and validation requirements.
* Track findings and actions through to evidence based closure, reporting progress and escalating overdue or off track items through agreed routes.
* Identify recurring themes and use audit outcomes to improve controls, evidence quality and the wider risk and control environment.

**Technology and cyber stakeholder leadership and engagement**
--------------------------------------------------------------

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. **Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.

* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for the global markets division.
* Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.
* Training and mentoring of junior colleagues.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
