The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

jobs.description:

Full Time

***Ready to strengthen risk oversight across UAE Wealth products and distribution?***

  

**Why HSBC**

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

As Senior Wealth Risk Manager in the UAE you’ll support the Head of Wealth Risk and MENAT IWPB CRO to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risks across the market Wealth business. The role provides focused second-line oversight across investment and wealth products, their distribution journeys, risk governance and the implementation of the Risk Management Framework.

  

Working closely with first-line product, distribution and business teams and with specialist second-line Risk Stewards you’ll provide practical advice and independent oversight to inform key decisions. You’ll help ensure material risks and issues are understood, escalated and addressed in a timely way.

  

Success means clear governance, decision-useful risk reporting and sustained improvements in controls, issue management and customer outcomes.

  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Support the launch and ongoing oversight of investment and wealth products, services and distribution journeys including due diligence, governance, controls and risk assessment
* Review committee papers and prepare concise briefings for senior risk leaders ahead of product, distribution and risk governance forums
* Oversee product due-diligence processes and the risk oversight of internal and external third-party providers
* Monitor distribution framework changes, risk indicators and issues and ensure appropriate read-across across products, channels, customer segments and other markets
* Embed the Risk Management Framework, Group Risk Policies and local procedures across the Wealth business
* Apply the Non-Financial Risk framework and relevant systems to key control identification and monitoring, issue management, risk indicators and action tracking
* Maintain the market Wealth risk profile including risk maps, risk appetite metrics, top and emerging risks, issues and mitigating actions including contributions to stress testing and scenario analysis where relevant
* Escalate material product, distribution, control, conduct and regulatory risk concerns promptly to the Head of Wealth Risk and relevant stakeholders
* Undertake targeted reviews with product and distribution teams to evaluate whether key procedures and controls are designed and operating effectively
* Coordinate Wealth risk governance including agendas, submissions, minutes, decisions and action tracking and produce timely, accurate risk reporting for market, regional and global stakeholders
  

**What we're looking for**

  

* A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory
* Relevant risk management experience from private banking, wealth management or another regulated financial services business is essential.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of investment and wealth products alongside product governance and distribution frameworks
* Working knowledge of risk governance, risk appetite, the Risk Management Framework and non-financial risk management is required.

* Experience supporting governance forums including preparing senior-level papers and briefings and tracking issues and actions is required.
* Operate effectively in a regulated environment with a strong understanding of the regulatory environment for Wealth business
* Use structured approaches to interpret complex information, identify connections and emerging risks and communicate practical conclusions clearly
* Provide effective independent challenge across stakeholders at different levels of seniority, using clear and professional judgement
* Work effectively in a complex matrix environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail
  

**Strengthening Wealth risk governance**

  

This is a role with real influence on how Wealth products are governed, distributed and monitored in market. You’ll help senior decision-makers see risk clearly and act early on issues that matter to customers, regulators and the business. If you’re looking to build deeper second-line oversight across investment and wealth products and shape practical improvements in controls and governance this role offers breadth, scale and visibility. Join HSBC and help keep the UAE Wealth business safe, well-governed and ready for growth.

  

For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number.

  

We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  

Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited

jobs.title: Vice President - International Gaming Compliance & MLRO
jobs.description:
About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.

About the Position:

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a **Vice President – Gaming Compliance & Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)** to join the resort’s **Gaming Compliance team** in Ras Al Khaimah. The role reports directly to the Chief Global Compliance Officer, Wynn Resorts, and administratively to the SVP, General Counsel, WMI.

As MLRO and a senior leader within Gaming Compliance, you will direct the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of WMI’s risk-based Anti-Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) Compliance Program. You will oversee suspicious activity investigations and reporting to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit (UAE FIU) through goAML, set risk appetite and control standards, lead training, and provide strategic direction to Gaming Compliance teams and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents. The program covers applicable UAE Federal AML laws, Cabinet Decisions, Chapter 12 of the GCGRA Executive Regulations, and FATF standards applicable to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs).

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

* Act as WMI’s MLRO, reviewing and determining Suspicious Activity Incident Reports (SAIRs), escalating and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), ensuring continuity through an appropriately qualified Deputy MLRO during any absence, and serving as Secretary of the WMI AML Compliance Committee.
* Provide strategic leadership and direction to Gaming Compliance, setting objectives, policies, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and business goals.
* Oversee AML/CFT obligations and maintain effective compliance systems, controls, and governance to minimize exposure to money laundering and terrorism financing.
* Direct and review suspicious activity investigations, analysis, and escalation, with direct reporting to the WMI AML Compliance Committee and governing body. Make timely, documented reporting or non-reporting decisions, prioritize cases by risk, and maintain confidentiality and independence.
* Oversee timely SAR filing with the UAE FIU through goAML, no later than 30 calendar days from initial detection, and ensure the GCGRA is notified of the FIU reference number immediately following submission.
* Oversee Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), source of funds and source of wealth verification, and risk scoring for potentially high-risk patrons and Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), approving risk-based decisions.
* Develop and maintain quality assurance (QA) policies, procedures, and review standards for SARs, CDD and EDD files, transaction monitoring alerts, and investigations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with GCGRA requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive QA testing to identify trends, gaps, and errors, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to strengthen the AML Compliance Program.
* Prepare QA reports, metrics, analytical findings, and enhancement updates for leadership, the WMI AML Compliance Committee, and the Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Maintain robust AML/CFT recordkeeping and storage for a minimum of five years, in accordance with the GCGRA Executive Regulations, with records immediately available to the GCGRA or UAE authorities upon request.
* Oversee regular screening of persons reported in SAIRs/SARs, currency exchanges, and third-party wire transfers, and review the monthly PEP checklist prepared for Global Compliance Investigations.
* Work closely with Wynn Resorts Global Compliance Investigations to prepare and review reports for the WMI AML Compliance Committee and Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Lead GCGRA examinations, internal audits, and annual independent AML Compliance Program testing; act as a primary regulatory contact and oversee remediation of deficiencies.
* Cooperate with the GCGRA, UAE FIU, Police, and Courts, managing responses to investigation inquiries and regulatory or law enforcement information requests.
* Oversee ongoing sanctions screening of players, transactions, and vendors against UAE and relevant UN Security Council sanctions lists, including match handling, escalation, freezing measures, reporting, and recordkeeping; ensure Targeted Financial Sanctions are applied when a match is identified.
* Oversee daily transaction monitoring, transaction logs, and Electronic Multiple Transaction Logs (e-MTLs), ensuring loggable and reportable transactions at or above AED 11,000 are accurately recorded and structuring or other suspicious activity is identified and escalated.
* Design and implement monitored risk scenarios and typologies, overseeing alert handling, escalation, investigation, system tuning, and transaction monitoring effectiveness.
* Enforce the prohibition on anonymous, alias/AKA, fictitious-name, and nominee Player Accounts, and ensure identification and account-opening due diligence requirements are met.
* Enforce strict confidentiality of SARs and suspicious activity investigations and the prohibition on tipping off, sharing SAR information only on a need-to-know basis in accordance with UAE law.
* Direct WMI’s annual money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risk assessment, using results to enhance policies, procedures, systems, and controls.
* Report clearly and promptly to senior management and governing bodies on AML/CFT/CPF program effectiveness, maintaining governance that upholds confidentiality and independence.
* Keep the Compliance Program current with evolving risks, typologies, legislation, regulatory guidance, sanctions requirements, products, services, and emerging technologies.
* Develop, deliver, and maintain AML/CFT/CPF training, including role-targeted programs, materials, and records; coach managers, staff, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents on regulatory obligations.
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage Gaming Compliance managers and team members.
* Build professional, positive relationships with department heads, team members, regulators, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents.
* Attend and lead departmental and interdepartmental meetings and share relevant information.
* Adhere to Company policies, procedures, and the Code of Conduct.
* Maintain professional conduct and grooming in line with Department and Company standards.
* Follow health and safety standards and pursue continuous improvement to prevent health and injury hazards.
* Undertake other duties and responsibilities typical of a VP-level role at WMI.

About You:

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* **Experience:** At least 10 years of experience in AML/CFT/CPF compliance, gaming compliance, or a related field, including at least five years in senior management or a director-level role, with sufficient authority, direct access to governing bodies, and the independence to challenge business decisions.
* **Operational MLRO experience:** Advanced, senior-level operational MLRO experience in a large, complex, cash- and/or value-intensive environment, relevant to WMI’s land-based casino business model, transaction profile, customer base, and ML/TF/PF risks.
* **Preferred experience:** Experience in UAE financial institutions or regulated entities, goAML and UAE FIU reporting, GCGRA requirements, the UAE AML/CFT/CPF framework and regulatory environment, and commercial gaming.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Fina

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Goodscore, our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own high-impact product areas from strategy → 0→1 → scale. You’ll work closely with the Founder, Product, Engineering, Design and business leadership to identify the biggest customer problems, define the product vision, make high-conviction bets and drive them through execution.

This is a role for someone who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Product Strategy - Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for your product area. Identify high-impact opportunities through customer insights, data, market trends and first-principles thinking. Translate ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* Build 0→1 and scale products - Take products from problem discovery → product definition → launch → iteration → scale. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality products quickly.
* Build AI-native experiences - Identify where AI and agents can fundamentally improve the credit experience, rather than simply adding AI features. Experiment with new AI capabilities, workflows and agentic experiences and turn emerging technology into simple, useful experiences for millions of consumers.
* Own outcomes, not outputs - Define north-star and product metrics. Monitor performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve the product. Balance user value, business impact and execution velocity.
* Lead cross-functional execution - Work across Engineering, Design, Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Operations. Create alignment around priorities and drive execution through ambiguity. Influence without authority and bring teams together around a clear product direction.
* Be relentlessly close to the customer - Talk to users, understand their financial behaviour and uncover unmet needs. Combine qualitative insights with data to make better product decisions. Build products that are simple enough for the next 10 million users.

**What we’re looking for**

* Exceptional academic and professional track record; IIT/NIT or equivalent undergraduate degree and/or top-tier MBA.
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building consumer products at scale with experience owning products end-to-end, including 0→1 launches.
* Strong product sense and ability to turn ambiguous problems into simple, compelling products. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data and product metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Genuine curiosity about AI, fintech, consumer technology and emerging products.
* Experience with AI/ML products, fintech, lending, credit, payments or marketplaces is a strong plus.

*GoodScore is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for ability, potential and impact, and welcome talented people from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, caste, religion, race, ethnicity, age, disability, marital or parental status, nationality, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Different perspectives make better products. We’re building a team that reflects the users we serve.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Dostt )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)
* **Astrology Guidance**  - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* **Edutainment Skill Learning**  - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* **Matrimonial Matchmaking**  - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* **Agri Consulting**  - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* **Local Jobs**  - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* **Social Community**  - Place to find post social updates (Lokal app)
* **Advisory Services**  - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

**About the Team:**  The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our house of apps model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. Youll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy-working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

**Responsibilities:**

+ **Drive product strategy**  to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
+ **Own and enhance payment systems**  by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
+ **Design and run pricing experiments**  including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
+ **Collaborate with Marketing**  to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
+ **Strengthen trust and user satisfaction**  by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
+ **Partner cross-functionally**  with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
+ **Own the product roadmap**  , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
+ **Conduct market research**  to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
+ **Develop retention strategies**  to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
+ **Analyze user behavior**  and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

**What We re Looking For:**

+ 5 - 9 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
+ Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
+ Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
+ Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
+ Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. Were outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

As a Data Governance Lead (Vice President) within the Chief Data Office, you will lead Markets data quality and data lineage initiatives, partnering across business, control functions, and Technology to deliver measurable risk reduction, operational efficiency, and regulatory-ready outcomes.

jobs.description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**DevSecOps Engineer**

**CI/CD security integration, automation and operational support**

**Job Posting Title**

**DevSecOps Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 1

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to implement and operate security checks in Azure DevOps and related delivery workflows. You will help engineering teams receive timely, accurate feedback on code, dependencies, secrets, infrastructure and deployed applications while maintaining the reliability of the supporting automation.

The role combines pipeline engineering, troubleshooting, tool configuration, evidence automation and developer support. It is ideal for someone who enjoys making security controls usable and repeatable.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Implement and maintain Azure DevOps YAML templates, pipeline tasks, scripts and configuration for approved security capabilities.

* Configure SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security checks at the pipeline stage defined by the control design.

* Onboard repositories and pipelines, verify prerequisites and permissions, test integrations and record coverage evidence.

* Troubleshoot scan failures, agent issues, network or authentication problems, API errors, timeouts and configuration drift.

* Normalise and route results to the correct application and owner; support deduplication, suppression review and ticket creation.

* Work with AppSec engineers to confirm which findings require manual triage, remediation tracking or validation.

* Collect baselines for report-only controls, analyse false positives and performance impact, and support pilots for risk-based blocking.

* Implement approved quality-gate rules and exception data; verify that bypasses are visible, authorised and time-bound.

* Maintain dashboards and evidence for tool health, adoption, coverage, scan outcomes, ageing findings and exceptions.

* Write clear onboarding guides, troubleshooting steps and FAQs; provide practical support to product engineering teams.

* Assist tool evaluations and proofs of concept by building integrations, running test suites and documenting detection and operational results.

* Apply version control, peer review, testing, secrets management and least privilege to security automation.

Identify repetitive manual work and propose safe automation or reusable templates.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 2-5 years in DevOps, software engineering, cloud engineering or security engineering, with hands-on CI/CD experience.

* Practical knowledge of Azure DevOps repositories and YAML pipelines, or strong experience with a comparable platform and the ability to transfer quickly.

You will own the technical integration and operating quality of security capabilities in CI/CD. You will partner with AppSec, platform and product engineering teams, but you will not take ownership of application or enterprise architecture decisions.

* Build reliable result ingestion, deduplication, ownership routing, suppression governance and links back to source, build and deployment context.

* Partner with AppSec engineers to align pipeline rules with secure development requirements, review evidence and remediation validation.

* Design controlled bypass and exception mechanisms with expiry, approval, rationale, compensating controls and complete audit trails; do not allow silent bypasses.

* Automate dashboards and evidence for coverage, policy outcomes, blocked builds, ageing findings, exceptions and adoption while protecting sensitive finding data.

* Lead structured tool evaluations and proofs of concept covering detection efficacy, language and platform coverage, API quality, deployment model, usability, scalability, security and cost.

* Experience tuning tools and designing risk-based gates that developers can understand and operations teams can support.

* Ability to diagnose pipeline failures across network, identity, agent, tool and configuration layers.

* Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to lead adoption across multiple engineering teams.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, registries, signing or attestation, SBOMs and software supply-chain frameworks.

* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Helm or similar.

* Experience with commercial AppSec platforms, vulnerability-management integrations or enterprise developer portals.

Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-availability environment.

Although the posting title is Jr AppSec Engineer, the management level requires mature judgement, credible stakeholder leadership and the ability to quality-review assurance decisions. The role remains technically grounded and must recognise when manual testing or specialist review is required.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead application and API discovery campaigns with technology, business and governance stakeholders; reconcile inventories, identify ownership gaps and define the population requiring AppSec oversight.

* Apply and improve risk-classification criteria using criticality, data, exposure, users, transactions, technology, regulatory relevance, threat and change to determine assurance depth and cadence.

* Review existing security evidence for control intent, scope, recency, testing method and applicability; reuse credible evidence and identify requirements that still need review or testing.

* Create proportionate assurance plans that combine existing evidence, questionnaires, design review, threat modelling, automated control results and specialist testing based on risk.

* Direct proportionate application security reviews, track completion and quality-review decisions with explicit conditions, assumptions and validity periods.

* Coordinate with AppSec testing, Red Team and DevSecOps colleagues when technical depth is required; ensure their output is incorporated into the assurance decision.

* Collaborate with architecture teams on security requirements and risk challenge without taking ownership of target architecture, solution design or design-authority decisions.

* Support threat-modelling and secure-design discussions, ensuring actions have owners and are reflected in delivery plans and acceptance criteria.

* Govern exceptions and risk acceptance: confirm accountable ownership, rationale, risk statement, compensating controls, remediation plan, expiry and required approval.

* Challenge weak or incomplete evidence and prevent administrative completion from being treated as security effectiveness.

* Maintain clear review records, decision logs and evidence traceability for governance, audit and regulatory review.

* Define metrics for population coverage, risk tiers, assessment status, evidence reuse, gaps, findings, remediation, exceptions and overdue decisions; explain trends and limitations.

* Prepare concise governance reporting and facilitate decisions with application owners, engineering leaders, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Audit.

Coach junior assurance staff, calibrate decisions across reviewers and improve standards, templates and playbooks using lessons from delivery.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Strong judgement in evidence sufficiency, control effectiveness, risk classification, exception quality and review conditions.

* Working knowledge of application architectures, web and API risk, threat modelling, secure development and automated security testing.

* Ability to translate between technical findings, control requirements, business impact and accountable risk decisions.

* Experience producing governance metrics and evidence that can withstand audit or regulatory challenge.

* Confident stakeholder facilitation and escalation, including the ability to challenge senior owners constructively.

* Strong written documentation, attention to traceability and ability to manage a sizeable portfolio.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated global organisation.

* Familiarity with control frameworks and secure development standards such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, ASVS, ISO 27001 or similar.

* Experience with GRC platforms, application inventories, work-management tools or evidence automation.

* Evidence of practical capability improving application security assurance or secure development practices.

Experience improving an assurance operating model or rationalising duplicate controls.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Be rigorous about evidence while making assurance proportionate to actual risk.

* Do not confuse process completion with an effective security outcome.

* State assumptions, gaps, conditions and decision ownership clearly; avoid ambiguous conclusions.

* Use metrics to support decisions and improvement, not to create false precision.

* Build trusted relationships and lead governance activity from the Hyderabad office.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

-

**About us:**

Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.

**What do we offer:**

FCDO team manages the implementation of best-in-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:

* **Data Governance**: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
* **Meta Data Management**: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
* **Data Ownership**: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
* **Issue Management**: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
* **Audit Support**: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
* **Data Certification**: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

**Expertise Required:**

Data/Information Mgt Sr Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM-based applications and AI agents.

**Metadata Management and Data Governance**

* **Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary:** Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
* **Data Lineage Mapping:** Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

**Data Profiling and Analysis**

* **Profiling Execution:** Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
* **Data Assessment:** Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

**Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring**

* **Rule Definition:** Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).
* **Rule Authoring/Implementation:** Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and preventative/detective controls using SQL, Python, or specialized DQ tools.
* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**

* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**

* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long-term solutions.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra

* Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
* Exposure to creating multi-agent orchestration

Good understanding of

* Banking domain (Cards, Deposit, Loans, Wealth management, & Insurance etc.)

* Data quality framework
* Risk & control Metrics

*(Preferred)* - Knowledge of Finance Regulations, Understanding of Audit Process

* Should have excellent communication and inter-personal skills

To be successful as a Resilience Recovery Lead ResOps**,** you should have experience with:

jobs.description:
**About Us**
Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.
  
  
We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.
  
  
**If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.**
**About Wealth And Retail Banking**
Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape with respect to Products and Solutions (Structured Products and other CMPS Products as may be assigned)
* Analyse data to identify opportunities and threats.
* Develop a clear product vision that aligns with the bank's overall strategy and goals.
* Create and maintain a product roadmap that outlines the key features, timelines, and milestones.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, and changes effectively to all stakeholders.

**Business**

* Revenue management
* Drive new business and strategic initiatives across different business segments within Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB)
* Drive product and platform innovation.
* Portfolio management

**Processes**

* Business owner in all related product platform
* Drive platform usage, client penetration efforts.
* Accountable for delivery of all product enhancements, project deliveries in terms of championing as business lead
* Manage operations, IT and middle office resources indirectly in terms of driving changes, delivery and strategy.

**Risk Management**

* Responsible for overseeing end to end product process through the product life cycle, including all risk management initiatives.

**Governance**

* Owns and responsible for Country Product Programme/Addendum and ensure alignment to the Group Product Programme
* Ensure compliance to internal and external governance standards and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in audits, manage regulatory incidents and communications on product and drive the process, product and system changes to minimise regulatory breaches.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**What’s the role?**

* Turn strategy into action: Translate business priorities, customer needs and product economics into clear product marketing plans with measurable outcomes.
* Build propositions that stand out: Develop compelling offers, proof points and messaging for priority customer segments.
* Bring campaigns to life: Own delivery from brief and targeting through content, approvals and launch across digital, CRM, paid, owned and social channels.
* Create better customer journeys: Design channel sequencing, lead experiences and fulfilment journeys that make it easier for customers to engage and convert.
* Own the social story: Plan product social media activity and manage content calendars, campaign moments, assets, approvals and publishing schedules.
* Let the data do the talking: Define KPIs and use funnel, campaign and customer data to understand what’s working, identify gaps and continuously optimise performance.
* Bring people together: Work closely with internal teams, agencies, vendors and external partners to deliver joined-up campaigns and co-brand activities.
* Keep things on track: Manage timelines, budgets, approvals, governance and dependencies while ensuring activity meets brand, legal, customer fairness and data privacy requirements.

**What do you bring?**

* Strong experience in product marketing, proposition development and go-to-market, ideally within financial services, a regulated industry or a complex product environment.
* Experience delivering integrated campaigns across digital, CRM, paid, owned and social channels.
* A strong understanding of customer journeys, segmentation, propositions, campaign planning and optimisation.
* Confidence using data to define KPIs, analyse funnels, interpret dashboards and turn insights into action.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, agencies, partners and vendors in a fast-moving environment.
* Strong commercial thinking, communication and influencing skills.
* The ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities independently while maintaining strong attention to detail.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline is preferred.
* Confidence using Microsoft 365 Copilot responsibly to support campaign planning, packs and trackers while protecting confidential information.

**Why Rakbank?**

* Because great product marketing doesn’t just promote products. It connects customer needs with opportunities that drive the business forward.
* Your ideas. Your impact. Your next move.
* Ready to turn insight into impact? Apply now.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the annual product marketing plan, campaign and social content calendars, budget inputs and portfolio roadmap in alignment with Marketing Planning.
* Translate business priorities, customer needs and product economics into clear, measurable marketing plans and outcomes.
* Develop differentiated propositions, offers, proof points and messaging for priority segments and manage end‑to‑end delivery.
* Design and orchestrate customer journeys, channel sequencing, lead experiences and fulfilment dependencies.
* Define KPIs, targets and reporting frameworks; monitor funnel performance and commercial results across engagement, leads, applications and conversion.
* Analyse audience, creative, channel and journey data to identify gaps, run tests and implement post‑campaign actions.
* Align internal teams, agencies and external partners around a unified campaign plan, including co‑brand objectives and approvals.
* Manage agencies, vendors and stakeholders, overseeing scope, timelines, budgets, quality and escalation of issues.
* Ensure compliance with brand, legal, customer fairness, data privacy and approval requirements; track spend and forecasts.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product marketing, proposition development and go‑to‑market experience, preferably in financial services or a regulated industry.
* Proven track record delivering integrated campaigns across digital, CRM, paid, owned and social channels with accountability for measurement and optimisation.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and managing agencies, partners and vendors in a matrix environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline (preferred).
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 Copilot for creating campaign plans, packs and trackers while safeguarding confidential information.
* Advanced skills in KPI design, funnel analysis, testing, dashboard interpretation and insight generation.
* Commercial acumen with excellent communication and influencing abilities to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines independently with high attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of digital, CRM, paid, owned and social channels, customer journeys, data privacy and marketing governance.

**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Bridge investment capabilities and client needs by translating market intelligence, competitor insight and distribution feedback into clear product priorities and commercial opportunities.
* Support product strategy, proposition development and go-to-market planning across the FAB Asset Management range, working with Investments, Product, Sales and Distribution.
* Act as a product specialist for client-facing teams by developing positioning, competitive comparisons and product narratives for institutional and distribution channels.
* Contribute directly to revenue growth through RFPs, due diligence questionnaires, client proposals, pitches and market-entry initiatives.
* Build systematic market intelligence and product analytics that inform management decisions, sales priorities and the mediumterm product roadmap.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market intelligence and competitive analysis: Monitor market trends, industry flows, client demand, regulatory developments and competitor activity across relevant asset classes, products and client segments; maintain structured benchmarking of product ranges, performance, fees, positioning and distribution models.
* Product strategy and roadmap: Convert market and client insight into product priorities, business cases and roadmap recommendations, highlighting addressable opportunities, capability gaps and commercial implications.
* Product proposition and positioning: Work with investment and product teams to shape investment propositions, target segments, differentiators, fee positioning and go-to-market narratives, while specialist functions retain ownership of legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation.
* Product specialist support: Serve as a link between portfolio managers and commercial teams, translating investment content into clear, client-relevant messages and equipping sales teams with product comparisons, talking points and responses to client objections.
* RFPs, DDQs and proposals: Lead or contribute to the product, strategy, market and competitive sections of RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and client proposals; coordinate inputs and maintain a reusable library of approved content and Q&A.
* Client and distribution engagement: Support institutional and distribution sales in client meetings, product pitches, product education and follow-up, providing credible technical and market context.
* Go-to-market and market entry: Develop market-entry assessments and go-to-market plans, including opportunity sizing, targetclient mapping, competitor analysis, positioning, pricing considerations and recommended actions.
* Product analytics and management reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, peer groups and analytical tools covering flows, performance, fees, ratings, market share and competitive positioning; produce clear management reporting and actionable recommendations.
* Cross-functional delivery: Coordinate multi-stakeholder initiatives across Investments, Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, managing dependencies and delivery timelines.
* Regulatory and regional awareness: Maintain current awareness of key UAE, Saudi and wider GCC asset-management developments and assess implications for products, distribution and commercial opportunities.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 7+ years in asset management, product strategy, product specialist, market intelligence, business development or a closely related role within regulated financial services.
* Product and market knowledge: Strong understanding of asset-management products, fund structures, distribution models and the drivers of product demand across institutional and intermediary channels.
* Market intelligence: Demonstrated experience using industry databases and analytical tools to assess market size, flows, competitor ranges, performance, fees, ratings and positioning.
* Commercial execution: Practical experience in RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, proposals, pitches and client engagement, with the ability to convert analysis into persuasive commercial content.
* Stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across investment, product, sales and control functions and to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Commercial judgement, analytical rigour, structured problem solving, executive communication, initiative, ownership and strong written English.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regional exposure: Experience across GCC markets is strongly preferred; international asset-management exposure is advantageous.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA, AMF or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

67113

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

17 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

01 December 2026

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

Credit & Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

We are currently seeking an ambitious professional to join the team as an Assistant Vice President who will provide credit advisory and support services to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage. This includes facilitating client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process

  

**In this role, you will:-**

* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds
* Drive continuous improvement in productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recommendations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators

**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**

  

* Proven expertise in corporate lending with strong analytical skills
* Must possess sound credit knowledge with proven skills of writing credit proposals
* Strong understanding of financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Tenacious with numbers – aptitude for analyzing and interpreting data.
* A trust earner – can listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* Committed to quality – high standards for work, solve problems so they are fixed and stay fixed.
* A critical thinker – can operate independently and use judgement in a dynamic environment.
* Attentive to detail and can apply professional skepticism – not afraid to challenge the status quo.
* Degree in Business, Finance or related field is highly desirable
* A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and/or work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

* Team & Technical Leadership

* Build a high-ownership, growth-oriented culture through effective feedback, coaching, and collaboration.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**
