* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly production performance and present operational reports to senior management.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management would be an added advantage.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
* Significant hands-on experience in forging operations and production management, preferably in a steel manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale manufacturing operations, production teams, and shop-floor activities.
* Strong understanding of forging processes, tooling, metallurgy, heat treatment, quality systems, and manufacturing technologies, as applicable.
* Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, cost control, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and deliver operational targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Rejection, rework, and scrap reduction.

* On-time delivery and adherence to production schedules.
* Workplace safety performance and compliance.
* Implementation of productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Credit & Operations Executive
jobs.description:
About Loan2Grow Fincap

Loan2Grow Fincap is a growing lending/financing company focused on providing responsible and accessible credit to underserved customer segments. As the business scales its lending operations, we are looking for a hands-on **Credit & Operations professional** who can support credit underwriting while also ensuring smooth execution of the loan lifecycle.

Role Overview

The Credit & Operations Executive will be responsible for **credit assessment, underwriting support, loan documentation and post-sanction operations**.

The ideal candidate should have experience working in an **NBFC, bank, fintech lender or other lending institution**, with a good understanding of retail/MSME lending processes. The person should be comfortable working across both **credit and operational activities**, maintaining accuracy and discipline while managing a growing loan portfolio.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced lending environment and wants exposure to the complete credit lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities1. Credit Underwriting

* Review and assess loan applications in accordance with the company's credit policy and underwriting guidelines.
* Analyse customer profiles, income/cash flows, bank statements, credit bureau reports and other relevant financial information.
* Assess customer repayment capacity, credit history, indebtedness and overall risk profile.
* Identify red flags, inconsistencies, potential fraud indicators and other credit risks.
* Conduct appropriate verification and validation of customer information and supporting documents.
* Prepare credit appraisal notes/recommendations for approval.
* Ensure that credit decisions are well documented and supported by appropriate analysis.
* Coordinate with sales/business teams to obtain missing information and resolve credit queries.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, approval authorities and internal controls.

2. Loan Documentation & Disbursement Operations

* Manage the documentation process for sanctioned loans.
* Verify KYC and other customer/loan documents before disbursement.
* Ensure execution and completeness of loan agreements and other required documentation.
* Coordinate with customers and internal teams for completion of documentation and disbursement conditions.
* Ensure that loan files are complete, accurate and properly maintained.
* Coordinate with relevant teams/vendors for e-signing, e-NACH/e-mandate setup and other digital loan processes.
* Track pending documentation and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.

3. Repayment & Mandate Management

* Manage and monitor **e-NACH/e-mandate registration and activation** for customers.
* Track mandate failures, re-presentations and other payment-related exceptions.
* Coordinate with customers and internal teams to resolve mandate/payment issues.
* Maintain accurate loan and repayment records.

4. Credit Bureau & Portfolio Operations

* Support periodic **credit bureau reporting** and ensure accurate submission of loan and repayment data.
* Review bureau reporting files/data for completeness and accuracy.
* Coordinate corrections for bureau reporting discrepancies and customer complaints.
* Support reconciliation of loan accounts, repayments and outstanding balances.
* Maintain operational MIS relating to disbursements, repayments, mandates, bureau reporting and other portfolio activities.

5. Loan Portfolio Administration

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date loan records across relevant systems.
* Monitor the status of loans from sanction through documentation, disbursement and repayment.
* Track operational exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate with collections, finance, technology and business teams wherever required.
* Support internal audits, portfolio reviews and management reporting.
* Help improve lending processes, controls and operational workflows as the business scales.

Candidate Profile

**Essential:**

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in **credit underwriting and/or credit operations**.
* Prior experience with an **NBFC, bank, fintech lender, HFC or other lending institution**.
* Hands-on experience in credit appraisal/underwriting.
* Good understanding of credit bureau reports and customer credit assessment.
* Experience with loan documentation and disbursement processes.
* Working knowledge of **e-NACH/e-mandates, KYC/document verification and credit bureau reporting**.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies and credit risks.
* Good Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of operational tasks.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in a small or mid-sized NBFC/fintech where the individual has handled multiple parts of the lending lifecycle.
* Experience with digital lending/LMS/LOS platforms.
* Experience handling bureau corrections, mandate failures and operational reconciliations.
* Exposure to retail, MSME, asset finance or other secured/unsecured lending products.
* Experience working in a fast-growing lending business.

Key Skills

* Credit underwriting
* Financial and cash-flow analysis
* Credit bureau analysis
* KYC and document verification
* Loan documentation
* Loan disbursement operations
* e-NACH/e-mandate management
* Credit bureau reporting
* Loan account reconciliation
* MIS and reporting
* Excel/Google Sheets
* Risk identification
* Attention to detail
* Cross-functional coordination

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands-on, detail-oriented and comfortable owning tasks end-to-end**.

The ideal candidate is not someone who only reviews credit files. They should be willing and able to work across the lending process—from **application assessment and underwriting to documentation, disbursement, mandates, bureau reporting and portfolio operations**.

Candidates who have worked in an NBFC/fintech lending environment and have had exposure to both **credit and operations** will be particularly suitable.

Location

**Lucknow, UP**

Experience

**2–3 years of relevant experience**

Reporting

The position will work closely with the **Credit/Business Head and senior management** and coordinate with business, finance, collections and technology teams.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Executive – Loan Agreements, eNACH & EMI Servicing
jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Operations – Customer Servicing  
**Designation:** Customer Operations Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, UP  
**Reporting to:** Head of Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, office-based

**Salary: As per suitability and experience (Fixed + Performance Incentive)**

1. About the Role

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is looking for a Customer Operations Executive to manage customer communication and follow-ups for loan agreements, eNACH registration, onboarding formalities and routine EMI servicing across its lending products.

The role will ensure that customers receive timely assistance in completing loan formalities, understand their repayment obligations and receive reminders and support throughout the loan lifecycle.

The position requires strong communication skills, disciplined follow-up, customer empathy and accurate record-keeping. The candidate will work closely with the Operations, KYC, Documentation and Finance teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Loan Agreement Follow-up

* Contact customers to facilitate the completion and execution of loan agreements and other required formalities.
* Explain documentation requirements and guide customers through the approved process.
* Follow up on pending signatures, declarations, confirmations and other customer-dependent actions.
* Record customer responses, pending items, expected completion dates and next follow-up actions in the designated system.
* Coordinate with team when documentation is incomplete, incorrect or requires verification.

B. eNACH / Repayment Mandate Follow-up

* Guide customers through eNACH, NACH or other approved electronic repayment mandate registration processes.
* Follow up on pending, rejected or unsuccessful mandate registrations.
* Help customers navigate registration links and routine technical issues, escalating unresolved problems to the appropriate team.
* Track customer actions and update the system with the latest follow-up status.
* Coordinate with team, who is responsible for verifying mandate completion and ensuring that the correct status and supporting evidence are recorded in the loan system.

C. Customer Handholding & Servicing

* Act as a point of contact for routine customer queries relating to loan formalities, repayment schedules, EMI due dates and approved payment channels.
* Make outbound calls and follow up through company-approved communication channels.
* Explain processes patiently to customers with varying levels of digital literacy.
* Resolve routine queries and route credit, account reconciliation, policy exceptions and grievances to the designated team.
* Maintain professional, respectful and customer-friendly communication.

D. Routine EMI Reminders & Payment Follow-up

* Contact customers with reminders ahead of EMI due dates and on the due date, following the approved reminder calendar.
* Follow up on routine payment delays and failed transactions.
* Guide customers towards approved repayment methods and escalate unresolved payment or reconciliation issues.
* Record payment-related conversations, customer commitments and next actions.
* Transfer overdue accounts meeting the company’s approved collections escalation criteria to the designated collections owner.

This role focuses on routine servicing and preventive reminders. It does not independently approve payment concessions, waive charges, restructure loans or make credit decisions.

E. Coordination & MIS

* Maintain accurate call logs, customer interaction records and follow-up trackers linked to the relevant loan/application ID.
* Track pending agreements, eNACH actions, unsuccessful contact attempts, EMI reminder coverage and customer service issues.
* Share daily updates and weekly status reports with the Head of Operations.
* Coordinate with team for documentation and mandate verification, for KYC/onboarding gaps, and Finance for payment-related queries.
* Ensure every pending case has a clear next action, follow-up date and responsible owner.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Approximately 1–3 years of experience in customer support, telecalling, loan operations, banking, NBFCs, fintech or repayment servicing.
* Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email and customer management systems.
* Prior experience with loan agreements, eNACH/NACH mandates, EMI reminders or digital lending operations will be an advantage.

4. Required Skills

* Strong verbal communication and telephone etiquette.
* Patience and the ability to explain digital processes clearly.
* Disciplined follow-up and time management.
* Attention to detail and accurate data entry.
* Ability to manage multiple customer cases and meet timelines.
* Problem-solving, coordination and escalation skills.
* Professional conduct, confidentiality and sensitivity to customer information.

5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be assessed against agreed targets, including:

* Timely follow-up on pending loan agreements.
* eNACH/NACH follow-up completion and reduction in customer-action pendency.
* Coverage and timeliness of scheduled EMI reminders.
* Resolution or escalation of failed-payment cases within defined timelines.
* Accuracy and completeness of call logs and customer interaction records.
* Customer query handling and service quality.
* Compliance with approved communication, privacy and customer-protection procedures.

Targets will be established based on product mix, customer volumes and operational service-level requirements. Customer contact attempts alone will not be treated as proof of agreement or mandate completion.

6. Working Conditions

* Full-time, office-based position in Lucknow, UP
* Regular coordination with internal teams and, where applicable, institutional or platform partners.
* Work schedules and customer-contact timings will follow company policy and applicable requirements.
* Working Days - Monday to Saturday

7. Application Process

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with current compensation, expected compensation, notice period and relevant experience in customer servicing, telecalling or lending operations.

**Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited** seeks candidates who demonstrate customer empathy, reliability, accuracy and accountability.

Pay: From ₹10,000.00 per month

jobs.title: Collections Executive (Telecalling)
jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Collections & Portfolio Management  
**Designation:** Collections Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Reporting to:** Collections Manager / Head of Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Salary: As per suitability and experience (Fixed + Performance Incentive)**

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financing company focused on providing responsible and accessible credit to underserved customer segments. The company offers lending solutions across multiple customer segments and is expanding its lending operations.

As our loan portfolio grows, we are strengthening our collections team to ensure timely repayment, proactive customer engagement and effective management of overdue accounts.

2. About the Role

We are looking for proactive and target-oriented **Collections Executives** who have hands-on experience in telecalling-based loan collections and repayment follow-ups.

The selected candidates will be responsible for contacting customers before and after EMI due dates, following up on overdue payments, securing repayment commitments and ensuring that customers make payments through approved repayment channels.

The role requires strong telephone communication skills, persistence, negotiation abilities and disciplined follow-up. Candidates should be comfortable handling a high volume of outbound calls and managing multiple overdue customer accounts simultaneously.

This is primarily a desk-based collections role involving telecalling and digital follow-ups. No routine field collection responsibility is envisaged.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Telecalling-Based Collections

* Make outbound calls to customers for EMI reminders and repayment follow-ups.
* Contact customers with upcoming, due and overdue instalments.
* Follow up consistently with customers who have missed their repayment deadlines.
* Communicate outstanding amounts, overdue instalments and applicable payment timelines accurately.
* Persuade and encourage customers to clear their pending dues through approved repayment channels.
* Maintain regular communication with customers until the payment is received or the account is escalated.
* Handle customer objections and repayment-related concerns professionally.

B. Payment Commitment & Follow-up Management

* Obtain clear repayment commitments from customers, including expected payment dates.
* Maintain a daily tracker of customer commitments and promised payment dates.
* Reconnect with customers who fail to honour their repayment commitments.
* Prioritise follow-ups based on overdue duration, outstanding amounts and collection priorities.
* Ensure that every overdue account has a documented follow-up status and next action.
* Escalate customers who are repeatedly unresponsive or unwilling to repay.

C. Overdue Account Management

* Manage assigned overdue customer accounts and ensure timely follow-up.
* Track accounts across different DPD (Days Past Due) buckets as assigned.
* Identify reasons for delayed payments, including financial difficulties, payment failures, technical issues or customer disputes.
* Coordinate with the operations and finance teams to verify payments and resolve reconciliation issues.
* Escalate accounts requiring additional intervention to the Collections Manager.
* Support early-stage delinquency management to reduce the movement of accounts into higher overdue buckets.

D. Customer Communication & Query Resolution

* Explain repayment obligations and available approved payment channels to customers.
* Guide customers through payment processes where required.
* Handle routine repayment queries and payment-related complaints.
* Maintain a professional, respectful and firm approach during customer interactions.
* Ensure all communication follows company-approved collection practices, customer protection standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Avoid unauthorised commitments regarding waivers, settlement, restructuring or changes in repayment terms.

E. MIS, Reporting & Coordination

* Maintain accurate records of calls, customer responses, payment commitments and collection outcomes.
* Update collection systems and daily follow-up trackers.
* Prepare daily collection reports covering:
* Total accounts assigned.
* Accounts contacted.
* Successful customer connections.
* Payment commitments obtained.
* Commitments honoured and missed.
* Amount collected.
* Outstanding overdue accounts.
* Track individual collection performance against assigned targets.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment confirmation and reconciliation.
* Share daily performance updates with the Collections Manager / Head of Operations.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential:**

* Graduate in any discipline (12th-pass candidates with strong relevant experience may also be considered).
* 1–3 years of experience in telecalling-based collections.
* Prior experience in loan collections with an NBFC, bank, fintech lender, microfinance institution or other financial services organisation.
* Hands-on experience in making outbound collection calls and following up on overdue loan accounts.
* Experience handling repayment commitments, missed EMIs and delinquent customers.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to work with daily targets and collection performance metrics.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in digital lending, personal loans, MSME loans, consumer loans or other retail lending products.
* Experience handling high-volume telecalling collections.
* Familiarity with DPD buckets, collection efficiency and overdue portfolio monitoring.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Experience in early-stage and bucket-based collections.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong verbal communication and telephone etiquette.
* Persuasion and negotiation skills.
* Confidence in handling difficult customer conversations.
* Persistence and disciplined follow-up.
* Ability to manage high call volumes.
* Target orientation and result focus.
* Customer handling and objection resolution.
* Basic Excel and MIS reporting.
* Attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.
* Ability to work under time-bound collection targets.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against agreed collection targets and operational quality parameters, including:

* Collection amount achieved against assigned targets.
* Collection efficiency across assigned overdue accounts.
* Percentage of overdue accounts successfully contacted.
* Payment commitment-to-realisation ratio.
* Follow-up coverage of assigned accounts.
* Reduction in repeat payment defaults and overdue ageing.
* Timely follow-up on missed payment commitments.
* Accuracy and completeness of collection MIS.
* Adherence to approved collection policies and customer communication standards.

Targets will be assigned based on portfolio size, loan product, overdue buckets and the number of accounts allocated to each executive.

7. Important Expectations

We are looking for candidates who:

* Have actual experience in loan collections over telephone, rather than only customer service or general telecalling.
* Are comfortable making a large number of outbound calls every day.
* Can confidently handle customers who delay or avoid repayment.
* Understand the importance of continuous follow-up until payment realisation.
* Can manage individual collection targets and take ownership of assigned accounts.
* Maintain professionalism and follow ethical collection practices.

**This is a calling-based collections position. Candidates with only sales or lead-generation telecalling experience, without loan repayment collection exposure, may not be suitable.**

8. Working Conditions

* Full-time, office-based position in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Data and AI Lead who is passionate about turning data into products and decisions, and wants to work in a disruptive, fast-growing and exciting environment. Every transaction on our network tells us something about what customers want, which products perform in which markets and how our partners can grow. This role will bring that intelligence together and put it to work across the business.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working closely with the leadership team, product, engineering and commercial teams, you will set the direction for how DT One uses data, analytics and AI, build the team to deliver it, and make sure it has a measurable impact on growth and profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, commercially minded leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own data and AI end to end, from strategy and platforms through to the products, insights and automation that our teams and partners use every day.
  
  

* Define and drive the data and AI strategy and roadmap, making sure it is aligned with commercial, product and technology priorities
* Build, lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team across data engineering, data science and machine learning, analytics and data governance
* Own the data platform, bringing together transaction, product and partner data into a trusted, scalable foundation for real-time and batch analytics
* Deliver data and AI products that drive growth, such as product recommendations, pricing and demand insights, partner performance analytics, and fraud and anomaly detection
* Lead the adoption of AI, including generative AI, to automate operations and improve decision-making across the business

* The ability to translate business goals into a clear data roadmap, and to communicate with and influence senior stakeholders

We can offer you an environment with a culture of learning and feedback. You will have real ownership of data and AI across a network that operates 24/7 around the world, with the scope to build a team and shape how the business makes decisions. You will work with teams in different countries, and our environment and packages match the ambition of the company: building world-class teams.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.

jobs.title: ED - Head, Margin & Collateral Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director – Global Head, Margin and Collateral Operations is accountable for the global end-to-end delivery, control and transformation of the Bank’s uncleared margin and collateral franchise across non-centrally cleared derivatives, repo, securities borrowing and lending, structured financing, commodities, precious metals and other collateralised businesses.
* The role owns Initial Margin, Variation Margin, Independent Amount, portfolio reconciliation, dispute management, collateral allocation, settlement, interest, static data, reconciliations, reporting and exception management across the full lifecycle—from legal-agreement and counterparty onboarding through daily exposure calculation, margin exchange and collateral return.
* The role ensures compliance with applicable uncleared margin, segregation, portfolio-reconciliation, dispute-reporting, client-asset, liquidity and books-and-records obligations across all relevant jurisdictions and legal entities, and is accountable for timely, evidenced delivery of regulatory, audit, assurance and risk-remediation commitments.
* The role leads the global target operating model, people strategy and investment roadmap to deliver upcoming global and local margin regulations, maintain compliance with existing requirements through adequate preventive and detective controls, and resolve conflicts between global standards and local regulatory, legal-entity, currency, custody and settlement obligations. The role is accountable for evolving MARS into the Bank’s strategic straight-through and zero-touch collateral management solution, enabling artificial intelligence and effective integration with industry utilities and vendors, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, while supporting digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto and other new-business requirements across Asia and the wider Bank.

Strategy
  
  

* Define and execute the global strategy for uncleared Margin and Collateral Operations, aligned with Global Markets Operations, business growth, counterparty credit-risk mitigation, liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Own the forward regulatory roadmap for global and local margin reforms, translating emerging rules into coordinated legal, client, model, process, technology, custody, settlement, finance and control deliverables while sustaining compliance with existing regulations.
* Establish a scalable target operating model with global process ownership, follow-the-sun delivery, resilient location strategy, clear service segmentation and effective capacity planning.
* Set the strategic direction for MARS as the Bank’s authoritative collateral management platform, delivering end-to-end straight-through processing and zero-touch processing across calculation, margin exchange, allocation, settlement, reconciliation, reporting and exception management.
* Own the multi-year transformation and investment roadmap for standardisation, artificial intelligence, real-time settlement transparency, collateral optimisation, common data, strategic platform integration and controlled decommissioning of legacy processes and systems without service or control degradation.
* Establish strategic partnerships and interoperable solutions with global vendors and industry utilities, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, to increase automation, strengthen portfolio reconciliation and dispute management, and support exception-led operations.
* Set measurable outcomes covering regulatory compliance, margin timeliness, settlement success, disputes, reconciliations, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, client service, collateral utilisation, funding efficiency and financial-data accuracy.
* Anticipate regulatory, market, product and infrastructure developments and ensure the operating model remains controlled, scalable and fit for global flow business and complex local or bespoke requirements.

Business
  
  

* Act as the senior global Operations owner for uncleared margin and collateral services, maintaining effective service across products, legal entities, regions and client segments.
* Partner with Trading, XVA, Treasury, Repo, Prime, Product, Sales and Client Coverage to enable new clients, products, markets and bespoke structures with transparent operational readiness, risk assessment, approvals, capacity and controls.
* Lead the operational enablement of digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto, crypto spot, crypto derivatives and other emerging business propositions, ensuring appropriate agreement structures, segregated or cross-service margin treatment, settlement, custody, valuation, reconciliation, reporting and risk controls.
* Support the Bank’s growth across diverse Asian markets by delivering scalable solutions for local currencies, local custodians, domestic settlement infrastructure, country-specific collateral rules and bespoke regulatory margin requirements.
* Protect the Bank from counterparty credit, liquidity, market, conduct, operational, regulatory and reputational impacts arising from ineffective margining, collateralisation, disputes or settlement.
* Maximise utilisation of the Bank’s collateral inventory through eligibility, concentration, substitutions, intragroup margining, cross-product opportunities and cheapest-to-deliver allocation, while ensuring optimal funding, liquidity, legal-entity and regulatory outcomes.
* Represent Margin and Collateral Operations in senior business, client, risk, governance, audit and investment forums, providing clear decisions and escalation on material matters.

**Processes**

* Own the global control and service framework for agreement onboarding and static data; trade and valuation feeds; IM, VM and Independent Amount calculation; SIMM; margin issuance and response; dispute investigation; collateral selection and movement; interest; substitutions; returns; reconciliations; and reporting.
* Ensure margin calls and collateral movements are complete, accurate, timely and consistent with legal terms, credit requirements, settlement instructions, eligibility schedules, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, haircuts and concentration limits.
* Deliver change for new and amended global margin regulations and local addenda, including impact assessment, requirements interpretation, controls, documentation, client repapering, model approval, custody and settlement readiness, testing, training, implementation and post-go-live assurance.
* Design and operate a defensible framework for conflicting global and local requirements, with documented rule hierarchy, legal and compliance interpretation, country-specific configurations, approvals, traceability and evidence that each applicable obligation is met.
* Enhance MARS and its upstream and downstream interfaces to enable STP and ZTP processing, AI-supported ingestion and exception analysis, real-time connectivity with TriOptima and AcadiaSoft where appropriate, and controlled handling of clients or markets that cannot use industry utilities.
* Provide real-time or near-real-time settlement status for cash and securities, with end-to-end acknowledgement, fail management, aged-item escalation and reconciled views across MARS, settlement platforms, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely feeds of collateral positions, valuations, movements, interest, encumbrance and accounting attributes to Finance, Aspire and other downstream liquidity, ledger, regulatory and management-reporting systems, supported by controls and reconciliations.
* Maintain a robust portfolio-reconciliation and dispute-management model with risk-based prioritisation, ageing, escalation, regulatory reporting and accountable root-cause remediation.
* Establish complete reconciliations across margin systems, trade platforms, settlement systems, Finance, Aspire, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records; ensure all breaks are risk-assessed, owned, aged and resolved with

jobs.title: Senior Vice President- Regional Head- South India-MSF IWPB
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the regional sales strategy for the Mobile Sales Force, delivering sustainable growth across customer acquisition, retail assets, liabilities, cards, personal loans, investments, insurance, foreign exchange and other relevant products.
* Acquire and deepen relationships with Premier and Advance customers, including New to Bank customers, through coordinated sales across liabilities, wealth and lending products.
* Deliver revenue, volume, productivity and profitability targets while maintaining disciplined control of acquisition costs, overheads and resource allocation.
* Build a customer-centric, high-performing regional sales organisation by integrating product teams, strengthening sales management practices and driving consistent service standards.
* Identify market opportunities, customer needs and competitor activity, using insights to refine regional plans, improve distribution reach and develop new revenue opportunities.
* Partner with branches, Direct, Wealth and other Group businesses to maximise referrals, customer migration and relationship opportunities, including corporate employee programmes and third-party distribution partnerships.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional sales team, fostering an inclusive, collaborative and performance-driven culture with clear accountability for results and customer outcomes.
* Own the end-to-end sales and customer onboarding process, ensuring a consistent customer experience and timely resolution of service issues.
* Maintain effective governance and controls across sales operations, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, Group standards, Financial Crime Compliance requirements and internal procedures.
* Identify, assess and mitigate operational, fraud, credit, conduct and reputational risks; ensure control weaknesses, audit findings and regulatory issues are addressed promptly.
* Work closely with Credit, Collections, Fraud, Compliance and other stakeholders to maintain portfolio quality, minimise delinquencies and support responsible growth.
* Ensure mandatory training, accreditation and compliance objectives are completed by the team within required timelines.

**Qualifications / Skills**

* Postgraduate qualification in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Typically 5–10 years’ experience in retail banking, wealth management, financial services sales or a related commercial environment.
* Proven experience leading a geographically dispersed sales force and managing managers or large, multi-product sales teams.
* Strong track record in customer acquisition, relationship deepening, revenue growth and delivery of business targets.
* Experience across retail banking products such as deposits, lending, cards, investments, insurance and foreign exchange.
* Strong commercial and financial management skills, including productivity, profitability, acquisition-cost and expense management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional sales strategies using market, customer and competitor insights.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to improve onboarding, service quality, loyalty and retention.
* Effective coaching, people leadership and change-management skills, with the ability to build a collaborative and performance-led culture.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across branches, product teams, wealth, corporate banking, operations, risk and control functions.
* Sound understanding of operational risk, conduct, fraud prevention, credit quality, Anti-Money Laundering, customer due diligence and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to establish robust governance, monitor controls and ensure timely remediation of issues.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and decision-making skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability and commitment to responsible customer and business outcomes.
* Proficiency in using management information, sales-performance metrics and data to drive decisions and improve productivity.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence Services
jobs.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Global O2C Head / Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for the global Order-to-Cash organization, with end-to-end accountability for service delivery, working-capital performance, client outcomes, financial performance, transformation, productivity and talent.
  
  
The role will lead a large-scale global O2C organization covering billing, accounts receivable, credit management, collections, cash application, dispute management, deductions and customer account management.
  
  
The leader will be responsible not only for operational excellence but also for transforming O2C into a technology-enabled, data-driven and increasingly autonomous cash-management capability.
  
  
The role will partner with CFOs, Controllers, Treasurers, Sales, Commercial, Customer Experience, Operations, Technology, Transformation and Global Delivery leadership.
  
  
**Experience Required:**

* 18–25+ years of Finance / O2C experience.
* Significant global O2C leadership experience.
* Experience managing large-scale global delivery organizations.
* Strong GCC / GBS / Shared Services / BPO experience.
* Proven working-capital and DSO improvement track record.
* Strong client-facing and commercial experience.
* P&L or financial-management accountability.
* Experience leading large transformation programs.
* Strong exposure to AI, automation and digital O2C.
* Scale Experience

**Preferred:**

* 500+ O2C professionals
* Multi-country operations
* Multi-client environment
* Large managed-services / GCC portfolio
* Significant revenue and margin responsibility
* Large-scale transformation programs
* Global O2C Leadership

Own the end-to-end O2C portfolio covering: Establish globally standardized processes, policies, controls, SLAs and operating procedures.
  
  

* Customer master / customer onboarding
* Credit management
* Order management interface
* Billing and invoicing
* Accounts Receivable
* Collections
* Cash application
* Customer account reconciliation
* Dispute management
* Deductions management
* Credit & risk management
* Bad-debt management
* Write-offs
* Month-end AR close and reporting
* P&L & Commercial Accountability

Own or significantly influence the financial performance of the O2C business, including:
  
  

* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Cost-to-serve
* Productivity
* Pricing
* Transformation benefits

Partner with Sales and Commercial teams on:
  
  

* New business
* Renewals
* Expansions
* Cross-sell
* Pricing
* Solution design The leader must balance:

Revenue + Margin + Cash + Customer Experience
  
  

* Working Capital & Cash Performance
* This is a critical differentiator for the O2C leadership role.
* Establish a global Cash & Working Capital Performance Council with Finance, Treasury, Sales and Operations.
* The leader should be able to demonstrate measurable improvement in cash conversion and working capital, not merely SLA performance.
* Billing & Revenue Enablement

Own the transformation of billing operations to improve:
  
  

* Billing accuracy
* First-Time-Right
* Invoice acceptance
* Billing cycle time
* Electronic invoicing
* Contract-to-bill integration
* Revenue leakage prevention
* Customer experience
* Partner with Sales, Commercial and Operations to eliminate upstream causes of billing failure.
* Dispute & Deduction Management

Create a globally standardized dispute-management model.
  
  
Focus on:
  
  

* Dispute prevention
* Root-cause analytics
* Automated classification
* Ownership and accountability
* Resolution TAT
* Deduction recovery
* Aged dispute reduction
* Revenue leakage prevention
* The objective should be to move from managing disputes to eliminating their root causes.
* Cash Application

Drive high levels of automation in cash application.
  
  
Focus on:
  
  

* Auto-matching
* Remittance capture
* Predictive matching
* Exception management
* Unapplied cash reduction
* Faster cash visibility
* Customer account reconciliation
* Target an increasingly touchless cash-application environment.
* GCC / Global Delivery Strategy

Play a key role in expanding and optimizing the global O2C delivery footprint.
  
  
Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Build Centers of Excellence.
* Establish global process ownership.
* Develop country-specific talent strategies.
* Establish global governance.
* The leader should be capable of taking O2C through: Design → Transition → Stabilize → Standardize → Automate → Scale
* Transformation & Intelligent O2C

Own the O2C transformation roadmap.
  
  
**Key areas:**

* GenAI
* Agentic AI
* Predictive collections
* Intelligent cash application
* AI-powered dispute resolution
* Digital billing
* Process mining
* Workflow automation
* Customer self-service
* Predictive cash forecasting
* Revenue leakage analytics
* Autonomous O2C The strategic ambition should be:

Traditional O2C → Digital O2C → Intelligent O2C → Autonomous Cash Management

Act as the senior operational executive for strategic global clients.
  
  
Own:
  
  

* Executive governance

* Continuous improvement
* Develop relationships beyond the Finance Operations team with CFOs, Treasurers, Controllers, CROs and Commercial leaders.

jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

Experience Level: Senior (12+ years consulting delivery)

Employment Type: Full-Time

A leader who is technically credible, commercially savvy and client obsessed. Balance consulting rigor (scope, schedule, budget) with technical excellence and client success. Comfortable managing multiple concurrent engagements; skilled at converting client problems into delivery roadmaps and winning P&L outcomes. Bring hands-on knowledge of Data Engineering, AI/ML delivery, and payments infrastructure. Mentor delivery teams, build bench capacity, and foster consulting excellence. A trusted advisor to clients, champion for your teams, and owner of firm economics.

**Role Overview**

* Lead consulting engagements for a fast-growing fintech/payment consulting firm. Own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-year client projects across Fixed Price (FP), Time & Materials (T&M), and Outcome-based models.
* Manage project portfolios, lead cross-functional teams (engineers, architects, data scientists), drive client success, and ensure profitability.
* Requires deep technical credibility in payments infrastructure, database systems, AI/ML integration, regulatory compliance, and consulting delivery methodology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own delivery and commercial success of 2- 4 concurrent engagements; manage $2M-$10M+ project portfolios
* Drive project scoping, estimation, and resource planning; manage change orders and scope creep
* Establish SOWs, success criteria, and delivery roadmaps; communicate status through executive-level reporting
* Own P&L accountability; monitor utilization, billing, and profitability metrics
* Lead production deployments and handoff to client operations teams

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead technical strategy for payments/fintech infrastructure projects (migrations, API modernization, compliance automation)
* Own delivery of database architecture initiatives (schema design, data modeling, large-scale migrations)
* Lead AI/ML and automation projects (fraud detection, risk scoring, ML ops, agentic workflows)
* Write technical specifications, acceptance criteria, and implementation guides
* Advise clients on architecture trade-offs, technology selection, and compliance requirements

**Consulting Delivery Excellence**

* Establish and enforce consulting delivery methodology (agile, waterfall, hybrid) tailored to engagement model
* Define project intake, scoping, risk management, and QA standards
* Create playbooks for data migrations, system integrations, platform implementations, and AI/ML pilots
* Track schedule, budget, and resources; escalating risks and propose mitigation strategies
