**Role Overview:**

Mizuho America’s Model Risk Management is the firm’s second line of defense and is responsible for managing model risk generated via the firm’s various entities and corporate functions. The group is tasked with establishing and implementing an SR 26-2 consistent risk management framework by which the firm’s model inventory is effectively challenged and validated. The group is also tasked with managing model risk governance, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. Mizuho seeks a highly motivated individual to serve as a Director, responsible for building and leading Model Risk team at the Mizuho Pune office. The role reports locally to the Mizuho Pune Head of Risk and globally to the Head of Model Risk Management within America’s Risk Management department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Establish and lead the Model Risk capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
* Build and lead a high-performing Pune Model Risk team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk-management hub.
* Act as the senior Model Risk point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global Model Risk teams.
* Manage a team of validation specialists, focusing on Pricing/Valuation models for Equity and Fixed Income Derivatives, XVA and other related models, providing guidance as necessary to ensure that the most robust independent review and challenge is possible
* Train and develop junior team members focusing on overlapping areas of expertise within the team, independence of view, and vocal challenge
* Design, build, and manage Model Risk workflow management, including AI tools, to assist in the efficient execution of the group's framework.
* Assist in maintaining a strong model governance framework, working with management and model owners to ensure maximum alignment with regulatory and policy requirements

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience Qualifications:**

* 18-20+ years of experience in financial services with specific experience in Model Risk
* Solid understanding of risk management concepts
* Working knowledge of SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance on model risk management
* Strong management skills with experience in managing quants while maintaining strong relationships with management and business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience in responding to audit and regulatory requests
* Impeccable attention to detail and a high standard of polish with regards to documentation and presentation materials

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

**About Us**

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.

* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.

* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

* + all statutory and regulatory HR compliance obligations for all branch locations (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Bengaluru & GIFT City)

**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Designation:** Accounts Coordinator  
**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Head/CA  
**Location:** Ghatkopar / Head Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Senior Accounts Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting day-to-day accounting and finance activities, ensuring accurate accounting records, timely reconciliations, statutory compliance, vendor/customer coordination and preparation of financial and MIS reports.

The role requires strong coordination with internal departments, vendors, customers, banks, auditors and external consultants to ensure smooth and timely completion of accounting activities.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Accounting Operations

* Handle day-to-day accounting transactions, including purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries.
* Verify invoices, vouchers and supporting documents before accounting.
* Maintain accurate ledgers and accounting records.
* Monitor Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Ensure proper accounting of expenses, provisions and accruals.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly and yearly closing of accounts.
* Support preparation and finalisation of financial statements.

B. Reconciliation & Control

* Prepare and review Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).
* Perform customer, vendor and general ledger reconciliations.
* Identify and resolve outstanding and unreconciled items.
* Reconcile GST input/output balances with books and available GST data.
* Monitor advances, outstanding receivables and payables.
* Ensure proper documentation and accounting controls.

C. GST & TDS Compliance

* Prepare data and working for GST returns and coordinate with consultants for timely filing.
* Verify GST applicability, input tax credit and tax-related entries.
* Prepare TDS workings and ensure correct deduction as applicable.
* Coordinate for timely TDS payment, returns and reconciliation.
* Maintain records related to GST, TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Assist in responding to statutory notices and queries, wherever required.

D. Vendor & Customer Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices, payments, outstanding balances and account statements.
* Coordinate with customers for outstanding payments and reconciliation.
* Obtain missing invoices, debit/credit notes and supporting documents.
* Resolve accounting discrepancies with respective departments and external parties.
* Maintain proper records of vendor and customer communications.

E. Banking & Payments

* Coordinate with banks for routine banking activities.
* Prepare payment-related documents and supporting schedules.
* Verify bank transactions and ensure timely accounting.
* Assist in NEFT/RTGS/cheque payment processes as per company approval procedures.
* Follow up on pending banking and payment-related matters.

F. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic Accounts MIS reports as required by management.
* Prepare ageing reports for receivables and payables.
* Prepare outstanding, collection and payment status reports.
* Provide financial data and analysis to the Accounts Manager / Finance Head.
* Maintain trackers for statutory payments, reconciliations and important accounting deadlines.

G. Audit & Compliance Support

* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Provide accounting records, ledgers, reconciliations and supporting documents for audits.
* Assist in preparation of audit schedules and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of financial and statutory records.

H. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase, Sales, Stores, HR, Administration and other departments for accounting-related requirements.
* Ensure timely receipt of documents required for accounting and compliance.
* Follow up with respective departments for pending documents and approvals.
* Support the Accounts Manager / Finance Head in special assignments and process improvements.

3. Required Qualification

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* CA Inter / CMA Inter will be an added advantage.

4. Experience

* **3–10 years of relevant experience** in Accounts & Finance.
* Experience in a manufacturing / trading / corporate environment will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong hands-on experience in Tally and statutory compliance will be preferred.

5. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
* Hands-on knowledge of **Tally ERP / Tally Prime** or similar accounting software.
* Good knowledge of **GST and TDS**.
* Strong knowledge of Bank, Vendor, Customer and Ledger Reconciliation.
* Good command of **MS Excel**, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS and basic financial reporting.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.
* Timely completion of bank, vendor and customer reconciliations.
* Timely submission of GST/TDS data and compliance workings.
* Reduction of outstanding unreconciled items.
* Timely preparation of MIS and management reports.
* Timely resolution of vendor/customer accounting discrepancies.
* Audit readiness and timely submission of audit documents.
* Compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls.

7. Behavioural Competencies

* Ownership and accountability
* Strong coordination and follow-up
* Integrity and confidentiality
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability
* Time management
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹49,500.00 per month

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.

* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.

**Job Purpose:**

To lead EDB’s investment and funding strategy by managing multi-asset portfolios and optimizing capital deployment across fixed income, equities, and private equity. The role ensures efficient liquidity and cost of funds through structured funding solutions, including public/private issuances and repo facilities. It also involves overseeing portfolio performance, regulatory compliance, and execution of investment and funding activities aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives, while driving cross-functional collaboration and revenue growth.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Formulate, evaluate and implement investment policies, guidelines, asset allocation, selection of external investment managers, risk management, compliance monitoring and rebalancing through advanced planning and management of investment risk at strategic, managerial and operational levels.
* Manage the investment portfolios, analyze market trends and economic indicators as well as execute trades based on their analysis.
* Construct and continuously manage the fixed income portfolios within the approved parameters to generate alpha (risk-adjusted return) for the bank.
* Utilize cash flow planning for the funds and investments across a multi-year time horizon to assist in strategic decision-making.
* Align investment goals with the overall objectives of the bank and position portfolios accordingly.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis of the private equity portfolio, coupled with arranging quarterly performance calls with their senior management teams, attending AGMs, developing exit strategies (where required), and apprising EDB management periodically.
* Assess the funding needs of the bank, develop funding strategies, source potential investors, and formulate capital structure strategies to advise on capital investment decision making and ensure compliance with financial regulation.
* Choose the most cost-efficient effective funding solutions for the bank to minimize CoF while continuously revamping the mix to achieve optimum results
* Grow the short-term financing tools and manage liquidity of the bank by establishing a Repo framework in accordance with GMRA guidelines to optimize returns or to raise funding using fixed income securities
* Execute all tasks related to any existing or new issuances by the bank (public or private), including deliberations with the JLMs (Joint Lead Managers), external counsels and auditors, securities exchanges, regulators, rating agencies, etc.

**Operational Responsibilities:**

* Originate, price, execute, book, manage and monitor investments like Fixed Income securities, Listed and Unlisted Equities, Repo and Reverse Repos and other investments.
* Assess the bank’s cash positioning, including forecasts, and recommend ways to utilize idle funds by identifying potential investment opportunities
* Anticipate interest rate shifts and optimize trade timing to secure favorable terms with brokers and banks while negotiating terms like interest rates, yield, pricing, before making any investment decisions, ensuring alignment with EDB Investment guidelines and objectives.
* Rotate cash across assets classes or within the same asset class to optimize returns in the short term (when required), while focusing on maximizing the annuity income for the bank on a longer-term risk adjusted net-FTP basis
* Manage the private equity portfolio, review and analyze the company’s yearly valuations, attend EGMs & AGMs, report to senior management on company’s performance, manage dividend payouts, capital reductions or injections, including devising exit strategies
* Coordinate with the Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure exposure remains within the limits defined with adherence to CBUAE and Basel regulatory requirements
* Partner with EDB’s Balance Sheet Management function to understand the bank’s funding requirements in the short, medium and long term.
* Perform market scan with banks, investors and other external counterparties to select viable funding solutions for the bank and recommend the same to ALCO
* Work with internal as well as external stakeholders, from origination to completion, to close the selected approved financing solution
* Transact Repo and Reverse Repo trades to manage short-term financing needs in accordance with approved guidelines. This requires the presence of an approved Repo framework, including a Product Manual, Standard Operating Procedure (SoP), and Operational Risk Assessment Plan (ORAP) duly signed off. Additionally, all transactions must be supported by executed GMRA agreements with counterparties, a functional collateral management operation, established counterparty limits, and a pricing mechanism with clearly defined haircuts.
* Draft and submit memos related to the Investment and Funding businesses to the relevant committees of the bank for approvals as per the DoA matrix
* Coordinate with the MIS team/Finance to deliver periodic performance updates as well as reports for senior management’s review and monitoring
* Evaluate and manage the bank’s capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, and other ratios with the Risk department.
* Cultivate strong relationships with external counterparties while managing internal stakeholders with an equal amount of care and responsibility.
* Ensure all revenue, cost, and volume targets are delivered under the stipulated guidelines.
* Be the key driver in delivering a larger share of the P&L responsibility for T&I.
* Conduct constructive and meaningful discussions with senior management, using market knowledge and business expertise to build trust and affinity, leading to better performance results
* Develop and implement sound business practices across all investment as well as funding related activities/operations to promote efficiencies in work processes.
* Maintain a trusted partner status with Middle Office, Market Risk, Finance, and Operations.
* Comply 100% with all Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Operational requirements as well as ensure there are no breaches
* Function within the framework and boundaries of EDB’s policies as well as overall organizational and governance frameworks
* Maintain adherence to Treasury & Investments policies, procedures, and processes that comply with the leading practices, laws, and regulations
* Take decisions as per the approved authorization matrix.
* Always maintain the highest standards of work ethics, making sure that one operates in a professional environment, there are zero compromises on compliance or principles, any breaches of limits, etc. are immediately escalated, and all activities are performed under the approved audit framework

**About the Role**

Our client is looking for a Senior Executive Vice President to head Traded and Treasury Credit Risk across all of its markets. Reporting to the Group Chief Credit Officer, you will set the bank’s counterparty credit risk frameworks and approve complex exposures that come from Treasury, Global Markets and trading activity. This is a senior role for a credit risk leader who knows markets products well and is ready to shape risk governance across the whole bank.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Run every stage of credit for market-linked exposures, from first assessment and approval through to ongoing monitoring and review
* Write the bank’s policies and standards for counterparty risk and keep them up to date as markets and regulation change
* Approve limits and credit requests for trading and funding counterparties, and send major exceptions to the right governance forums
* Help the Markets and Treasury desks design deals that work for the business and stay within risk appetite, especially on collateral, margin and legal terms
* Keep a close watch on portfolio health through stress tests, scenario analysis and exposure metrics, and step in quickly when warning signs appear
* Hold the bank within its counterparty, country, product and concentration limits, and deal with any breaches
* Speak for Credit Management on the Credit Committee and in regulatory discussions
* Act as the main link between the business, risk, legal, finance and operations teams, and help train staff to build a strong risk culture

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in finance or risk (e.g. MBA, CFA, FRM, CA) is preferred
* Minimum of 15+ years in banking, much of it in counterparty or traded credit risk, with several years leading teams
* Deep practical knowledge of treasury and capital markets products, including derivatives, FX and securities financing
* Solid understanding of how counterparty exposure is measured and how Basel-related capital rules apply to it
* Proven experience with collateral and margining arrangements and with standard trading documentation
* A track record of assessing a wide range of counterparties, such as banks, sovereigns, corporates and clearing houses, across several countries
* A confident leader and communicator who can influence senior management and coach a team.

10 to 15 years

Pune
  
  

**About Aligned Automation**

At Aligned Automation, we live by our "Better Together" philosophy to build a better world. Our culture is rooted in our 4Cs – Care, Courage, Curiosity and Collaboration – so every employee is empowered to grow, innovate and thrive in an inclusive workplace.

We are seeking a seasoned transformation leader to own the process, organization and program-delivery side of large digital transformation engagements. You will be the trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead Business Analysts and Program Managers, and translate business goals into process designs, operating models and executable programs. The ideal candidate can move between executive conversations and detailed technical discussions, keeping customer needs and technical implementation aligned. Prior work with large enterprises or government organizations is strongly preferred.

Required Qualifications
  
  
  
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field; MBA or equivalent Master's degree preferred.

The Opportunity
  
  
This role shapes the technology strategy and delivery for Business Resilience within Business Risk and Resilience (BRR) - part of HSBC’s Operational Resilience capability. You’ll oversee existing and new technology solutions and steer transformation that strengthens oversight of risk identification, management and mitigation, supported by regulatory compliance reporting. Working with senior Business, Technology and Risk stakeholders you’ll deliver scalable, secure and sustainable solutions aligned to HSBC’s technology strategy, regulatory requirements and risk-management framework. Success means a clear roadmap with measurable outcomes, reliable end-to-end delivery and a stronger and more transparent control environment. It also means simplifying complexity, reducing manual activity and ensuring technology risk management and governance is evidenced through effective management information.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Define and deliver the technology strategy and roadmap for Business Resilience aligned to HSBC priorities
* Identify opportunities to use automation, data and emerging technologies to improve operational effectiveness and resilience outcomes
* Oversee technology modernisation, innovation and transformation initiatives that strengthen resilience capabilities
* Establish success measures aligned to BRR OKRs and track benefit realisation across the portfolio
* Own end-to-end delivery of existing and new solutions ensuring outcomes are delivered on time and to budget
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture and engineering standards while reducing technical debt and unnecessary toil
* Govern portfolio execution, dependencies and delivery risks through strong delivery governance and performance oversight
* Champion technology-risk management, regulatory alignment and sustainable issue resolution with clear ownership and escalation

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive senior technology leadership experience in complex financial services including large-scale transformation delivery
* Demonstrate technology governance, risk management, controls and operational resilience experience within a regulated banking environment

* Evidence the ability to translate business strategy into practical technology outcomes through structured judgement and decision-making
* Demonstrate commercial acumen in technology investment, portfolio prioritisation and financial oversight including third-party relationships
* Show experience managing significant delivery portfolios with complex dependencies and resource allocation decisions
* Demonstrate engagement with senior executives across a complex, global matrix organisation including governance forum representation
* Bring experience developing geographically distributed teams and strengthening capability, inclusion and succession depth
* Demonstrate excellent communication, influencing, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills

Technology for Operational Resilience
  
  
This is a chance to set direction for technology that underpins HSBC’s operational resilience capability within BRR. You’ll shape the roadmap, oversee delivery and strengthen governance so resilience outcomes are measurable, sustainable and aligned to regulatory expectations. If your experience includes modernising enterprise platforms while improving risk management and service sustainability we’d like to hear from you. Apply to help build simpler, more effective solutions that support how HSBC identifies, manages and mitigates operational resilience risk.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

In this role, the Finance Operations Process leader will drive the injection of contemporary finance practices rooted in automation, data modeling and integrated business planning and reporting. This position typically works under limited supervision and direction. Incumbents of this position regularly exercise discretionary and regular decision-making authority.

* Perform root cause analysis on complex operational issues, developing corrective actions that align with business objectives and financial targets
* Champion a Kaizen mindset across teams, embedding a culture of incremental improvement, accountability, and quality at every process level

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile 1: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a techno-functional leader with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking and strong expertise in banking business analysis, requirements management, solution mapping, process design, API and interface analysis, data mapping, integration coordination, and banking data models. The role supports Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade, and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role -**
Techno-Functional Consultant – Finacle Core Banking
  
  
**Level -**
Manager
  
  
**Experience -**
8+ years in banking; 5+ years in business analysis or techno-functional consulting
  
  
**Domain -**
Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst and techno-functional consultant in banking transformation programs.
* Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.
* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, data mappings, and interface specifications.
* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.
* Provide functional and technical clarifications to integration, migration and testing teams.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, specifications, test scenarios and delivered solutions.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare activities.
* Lead functional workstreams, support delivery governance, manage risks and engage senior stakeholders as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking architecture, ecosystem, system configuration and banking data models.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, data mapping, migration, reconciliation, data quality and interface analysis.
* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.
* Knowledge of payment and settlement systems including SWIFT, TARGET2, EBA and ISO 20022.
* Strong client-facing communication, leadership, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Experience leading Business Analysis teams and large-scale core banking transformation, migration or upgrade programs.
* Project or program management, PMO governance, risk management and stakeholder reporting exposure.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.
* Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, Finacle, TOGAF or ITIL

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

------------------------

• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**

• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. **About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

* **Scope and direction:** Owns the Lending engineering domain and acts independently to set direction and allocate people, budget and capacity across programmes, projects and services.
* **Problem solving and standards:** Resolves complex technical, operational and organizational problems, and recommends standards and operating strategies that mitigate risk and drive growth.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRINGGROUP CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (GROUP CFO)

**Honey Makhija Group**

**Location:** Katni, Madhya Pradesh / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 15–25 Years Preferred  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Position:** Full-Time | Senior Leadership

About the Role

Honey Makhija Group is looking for an experienced, ambitious and strategically capable Group Chief Financial Officer to take complete ownership of the financial functions across the entire group and its subsidiaries.

The CFO will lead all aspects of corporate finance, institutional fundraising, banking, working capital, project finance, government grants and subsidies, accounting, taxation, audits, treasury, financial controls and corporate governance.

A key objective will be to transform the group into a professionally managed, institutionally funded and financially disciplined organisation, with the goal of preparing the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within the next three years.

The CFO will report directly to the Group Chairman.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Fundraising & Banking**

* Raise Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), Working Capital and Term Loan facilities.
* Arrange project finance, equipment finance and structured debt.
* Develop relationships with PSU banks, private banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Lead consortium banking arrangements and negotiate financing terms.
* Explore NCDs, corporate bonds, private credit and institutional funding.
* Manage loan renewals, enhancements, credit ratings and lender compliance.
* Develop and execute a group-wide fundraising strategy targeting ₹1,000+ crore in institutional funding over the medium term, subject to project viability and lender approvals.

**2. Government Grants & Subsidies**

* Identify eligible central and state government subsidy schemes.
* Apply for capital subsidies, interest subsidies and industrial incentives.
* Explore schemes for MSMEs, food processing, manufacturing, renewable energy, EV infrastructure and agro-industries.
* Coordinate with government departments, ministries, industrial development corporations and financial institutions.
* Manage applications, approvals, documentation and subsidy disbursements.

**3. Financial Planning & Management**

* Take complete ownership of group-level financial planning.
* Prepare annual budgets, financial projections and business-wise profitability reports.
* Manage cash flows, working capital and treasury.
* Optimise borrowing costs and capital allocation.
* Evaluate new projects, investments, acquisitions and expansion plans.
* Prepare detailed project reports (DPRs), financial models, IRR, NPV and DSCR calculations.

**4. Accounting, ERP & Financial Systems**

* Establish standardised accounting systems across all group companies.
* Implement ERP and centralised financial management systems.
* Develop financial SOPs, approval matrices and internal controls.
* Establish monthly MIS, consolidated financial reporting and business-wise dashboards.
* Introduce cost accounting, inventory controls and automated reconciliations.
* Build transparent and professionally managed finance operations.

**5. Audits, Taxation & Compliance**

* Lead statutory audits, internal audits and tax audits.
* Oversee GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances.
* Establish audit calendars and financial reporting deadlines.
* Ensure accurate financial statements and timely account finalisation.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Implement internal financial controls and close audit observations.

**6. IPO Readiness – Three-Year Mandate**

* Prepare the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within three years.
* Develop the IPO-readiness roadmap.
* Strengthen corporate governance and financial reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review corporate structures, shareholding and related-party transactions.
* Coordinate with merchant bankers, legal advisors, auditors and investment bankers.
* Prepare the organisation for financial due diligence and regulatory scrutiny.
* Evaluate listing structures, valuation and capital market opportunities.

**7. Treasury & Financial Risk Management**

* Manage group-wide liquidity and cash flow.
* Monitor debt obligations, interest costs and repayment schedules.
* Establish treasury management policies.
* Manage financial risks and optimise deployment of surplus funds.
* Ensure effective working capital management.

**8. Group-Level Financial Governance**

* Establish a centralised finance function across all group companies.
* Consolidate financial reporting.
* Monitor subsidiary performance and financial discipline.
* Build and lead professional finance, accounts, treasury and audit teams.
* Develop financial policies and reporting structures.
* Work directly with the Chairman on strategic financial decisions.

Business Exposure

The CFO will manage financial strategy across the diversified Honey Makhija Group, including:

* Rice milling, agro-processing and food industries.
* EV charging infrastructure.
* Solar and renewable energy.
* Biomass and alternative energy.
* Manufacturing and industrial projects.
* Technology, AI and software businesses.
* Logistics, hospitality and other ventures.

Candidate Requirements

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification mandatory.
* 15–25 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Previous CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director or senior corporate finance experience preferred.
* Strong experience in CC limits, term loans, project finance and institutional fundraising.
* Established relationships with banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Experience in consortium finance and structured debt.
* Knowledge of government grants, subsidies and incentive schemes.
* Strong expertise in accounting, taxation, audits and financial controls.
* Experience in ERP implementation and financial transformation.
* Exposure to IPO preparation, capital markets and corporate governance.
* Excellent negotiation, leadership and execution capabilities.

First 180-Day Expectations

* Complete financial assessment of all group companies.
* Review existing banking facilities, loans and liabilities.
* Develop a comprehensive group fundraising strategy.
* Initiate CC enhancement and term loan proposals.
* Identify and initiate eligible government subsidy applications.
* Implement centralised MIS and financial reporting.
* Establish internal audit and financial control systems.
* Prepare the three-year IPO-readiness roadmap.

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for someone who merely manages accounting, GST and taxation.

We are looking for a financial leader capable of building institutional relationships, raising substantial capital, structuring complex financing, obtaining government incentives, implementing professional financial systems and preparing a diversified corporate group for public-market participation.

The candidate must be execution-oriented, commercially aggressive, professionally disciplined and capable of working directly with the Group Chairman.

Application

Interested and eligible candidates are requested to share their updated CV / Resume via WhatsApp.

**WhatsApp: +91 83834 34626**

**Subject: Application – Group CFO | Honey Makhija Group**

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussions.

**Honey Makhija Group**  
Building businesses. Creating institutions.

Pay: ₹96,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

- Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,

- Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,

- Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
**Market Assessment and Business Development**

* Conducts market research to identify, initiate, establish and develop long term business relationships with the objective of meeting business and revenue objectives.
* Conducts periodic meetings with key customers, promoters, prospective customers to ensure business continuity and growth and expanding share of wallet from key clients.
* Conducts proactive business development activities from new & existing clients, through strategic penetration into identified market/sectors across the entire portfolio spectrum.

**Relationship Management**

* Identifies and acquires new client relationships by understanding the customers financial needs and provides suitable solutions in terms of providing bank products and services.
* Manages the client relationships by handling activities ranging from identifying clients’ financial needs, advising, structuring the deal, preparing the terms and conditions and closing the deal.

* Works in close coordination with relevant BUs to ensure smooth and quick turnaround of transactions as and when required.

jobs.title: Value Stream Leader - Connectivity & Systems
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**    

Job Description At Schneider Electric, the Installed Base (IB) Data organization ensures Installed Base data is accurate, trusted, and actionable to drive business growth, customer value, and digital transformation. Within the Installed Base Domain organization, we are looking for a Value Stream Leader - Connectivity Systems to define and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and execution of the Connectivity Systems value stream. This role plays a critical leadership position in connecting business objectives, digital capabilities, product connectivity, and data management to provide end-to-end visibility of the Installed Base lifecycle. As the leader of the Connectivity Systems value stream, you will collaborate across Lines of Business, Digital teams, Services LoB, and Data organizations to ensure the connectivity status and lifecycle of products and systems are accurately tracked, governed, and leveraged to create business value. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, digital and data expertise, strategic leadership, and program management capabilities to align stakeholders around a common vision and successfully deliver transformational initiatives.

  
   
  **Responsibilities**    

* Connectivity Strategy Vision: Define and drive the global strategy for tracking product and system connectivity status across all Lines of Business and divisions. Establish and maintain end-to-end visibility of the Installed Base from manufacturing through customer deployment and operation. Ensure connectivity data becomes a trusted business asset supporting customer value creation, service excellence, and digital growth initiatives.
* Systems Lifecycle Management: Establish a comprehensive framework for tracking systems throughout their entire lifecycle from a customer-centric perspective. Define business capabilities, data requirements, and governance needed to support visibility and lifecycle management across connected products and systems. Partner with business and digital stakeholders to identify opportunities for lifecycle optimization and enhanced customer experience.
* Value Stream Ownership: Collaborate closely with Domain Experts, Data Architects, Enterprise Architects, and Digital teams to define target-state processes, data models, and integration requirements. Ensure alignment between business priorities, architecture strategies, and technology investments.
* Business Requirements Solution Delivery: Lead definition and prioritization of business requirements for Connectivity Systems initiatives. Partner with Data Experts, Data Architects, E2E Business Architects, and IB Digital teams to translate business needs into actionable delivery plans. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and deployment activities in collaboration with Project Managers, Deployment Teams, and Delivery Leaders. Ensure solutions deliver measurable business value and meet stakeholder expectations.
* Strategic Roadmap Management: Co-create and maintain the annual Connectivity Systems roadmap in alignment with business objectives and digital transformation priorities. Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic goals and architecture direction. Monitor emerging technologies, connectivity trends, and digital capabilities to continuously evolve the roadmap.
* Value Stream Governance Execution: Lead monthly value stream operating reviews and governance forums. Drive execution transparency through KPI tracking, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication. Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and remove obstacles to delivery. Ensure initiatives are delivered according to agreed priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.

  
   
  **Key Skills Experience**    

* Domain Expertise: Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least two of the following three domains: Product Domain; Tools Data Domain; Services Domain.
* Product Domain: Deep understanding of Schneider Electric product portfolios, connected products, software ecosystems, and digital offerings. Experience with connectivity technologies, Edge-to-Cloud architectures and software centric design.
* Tools Data Domain: Solid understanding of enterprise systems and digital platforms supporting the Installed Base ecosystem (ERP, M2C, DATE, bFS, ALM, SDH, IB360, and related systems). Strong knowledge of data architecture, data governance, system integration, and business data flows.
* Services Domain: Strong understanding of Installed Base management, service delivery processes, and customer lifecycle management. Knowledge of how connectivity and digital services create value throughout the customer journey.

  
   
  **Core Competencies**    

* Strategic Leadership
* Program Portfolio Management
* Business Digital Acumen
* Stakeholder Management Communication
* Problem Solving Decision Making

jobs.title: Full-Stack GenAI & Hyperscaler Solutions Leader
jobs.description:
**Job description**

  

**Senior Hiring :** Full- Stack GenAI & Hyperscaler Solutions

Location: India

  

**Who we are:**

Tiger Analytics is a global leader in AI and analytics, helping Fortune 1000 companies solve their toughest challenges. We offer full stack AI and analytics services & solutions to empower businesses to achieve real outcomes and value at scale. We are on a mission to push the boundaries of what AI and analytics can do to help enterprises navigate uncertainty and move forward decisively. Our purpose is to provide certainty to shape a better tomorrow. Our team of 4000+ technologists and consultants are based in the US, Canada, the UK, India, Singapore, and Australia, working closely with clients across CPG, Retail, Insurance, BFS, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Healthcare. We are a Great Place to Work Certified , recognized globally for our dedication to innovation and excellence.

  

**Curious about the role?**

What your typical day would look like? We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and hands-on Leaders to champion our full-stack AI Centers of Excellence (CoEs). In this leadership role, you will sit at the intersection of advanced AI solutioning, hyperscaler ecosystems (specifically GCP/AWS/Azure), and robust full-stack engineering. You will be responsible for designing and deploying end-to-end Agentic AI systems, bringing both deep technical execution and executive-level solutioning to our clients. If you are passionate about moving beyond simple wrappers to engineer robust, enterprise-grade cognitive architectures, this role is for you. As part of this role, you will:

  

* **Drive Hyperscaler CoE Innovation:** Architect and scale full-stack GenAI solutions heavily integrated with hyperscaler ecosystems, with a deep focus on GCP (Vertex AI), Anthropic (Claude/Cortex), and adjacent modern AI stacks.
* **Architect Agentic Systems:** Design and build autonomous, end-to-end Agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestrations, and production-grade RAG pipelines capable of solving complex corporate workflows.
* **Lead Full-Stack AI Engineering:** Oversee the end-to-end development lifecycle, from sophisticated prompt engineering and LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT) to robust backend microservices and responsive application layers.
* **Ensure Enterprise Deployment & MLOps:** Bridge the gap between AI modeling and core infrastructure by owning cloud scalability, containerization, robust error management, and automated CI/CD/MLOps monitoring pipelines.
* **Deliver Strategic Solutioning:** Partner closely with senior leadership and client stakeholders to translate intricate business challenges into scalable, production-ready AI blueprints.
* **Mentor and Build Elite Teams:** Cultivate, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of AI full-stack engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and aggressive innovation.

  

**EXPERTISE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

  

**Who do we expect ?**

  

* **Experience:** 15+ years of technical engineering experience, with at least 4+ years of dedicated leadership in leading NLP, Deep Learning, and Generative AI applications.
* **Hyperscaler & AI Ecosystem Depth:** Extensive hands-on experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, GKE) , Anthropic model suites, and deep familiarity with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI/Autogen for agentic setups.
* **Core GenAI Skills:**Proven expertise in building production RAG frameworks, advanced prompt optimization, and applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT).
* Strong background in full-stack architecture, featuring elite Python skills, API/Microservices design (FastAPI, Django, or Flask), and exposure to modern UI engineering patterns for AI interactions. Infrastructure & MLOps Mastery:Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD infrastructure, ensuring reliable scaling, low latency, and robust mitigation against LLM vulnerabilities (hallucinations, security bias).
* **Data Engineering Literacy**:Solid fundamentals in distributed computing, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), and cloud data warehouse ecosystems.
* **Leadership & Influence:**Strong executive presence, capable of fluidly pivoting from technical deep-dives with engineers to strategic product roadmap discussions with enterprise buyers.

  

**You are important to us, lets stay connected!**

  

Every individual comes with a different set of skills and qualities so even if you dont tick all the boxes for the role today, we urge you to apply as there might be a suitable/unique role for you tomorrow. We are an equal-opportunity employer. Our diverse and inclusive culture and values guide us to listen, trust, respect, and encourage people to grow the way they desire.

  

**Note:** The designation will be commensurate with expertise and experience. Compensation packages are among the best in the industry. Additional Benefits: Health insurance (self & family), virtual wellness platform, and knowledge communities.
