jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just right for you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* DBS India Consumer Banking Group including digibank (Retail Banking) and Treasures (Wealth Segment) serves over 2.6 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services.
* It is a business that focuses on quality customer acquisition through multiple acquisition channels, customer-centric value propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
* DBS has been at the forefront of adapting and incorporating rapid changes in technology to understand and serve customer needs better. Virtual Relationship Managers are a step in that direction.
* Thus Treasures Virtual Relationship Manager is a key role within the Consumer Banking Group Business that is responsible for engaging with clients across the geographies in India and Globally, greatly enhancing the client experience through the effective use of technology.
* A high level of customer-centricity, interpersonal relationships complemented by “multi-channel” approach to relationship management via online and digi app are critical to succeed in this role.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire clients through e-boarding of the provided leads and nurture the relationship for AUM build up in a steady manner.
* Establish the Virtual Relationship Channel as a major revenue contributor through effective engagement with clients via multiple communication channels
* Ensure right balance of the product mix and balance NTB (New to Bank NR customers) with increased penetration of existing customers to deepen the wallet share.
* Drive and deliver a radical improvement in customer satisfaction scores through timely engagement and redressal of client enquiries.
* Ensure highest levels of customer satisfaction. Interact with new customers to detail & explain all features & functions of products & assist in on boarding of new clients.
* Empower DBS IN clients embrace the value delivery channels to improve transaction efficiency and effectiveness

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Quality engagement with Emerging Affluent and Treasures clients to retain and developing sustainable relationships
* Ensure effective and efficient on-boarding, client coverage and client economics.
* Coordinate and drive timely investment and insurance portfolio reviews partnering with Investment / Insurance / Wealth specialists in Cluster locations.
* Establish relationships with the client’s basis opportunities identified by key acquiringchannels such as SME / CEP/IBG/ DBS Experience Centers or influencers for on-boarding the clients and ensure qualification as Treasures basis the stipulated criteria.
* Ensure service delivery by ensuring appropriate workflows and processes including digital on-boarding, upgrades, Scan / E-mail based wealth transactions, doorstep banking services, digital and remote account maintenance (Re-KYC / Risk Reviews) etc.
* Work closely with Cluster locations, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure that customer instructions are executed correctly and in a timely manner
* Improving customer experience by collating customer feedback, identifying areas to improve such as operational, administrative, processes and competitiveness of products and services
* Maintaining an awareness of relevant products and services available so as to provide the best solutions for clients as per their identified needs and aspirations
* Supporting process and product improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback on service and product offering and ensuring compliance with internal audit and regulatory requirements and quality assurance
* Adhere to DBS India and Group standards on code of conduct and controls in line with bank values and expectations

**Requirements:**

* Servicing high net worth clients at a financial institution / KPO
* While technical competence is not essential, ability to handle client requests via e-channels and versatility with digital tools would be beneficial.
* Good knowledge of wealth management products, both investment and insurance
* Customer oriented and able to capture customer financial needs
* Holder of relevant insurance, investment certification requirements (AMFI / IRDAI Composite license) would be an advantage
* Good command of spoken English and Hindi. Fluency in other regional languages (Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu etc.) would be an advantage.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline. Postgraduation in marketing or finance or banking would be desirable

**Core Competencies**

* Selling and team influencing skills to grow customer numbers and customer product uptake
* People Management
* Communication Skills
* Drive for Action
* Ability to work in an ambiguous environment
* Excellent understanding of the Bank’s Strategy and ability to interpret this and execute effectively to grow customer wallet share
* Proven track record in execution of sales or marketing strategy that resulted in business growth

Work Relationship
  
  

* Ensuring remote coverage and engagement of customers along with Branch teams for support.
* Close interaction with Channels / Segments and Clusters to ensure consistent delivery of service and business objectives.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviours are:
  
  

* Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

Pune-DBIL
  
  
**Job:**
Product Sales
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

jobs.title: Principal Process Architect - Core Finance Systems
jobs.description:
**Overview**
Intuit's mission is powering prosperity around the world. We do this by attracting the world's top talent, delivering innovative solutions for consumers, small businesses, self-employed professionals, and accounting experts. Every day we innovate with our flagship products: TurboTax, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Credit Karma. For over 100 million customers, we deliver more money, more time, and more confidence.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
We are seeking a Principal Process Architect to spearhead end-to-end process design and implementation across Core Finance, encompassing plan-to-perform and underlying financial operations. Operating as a senior individual contributor, you will collaborate with key technology and finance leaders to turn strategic goals into actionable outcomes—simplifying complex workflows, re-architecting processes, driving full-scale automation, and enabling real-time analytics. In this role, you will hold complete accountability for key transformation workstreams, managing every phase from target-state workflow design and data alignment to requirements definition, implementation, and organizational adoption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Process Architecture: Influence and shape the transformation roadmap by providing process architecture expertise that aligns with core finance priorities, supporting a cohesive enterprise-wide operational strategy. Codify the delivery model into reusable playbooks so it can be replicated across the Finance teams and new initiatives.
* Program & Sprint-Based Execution: Drive cross-functional execution of a program from discovery through delivery, ensuring it is delivered on time, to a high standard of quality, within budget, and in accordance with stated business and technical objectives.
* Discovery & Prioritization: Lead structured discovery through the use of a process intelligence tools and stakeholder sessions and workshops to quantify when process time is spent and the current state landscape. Translate observed friction into prioritized opportunity pipeline across levers such as automating manual work, fixing the data model, changing the operating model (process), or solve through system changes/enhancements .
* Operational Excellence & Innovation: Streamline ambiguous & inefficient processes within the core finance function. Focus on accelerating and optimizing operations by replacing manual tasks with automated capabilities or process improvements. Design AI-enabled solutions and processes hands-on through prototype, test, and refine cycle, separating what AI can solve from what requires data remodel or engineering.
* Solution Design & Development: Collaborate with IT and finance business stakeholders to design scalable financial solutions and automations. Ensure that new capabilities are innovative, repeatable, and aligned with organizational growth.
* Data Reconciliation & Automation: Structure and reconcile high-volume transaction data across disparate systems, identify root causes of discrepancies, and architect automated, controlled workflows for detection and resolution on packaged ERP/SaaS and custom finance applications.
* Stakeholder Influence & Decision Support: Act as a trusted advisor to finance leadership, using data and analysis to inform prioritization and decision-making; influence senior stakeholders without direct authority to harmonize on strategy and sequencing.
* Analytical Decision Support: Utilize advanced data analysis to guide executive decision-making. Execute strategies that integrate stakeholder requirements across the end-to-end financial journey.
* AI & Automation Enablement: Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern finance technologies to streamline processes, improve insights, and accelerate finance transformation outcomes.
* Adoption & Change Leadership mindset: Spearhead the change management efforts by working with the change team for transformation initiatives, including developing and executing targeted communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and detailed training programs to ensure successful adoption and full integration of new processes and systems.

**Key Competencies**

* ERP fluency: Can configure, test, and troubleshoot core ERP Cloud modules without hand-holding from IT.
* Speed with discipline: Moves fast and delivers in small, visible increments, without skipping discovery or letting solutions get ahead of the evidence.
* Builder mindset: Comfortable building Claude/AI solutions, not just specifying them — writes prompts, builds agents and workflow automation, and turns an idea into something testable within days.
* Rigor and candor: Grounds every claim in observed data or documented sources, reports progress honestly, and knows the difference between built, piloted, and adopted.
* User empathy: Understands how analysts actually work and treats friction as a capability or tool gap, not a performance issue.
* Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind.
* Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind.
* Clear communication across time zones: Leads with the answer, adapts to executive, partner, and builder audiences, and works effectively with global stakeholders through strong asynchronous communication and reliable overlap hours.

****Qualifications****
**Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a strong process and transformation leader with experience
  
  
spanning finance processes, business systems, and cross-functional program delivery. They understand core finance and accounting deeply enough to engage credibly with finance stakeholders, while also bringing the structured thinking and technical fluency needed to guide solution design and systems-enabled change.
  
  
They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, and influencing across a complex
  
  
stakeholder environment. They can balance strategic roadmap thinking with practical execution, and they bring a modernization mindset that includes process simplification, connected processes, and thoughtful application of AI and emerging technologies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in finance/accounting roles with deep domain expertise in financial systems, processes, and large-scale transformation projects.
* Subject matter expertise in the core financials, including Plan-to-Perform, Record-to-Report, Fixed Assets, Source-to-Pay, and direct & Indirect tax.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building processes and leveraging automation or AI-enabled solutions, such as LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, and workflow automation.
* Experience with process discovery and mapping methods, such as process mining or task monitoring, value-stream mapping, and user interviews.
* Ability to connect the core financials end-to-end process design with the data model, AI/automation, and technology to cross-process dependencies (planning, forecasting, and budgeting)
* Proven track record of orchestrating large-scale, multi-year finance transformation programs, effectively managing dependencies between technical implementations (ERP & SaaS) and business process re-engineering efforts.
* Expert understanding of core accounting principles (e.g., US GAAP, IFRS) and their application in a systems environment.
* Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into a scalable system architecture.
* Excellent communication skills to work effectively with stakeholders across the organization. You must be able to influence cross-functional senior leaders to use data and insights to inform business strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale change initiatives, operate

In this Director-level role, you will shape cloud strategies, guide large-scale migrations, and influence adoption of cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices. This is a senior individual contributor position ideal for a technically strong consultant who combines architectural depth with an advisory mindset.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with enterprise clients to assess current-state environments and define future-state cloud strategies with AWS as the primary platform
* Advise clients on cloud transformation approaches, including platform engineering, modernization, and migration
* Provide thought leadership on cloud-native architectures, landing zones, multi-account strategies, and operating models
* Lead cloud consulting engagements involving large-scale workload assessments and migration planning (rehost, re-platform, refactor, re-architect)
* Guide clients in designing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud environments
* Contribute to strategic discussions on cloud governance, security models, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and operational excellence
* Shape solution approaches for RFPs, proposals, and client workshops, working closely with pre-sales, architecture, and delivery teams
* Stay current with GenAI / LLM-powered cloud use cases and advise clients on adopting innovative cloud capabilities
* Influence cloud adoption decisions through deep expertise in automation, containerization, DevSecOps, and platform scalability
* Serve as a hands-on technical advisor and strategic individual contributor, bringing clarity and direction to complex cloud transformation initiatives

**Requirements**

* 20+ years of overall IT experience, including extensive hands-on cloud consulting or platform engineering experience
* Expertise in AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, governance, and DevOps
* Background in multi-cloud environments, with exposure to Azure as an added advantage
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK), CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms (EKS, ECS, Kubernetes)
* Understanding of cloud security, IAM, and networking, along with encryption, compliance, and cost optimization
* Capability to collaborate directly with business, technology, and architecture stakeholders to influence strategy and guide transformation choices
* Cloud certifications (AWS preferred; Azure certifications considered a plus)
* Depth of an architect combined with the mindset of an advisor, comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor and influencing strategy through hands-on expertise
* Confident in client-facing discussions and capable of translating complex cloud concepts into actionable business insights
* Passionate about cloud transformation, platform engineering, and modern cloud-native practices
* Strong English communication skills (B2 level or higher)

**Nice to have**

* Skills in application development using .NET, Java, or Python
* Background in SRE practices
* Proficiency in DevSecOps practices

We are seeking an experienced **Business Consulting professional** specializing in P&C Commercial insurance to serve as a subject matter expert and hands-on consultant, applying deep domain knowledge to real client projects, solutioning, delivery, and business transformation initiatives across underwriting, pricing, claims, and operational processes.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the go-to subject matter expert for P&C Commercial insurance matters, including underwriting, rating / pricing, policy administration, claims, product configuration, risk / exposure management, workflow, and regulatory considerations
* Apply hands-on consulting and delivery experience to client engagements, translating domain expertise into real project scenarios and business transformation initiatives
* Analyze complex insurance products, policies, processes, workflows, and data to identify opportunities for improvement and provide actionable insights
* Provide expertise in Pricing / Rating capabilities, including rating models, pricing processes, rating engines, product rules, premium calculation, and related operational impacts
* Manage the successful delivery of client requirements, including active participation in RFP responses, solution shaping, estimations, and proposal development
* Contribute to insurance thought leadership through white papers, POVs, client presentations, and market-facing collateral
* Identify and shape AI / GenAI-led use cases across the P&C insurance value chain, including underwriting, rating / pricing, claims, servicing, fraud, and operational efficiency
* Drive POCs and accelerators based on recent and relevant client project needs, ensuring practical applicability and measurable business value

**Requirements**

* 13-18 years of overall experience in IT, including 10+ years in the Insurance industry with strong focus on P&C Commercial lines
* Hands-on experience in consulting, business analysis, product management, transformation, or delivery roles within P&C Commercial insurance
* Expertise in at least two of the following P&C Commercial insurance capabilities: Pricing / Rating, Underwriting, Policy Administration / Renewal / Maintenance
* Skills in Product Configuration, Risk / Exposure Management, Claims, Workflow Management, Billing, or Premium Processing

jobs.description:

With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

 **Job Description**

**Job Title: Medical Writer – CDMA**

**Department:** Medical Affairs / Scientific Communications  
**Education:** MBBS / BDS / PhD / Master’s in Pharmacy or a related field  
**Scope:** Global

**Role Objective / Purpose**

* To develop high-quality scientific content and documentation across therapeutic areas by conducting in-depth literature reviews, synthesizing data, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials.
* The role involves contributing to both short- and long-term projects in the consumer healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors, including medical, safety, pre-clinical, clinical, regulatory, educational, and promotional content.
* Additional responsibilities include editing, proofreading, reviewing, referencing, and verifying content to ensure adherence to high medical writing standards.
* The role ensures timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining quality, compliance, and business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Literature Reviews and Evidence Mapping**

* Conduct comprehensive secondary research/literature reviews and prepare overarching summaries using effective search strategies across scientific databases (e.g., PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library) and open-source platforms.
* Analyze and interpret clinical and scientific data to extract actionable insights.
* Stay current with trends, treatment guidelines, and regulatory updates in both OTC and Rx domains.

**Medical and Scientific Content Development**

* Leverage scientific expertise to create high-quality communication materials in the OTC and Rx space.
* Research, write, edit, organize, interpret, curate, and quality-check various types of scientific content across multiple formats and channels.
* Prepare, review, and edit a range of scientific documents, including:
  + Literature reviews
  + Manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
  + Abstracts, posters, and slide decks for scientific conferences
  + Treatment guideline summaries
  + Publication summaries and white papers
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with applicable guidelines (e.g., ICMJE, CONSORT).

**Content Review and Quality Assurance**

* Review medical, promotional, and scientific materials in accordance with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
* Verify references and ensure content is plagiarism-free.
* Ensure clear, factual, and effective presentation of data and discussions.
* Maintain and apply templates, formats, and styles to ensure compliance with industry and client standards.

**Project Execution**

* Understand and define client requirements during project initiation, including objectives and timelines.
* Develop scientifically accurate and medically relevant content across therapeutic areas, adhering to branding and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
* Respond to and deliver ad-hoc client requests within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with medical writing colleagues, the graphics team, and clients as needed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* **Mentorship:** Actively mentor team members to support effective task execution and goal achievement.
* **Values and Behaviors:** Consistently demonstrate WNS values and foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Personal Development:** Identify learning and development needs in collaboration with the line manager and pursue relevant training opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Process-Related**

* **Domain Expertise:** Quickly build subject matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas.
* **Efficiency:** Develop effective search strategies, organize data for analysis, and prepare medical and scientific content.
* **Accuracy:** Validate sources, identify data gaps, and ensure scientific rigor.
* **Quality:** Deliver well-structured, grammatically sound, and visually engaging documents using appropriate templates and tone.

**People-Related**

* Demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and professionalism.
* Actively participate in team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and training initiatives.

**Required Competencies & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, OTC, and consumer healthcare landscape.
* Clear grasp of medical, scientific, and statistical terminology and concepts.
* Robust knowledge of various types of clinical studies, the structure, and formats of different manuscript types (e.g., SLR, TLR, Meta-analysis), along with their relevance and application in evidence synthesis and utilization.
* Proven experience in scientific writing and literature analysis.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and online research tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking abilities, and the capacity to work independently.
* Demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and effective time management.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with regulatory documentation and compliance in US/EU markets.
* Exposure to text mining, data visualization tools, and scientific storytelling.
* Experience with reference management (e.g., EndNote, Zotero, Mendeley) and statistical (e.g., RevMan, SPSS, GraphPad Prism, R, SAS) tools.
* Knowledge of proprietary tools such as DataVision, PubPro, and Veeva Vault.

  
**Qualifications**

• BDS/ MDS/PhD with 6-8 years’ experience• Understanding of any specialty area of medicine (preferred Oral health) or an overall understanding of the medical field.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Analyst, SQL, Python and SAS
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Business Analytics****Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics.
* Help draft initial narrative summaries, executive dashboards, and documentation for final test result publication.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Track and update sprint milestones, deliverables, and cycle times to ensure on-time testing execution.
* Support team capacity planning by gathering allocation data and tracking utilization across testing stages.
* Assist in maintaining skill inventory matrices to facilitate optimal, competency-based resource assignment.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 5+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Technical Skills: Basic statistical Modeling (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree), SQL, SAS , Python

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

* undefined

**Education:**

* Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Senior UiPath RPA Developer
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 398621
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior UiPath RPA Developer to join our team in Hyderbad, Andhra Pradesh (IN-AP), India (IN).
  
  
"JOB DESCRIPTION
  
Senior UiPath RPA Developer / Technical Lead
  
Experience Minimum 5+ years of hands-on RPA experience with strong UiPath expertise
  
Role Level Senior Developer / Technical Lead
  
Primary Focus UiPath delivery, SAP automation, intelligent document processing and production support
  
Employment Type Full-time
  
1. Role Objective
  

* Own end-to-end design, development, deployment, support and continuous improvement of enterprise UiPath automations.
* Take technical ownership of complex production automations, including SAP, Excel, email, document processing and enterprise application workflows.
* Provide senior-level troubleshooting, code/design review, stakeholder coordination and guidance to junior RPA developers.

2. Mandatory Experience Core Skills
  

* Minimum 5+ years of professional RPA experience with strong hands-on development in UiPath Studio, Robot and Orchestrator.
* Proven experience delivering production-grade automations across the full lifecycle: requirement analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, hypercare and support.
* Advanced knowledge of UiPath Modern Design Experience, UI Automation, selectors, Object Repository, queues, assets, triggers, jobs, schedules and reusable libraries.
* Strong experience with REFramework or equivalent enterprise framework patterns, transaction handling, retries, restart/resume, logging and exception management.
* Strong DataTable processing, LINQ, VB.NET expressions and Invoke Code for complex business rules and data transformation.
* Hands-on Excel, CSV, Outlook/email and file automation, including large-volume data handling and configurable solutions.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using UiPath logs, Orchestrator logs and application-level diagnostics.

3. SAP Automation Expertise
  

* Strong hands-on experience automating SAP GUI processes using UiPath UI Automation and SAP scripting.
* Ability to handle dynamic SAP tables, bulk data entry, scrolling, pop-ups, validations, session behavior and unstable/dynamic selectors.
* Experience troubleshooting SAP automation failures caused by application changes, migrations, selector changes, login/session issues or scripting behavior.
* Ability to assess and implement more stable alternatives to fragile UI automation, including scripting, APIs or integration-based approaches where feasible.

4. Document Understanding Intelligent Automation
  

* Hands-on experience with UiPath Document Understanding for document classification, extraction, validation and post-processing.
* Working knowledge of ML Extractor, Generative Extractor, keyword-based classification, taxonomy design and document validation workflows.
* Experience with UiPath AI Center / ML Skills and Action Center for human-in-the-loop validation and exception handling.

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.

IT Infrastructure Technology

Jefferies’ IT Infrastructure Technology team builds and runs the core technology backbone that enables the firm to operate globally. It covers enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations while driving modernization initiatives such as Cloud Adoption and Network Resiliency. The group supports critical platforms including networking, end-user computing, cloud, databases, server/Unix engineering, communications, and global data centers (including low-latency colocations near exchanges).

* Networking / Telecom / Multimedia Engineering
* Windows / Desktop / Messaging Engineering.
* Private / Public Cloud / Database / Unix Engineering.
* Data Centers.

The ideal candidate will have strong engineering experience in either AWS or Microsoft Azure, hands-on Kubernetes knowledge, and experience using infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practices to manage cloud environments at scale.

* Troubleshoot complex cloud and Kubernetes platform issues across infrastructure, networking, security, and application integration layers.
* Improve platform reliability through monitoring, observability, automation, operational standards, and continuous engineering improvements.
* Support cloud modernization and migration initiatives, including the transformation of legacy applications into cloud-native architectures.
* Evaluate emerging cloud and Kubernetes technologies and recommend practical improvements to the platform.

Required Qualifications

* 3-5+ years professional hands-on experience with a major cloud provider
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Experience designing, engineering, or operating cloud platforms in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Kubernetes and managed Kubernetes services such as Amazon EKS or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Experience with Kubernetes platform engineering, including cluster lifecycle management, networking, ingress, security, observability, upgrades, and workload onboarding.

jobs.title: SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

An SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO) acts as the central connective tissue of an enterprise’s IT ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining seamless end-to-end data flows and process integrations between SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C/4HANA, Ariba) and non-SAP cloud or on-premise applications.

With your vast knowledge of SAP and industry, you assist top-tier clients in their SAP digital transformation efforts. Your role entails providing guidance and executing SAP digital transformation initiatives. You also conceptualize, create, improve and optimize solutions using SAP development tools and platforms. Additionally, you work alongside global teams and partners across various functions to deliver solutions. You define and update solution and technology roadmaps, and architecture documents.

  

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput interfaces running on SAP Process Orchestration (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Concurrently, you will lead the refactoring and modernization of legacy interfaces to modern APIs, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns, enabling seamless data flow between core SAP S/4HANA systems and broader cloud or third-party enterprise platforms.

  

Lead enterprise integration assessments, interface architecture, and migration of legacy middleware to modern cloud integration platforms. Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective integration solutions. Own interface development from design through implementation and transition to operations, balancing long-term integration strategy with day-to-day stability, maintainability, and business continuity.

  

Professionals in this role author and leverage detailed technical design documentation, mapping specifications, and interface runbooks to build robust data flows across hybrid landscapes. Ensure all integration components are thoroughly documented, rigorously unit-tested, and validated for seamless end-to-end processing across connected systems. Lead interface walkthroughs and playback demonstrations with functional teams and client stakeholders. Triage, isolate, and remediate integration defects during pre-production testing cycles, cutovers, and hypercare support. Provide precise development effort estimates and guide project teams on integration patterns, BTP capabilities, and technical trade-offs.

  

Bring your deep integration engineering background to an organization modernizing enterprise application ecosystems, playing a central role in connecting critical business processes. You will collaborate alongside a global community of SAP and cloud specialists driving the future of hybrid connectivity—professionals who value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and open collaboration.

  

**What you will do**

* **Integration & Modernization Strategy:** Lead discovery and assessment of legacy PI/PO landscapes, evaluate interface technical debt, and build migration roadmaps to transition workloads toward SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Architecture & Interface Governance:** Establish enterprise integration guidelines, select optimal communication patterns (hub-and-spoke, API-led, event-driven), enforce error-handling standards, and ensure interface compliance with corporate security mandates.
* **Cloud & Hybrid Integration:** Architect, develop, and tune end-to-end integration flows across SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors, Event Mesh).
* **Core SAP & Third-Party Connectivity:** Build and support mission-critical interfaces linking SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and C/4HANA with third-party SaaS and on-premise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).
* **Protocol, Mapping & Security Management:** Implement data transformations using Groovy Script, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping; configure enterprise security standards including OAuth 2.0, SAML, Principal Propagation, SSL/TLS, and Keystore management.
* **Technical Leadership & Delivery:** Lead client design workshops, conduct code and mapping reviews, manage cutover/go-live risks, mentor junior developers, and coordinate interface testing between functional consultants and external partner counterparts.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a structured pathway to expand your career, from Integration Consultant to Principal Integration Architect. We provide unique opportunities to engage with hybrid architectures and hyperscaler-connected ecosystems, paired with dedicated learning resources and support to achieve professional certifications across modern SAP and cloud platforms.

You will partner with top-tier clients across a wide range of industries—from banking and retail to manufacturing and healthcare. Whether your ambition is to deepen your focus on enterprise iPaaS architectures or broaden your leadership across complex multi-cloud digital transformations, you can build that trajectory here. You will contribute to critical business initiatives, influence technology roadmaps, and cultivate relationships with diverse technical communities while mastering modern integration practices.

**Who You Are**

You bring seasoned hands-on technical proficiency in SAP integration and possess the delivery track record to back it up. Equally critical: you possess a continuous learning mindset, an analytical approach to solving complex interface issues, and a customer-first focus dedicated to operational resilience. You thrive in open, globally distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8–10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP integration engineering, middleware architecture, and interface delivery.
* **4+ years** of dedicated design and development experience on **SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)** .
* Proven track record in full-lifecycle **SAP PI (7.3/7.4) and PO (7.5)** implementations, dual-stack/single-stack administration awareness, and interface remediation.
* Solid experience delivering integration architecture for **SAP S/4HANA implementation and roll-in projects** , including legacy-to-cloud migrations.
* Deep proficiency in advanced mapping techniques: **Groovy Scripting, XSLT, Graphical Mapping, Value Mapping, and Custom Functions** .
* Comprehensive expertise across standard integration protocols and data structures: **OData (V2/V4), REST, SOAP/WSDL, IDoc, RFC, EDI/EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, AMQP, JSON, and XML** .
* Strong grasp of BTP platform connectivity, including **SAP Cloud Connector** , Destination Services, Cloud Integration Automation Framework, and multi-tenant subaccount structures.
* Solid background in integration security: certificate and key lifecycle management, **OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, mutual TLS, and Principal Propagation** .

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Hands-on implementation experience with **SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh, and SAP Integration Advisor** .
* Familiarity with non-SAP enterprise ecosystems and SaaS platforms such as **Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, and hyperscaler services (AWS, Azure, GCP)** .
* Experience establishing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated interface

jobs.title: ASIC CAD Technical Leader (9-15 Years| Bangalore)
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco’s Silicon One Optics Group (S1O) designs& delivers the high-speed optical transceivers, and platforms that power Cisco's core data center networking solutions. We specialize in the design and integration of cutting-edge IM/DD optics and silicon photonic platforms that enable customers to deploy industry-leading optical technologies within data center with unprecedented speed, capacity, and reliability. Come join us and take part in shaping S1O’s ground-breaking optical solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most advanced pluggable, Near Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-packaged Optics (CPO) being developed in the industry.
  
You will drive the India CAD operations working closely with the US CAD team to build the methodologies and tools that enable complex products. Because we work across the full product lifecycle, we have a unique opportunity to influence architecture, establish design methodologies early, automate repetitive engineering processes, and drive predictable design closure. A significant new focus for this role is the deployment of AI tools, when possible, to enhance productivity, quality, and development cycle times.
  
We value technical depth, innovation, ownership, and collaboration. Join us to build the CAD infrastructure and methodologies that will power the future of optical connectivity and high-performance computing.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a CAD Engineering Leader, you will drive the development and deployment of design automation and EDA infrastructure supporting next-generation silicon photonics and optical networking products. You will work across architecture, RTL, physical design, DFT, verification, packaging, and silicon design teams to establish scalable methodologies that enable first-pass design success and predictable full-chip closure.
  
You will provide technical leadership in design methodology and CAD automation while driving improvements in design quality, productivity, and time-to-market across multiple silicon programs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
In addition to providing technical leadership, you will be responsible for:
  
EDA Vendor Engagement
  
  

* Serve as a primary technical contact for EDA vendors, working directly with application engineers to resolve tool issues and escalate blocking defects.
* File, track, and drive bug reports and feature requests to closure, maintaining visibility of open items with internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate and benchmark new tool releases, assessing runtime, accuracy, capacity, and regression risk before deployment.
* Qualify tool and flow readiness for new process nodes in coordination with vendors and foundry partners.
* Participate in vendor roadmap reviews and early-adopter or beta programs to influence future tool capabilities.
* Support license and tool-access planning with vendors to align capacity with project demand.

Design Team Support and Enablement
  
  

* Act as a front-line technical resource for design and layout teams, providing hands-on debug support for tool and flow issues.
* Author and maintain clear flow documentation, quick-start guides, and best-known methods for supported toolsets.
* Develop and deliver training sessions and onboarding materials to accelerate adoption of new tools and flows.
* Drive adoption of AI tools to enhance productivity, quality, and development speed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams — design, CAD, and IT — to keep the design environment stable and productive.

CAD Infrastructure and Automation
  
  

* Lead the development of reusable automation and design infrastructure across product generations to improve design quality, productivity, and consistency.
* Lead cross-functional technical initiatives, resolve complex design-flow issues, and communicate methodology and execution risks to senior engineering leadership.

Minimum Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of ASIC, CAD, EDA, or semiconductor design experience, or Master's degree with 8+ years, or PhD with 5+ years.
* Demonstrated experience leading CAD, design methodology, or ASIC design-flow initiatives.
* Deep understanding of device modeling, analog design, and layout.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Pegasus, Quantus, Innovus, Genus, Siemens Calibre or equivalent technologies.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, or equivalent languages.
* Fluency in Linux, including shell usage, scripting, and general system navigation.
* Experience with job scheduling and workload management systems such as LSF, SGE, or similar, including job submission, resource allocation, and batch job debugging.
* Experience with design management and design management tools such as Keysight SOS, IC Manage and DesignSync.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical projects across multiple engineering organizations.

Preferred Qualification
  
  

* Experience leading CAD/EDA methodology teams or serving as a technical lead for silicon design infrastructure.
* Experience developing automated CAD infrastructure, flow orchestration, design-quality dashboards, and methodology qualification frameworks.
* Experience with Agentic-AI Mixed-Signal ASIC flow development
* Experience partnering with EDA vendors and defining tool, flow, and methodology requirements.
* Proven track record of mentoring engineers, influencing architecture, and driving organizational adoption of new methodologies.

Why Cisco?
  
  
WE ARE CISCO, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference. Here’s how we do it.
  
We embrace digital and help our customers implement change in their digital businesses. Some may think we’re “old” (30 years strong!) and only about hardware, but we’re also a software company. And a security company. A blockchain company. An AI/Machine Learning company. We even invented an intuitive network that adapts, predicts, learns and protects. No other company can do what we do – you can’t put us in a box!
  
But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.)
  
Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, we give our egos a break and we give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, we take bold steps, and we take difference to heart. Because without diversity of thought and a commitment to equality for all, there is no moving forward.
  
So, you have colorful hair? Don’t care. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That’s cool.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team

The GMH is Salesforce's dedicated delivery factory for strategic platform migrations — accelerating customer transitions from legacy systems to modernized platforms driven by agentic tooling and an AI-native delivery framework.
  
  
Reporting to the GMH GDC Head, the Senior Director leads a multi-track organization of Architects, Project Managers, and Consultants across four practices. In addition to full delivery leadership, this role carries a team’s billable utilization target — engaging directly with customers as an advisor on the Hub's most complex migration engagements.

**Strategy & Hub**

* Define and own the GMH's multi-year strategy — positioning the Hub as Salesforce's global center of excellence for platform migrations.
* Build and evolve the Migration Factory model: standardized delivery patterns, reusable accelerators, and wave-based execution playbooks across all tracks.

As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores—often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview
  
  
The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team’s delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team’s technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team.
* Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes.
* Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team’s capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions.
* Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems.
* Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic.
* Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes.
* Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle.
* Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues.
* Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support.
* Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity.
* Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment.
* Develop applications and automation using Java or Python.
* Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team.
* Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention.
* Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems.
* Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers.
* Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity.
* Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.
* Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects.
* Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior.
* Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python.
* Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions.
* Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools.
* Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics.
* Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic.

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

CNS (Computer Network Systems) is a technology company in the middle-east & has over 30 years of successful achievements and long-term partnerships with distinct customers across the region.

Lead new-business development and profitable revenue growth for CNS cybersecurity services in the Abu Dhabi- UAE. The role requires an established cybersecurity services salesperson with existing CISO/CIO relationships in the assigned Emirate, a proven record of originating and closing managed SOC/MDR, offensive-security and advisory engagements, and the ability to build a qualified pipeline from their network.  **Qualifications**

* Prior MSSP, cybersecurity consultancy or systems integrator experience; multiple SOC/MDR and offensive-security services wins; government, critical infrastructure or BFSI networks; multiyear contract sales.(Preferred)

* Proven hunter; cybersecurity services discovery and qualification; CISO/CIO stakeholder access; SOC/MDR and VAPT sales fluency; full-cycle complex sales, negotiation, RFPs, account planning, CRM and forecasting; strong written/spoken English.

Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts (Client Servicing)

**Company:** Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jayanagar 3rd Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Work Mode:** In-Office  
**Experience:** 3+ Years  
**Number of Openings:** 2  
**Industry:** Business & Strategic Consulting  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** As per company standards

About the Role

Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts to join its Client Servicing vertical.

This is not a typical back-end accounting role. The selected candidate will work as a financial consultant for a portfolio of small to medium-sized corporate clients, including domestic and global businesses.

The role involves managing end-to-end financial activities for assigned clients, covering daily bookkeeping, monthly statutory compliances, payroll, financial reporting, book closure and annual finalisation.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting and taxation knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Handle daily bookkeeping and accounting of expenses on an accrual basis.
* Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorised.
* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification and GST compliance on bills.
* Prepare and maintain weekly vendor registers and coordinate timely payments.
* Raise domestic and export invoices.
* Reconcile invoices and customer collections to ensure proper cash flow management.
* Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, including intercompany accounts and other balance sheet accounts.

2. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

* Manage client bank accounts and cash flows.
* Prepare monthly fund request statements.
* Execute bank transfers and monitor daily liquidity.
* Perform monthly Bank Reconciliations (BRS) and foreign exchange reconciliations.
* Update and maintain fixed asset registers.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* Ensure all sub-ledgers are aligned with the General Ledger at weekly and monthly intervals.

3. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting (MIS)

* Manage month-end closing activities.
* Record depreciation, prepayments and accrual provisions.
* Prepare and finalise monthly Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports for assigned clients.
* Participate in monthly client calls.
* Present financial reports, budget variances and operational insights to client SPOCs.

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation

**GST and Indirect Taxation**

* Handle GST computations and remittances.
* Manage Input Tax Credit (ITC) adjustments.
* Apply for GST refunds and manage GST return filings.

**Direct Taxation**

* Prepare monthly TDS statements and manage timely remittances.
* Handle quarterly advance tax planning, computations and payments.
* File e-TDS returns.
* Provide proactive tax-related guidance and tax-saving strategies.

**Year-End Finalisation & Audit**

* Manage annual books of accounts closure.
* Prepare Schedule III financial statements, including notes and accounting policies.
* Coordinate statutory audits.
* Provide required explanations and documentation to auditors.
* Resolve audit queries and ensure smooth audit sign-off.

5. Comprehensive Payroll & Labour Law Management

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing for assigned clients.
* Calculate salaries, employee benefits and reimbursements accurately.
* Handle monthly statutory remittances and filings related to:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Shops & Establishments (S&E)
* Gratuity
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Ensure accurate salary TDS deductions and timely deposits.
* Manage Form 16 issuance and related payroll compliance.
* Provide guidance and support on applicable labour law requirements under central and state regulations.

6. Global Client Engagement & Strategic Communication

* Act as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for Indian entities of global subsidiaries.
* Interact confidently with Board Directors, senior leadership and global stakeholders.
* Explain Indian financial, taxation and regulatory frameworks in a clear and actionable manner.
* Respond proactively to parent-company queries relating to financial performance, risks and compliance.
* Maintain timely and accurate information flow between clients and internal teams.
* Build professional client relationships through clear communication and ownership of responsibilities.

Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Expertise

* Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience in a professional services environment, preferably a CA firm or consulting firm.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting practices and standards.
* Good knowledge of GST laws and Income Tax provisions.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as:
* Tally
* QuickBooks
* Zoho Books
* Experience with payroll software such as:
* GreytHR
* KEKA
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel is mandatory.
* Practical experience in accounting, taxation, payroll and statutory compliance.

Essential Skills

* Strong client-first mindset and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in interacting with global parent companies and local stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to assess tax implications of business decisions and provide sound professional opinions.
* Strong ownership, time management and organisational skills.
* Proactive approach towards client servicing and financial operations.

Why Join Floraison?

At Floraison, you will work in a high-growth business and strategic consulting environment where you are more than just an accountant—you are a strategic partner to clients.

The organisation values disciplined, self-motivated professionals who take proactive ownership of their work and contribute to delivering high-quality financial and consulting services.

jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
Your profile
  
  

* 18+ years of experience in consulting and technology, including substantial leadership experience across Data, Analytics, AI and Cloud transformation.
* Prior senior leadership experience with a Big 4 consulting firm or leading Global System Integrator is mandatory, with evidence of building or scaling a Data & AI, Microsoft, Azure or Databricks practice.
* Proven ownership of practice growth, P&L or commercial targets, including large-deal origination, strategic sales, pipeline creation and executive client engagement.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Power BI, Purview, Azure AI, Azure Databricks and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
* Credible understanding of Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data engineering, analytics, ML/AI, GenAI, security, governance and platform modernization. Able to guide Fabric versus Databricks positioning, integration and coexistence decisions, and challenge architecture choices against scalability, operating cost, data quality and business requirements.
* Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft and/or Databricks alliances and converting partner relationships into joint opportunities, offerings, certifications and revenue.

**Preferred**

* Middle East market experience, especially UAE and KSA, with strong regional client and partner relationships.
* Relevant Microsoft Fabric/Azure and Databricks certifications or demonstrable oversight of certified practices.
* Industry experience in Financial Services, Government, Energy & Utilities, Telecom, Manufacturing or Retail.

Your role
  
  
Own the strategy, growth and operational leadership of the Microsoft and Databricks practice. The role carries accountability for bookings, revenue, pipeline, offerings, alliances, delivery governance, talent and market positioning across the Data & AI portfolio. Translate platform capabilities into commercially viable transformation programmes, working with sales, industry and delivery leaders to shape client investment priorities and build a sustainable services business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the practice strategy and multi-year growth plan across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Governance, AI/ML and Generative AI.
* Own or materially influence bookings, revenue, qualified pipeline, margin and utilization; lead strategic pursuits, proposals, solution shaping and C-suite presentations. Establish account growth plans, review opportunity qualification and commercial models, and maintain disciplined sales forecasting with account leaders.
* Build executive relationships and joint go-to-market plans with Microsoft and Databricks, including co-sell pipeline, partner funding, certifications, events and joint offerings. Align partner and account teams around priority clients, joint campaigns and opportunity conversion, with clear ownership and regular business reviews.
* Develop differentiated, repeatable propositions such as Fabric adoption, Databricks/Lakehouse modernization, data platform migration, AI-ready data foundations, GenAI and managed data services.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Data & AI strategy, platform choices, architecture, governance, investment roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
* Provide executive governance for major engagements, ensuring delivery quality, architecture integrity, responsible AI, security, profitability and customer satisfaction. Sponsor architecture and delivery reviews, resolve escalations, and ensure proposals translate into achievable scope, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
* Build and lead a high-performing, multi-location team of practice leaders, architects, engineers, data scientists and governance specialists; drive hiring, certifications and succession planning.
